APSSB Special Recruitment Drive 2026 Overview

Advertisement

Pay Scale Level-3, ₹21,700–69,100 in Pay Matrix for all posts ​

Closing Date of Application 10-04-2026 (03:00 PM) ​

Download Official Notification PDF

Candidates must read the detailed notification before applying online.​

  • Official APSSB Special Recruitment Drive 2026 Notification PDF

Release of Notification 13-03-2026 ​

Closing Date of Online Application 10-04-2026 (03:00 PM) ​
Tentative Written Examination 10-05-2026 (Sunday) ​
Tentative PST, PET & Trade Test 25-05-2026 onwards ​

Vacancy & Salary Details

All posts are in Level-3 of the Pay Matrix (₹21,700–69,100).​

Post Code Post Name Pay Matrix Total Ex-SM
5/26 Constable Band (IRBn) (Male) Level-3 (₹21,700–69,100) ​ 6 0 ​
6/26 Constable Bugler (IRBn) (Male) Level-3 (₹21,700–69,100) ​ 2 0 ​
7/26 Constable IRBn (Male) Level-3 (₹21,700–69,100) ​ 421 0 ​
8/26 Constable Civil Police (Female) Level-3 (₹21,700–69,100) ​ 51 0 ​
9/26 Constable Civil Police (Male) Level-3 (₹21,700–69,100) ​ 216 58 ​
10/26 Fireman (Male) Level-3 (₹21,700–69,100) ​ 73 3 ​
11/26 Special Tiger Guard (STPF) Level-3 (₹21,700–69,100) ​ 243 0 ​
  Grand Total   984 67 ​

Eligibility Criteria

Nationality & Cut-off Date

  • Candidate must be a citizen of India.​

  • Educational qualification, age and experience will be reckoned as on 10-04-2026 (closing date).​

Educational Qualification (All Posts)

  • Must have passed Class X / Matric or equivalent from a recognised Board.​

  • For Constable Band (IRBn): 10th pass with knowledge of playing band.​

  • For Constable Bugler (IRBn): 10th pass with knowledge of playing bugle.​

Age Limit

Age limit is determined as on 10-04-2026.​

Post Codes Posts Age Limit
5/26, 6/26, 7/26, 8/26, 9/26 Constable Band, Bugler, IRBn, Civil Police (Male & Female) 18–22 years ​
10/26, 11/26 Fireman, Special Tiger Guard (STPF) 18–32 years ​

Age Relaxation:

  • APST candidates: up to 5 years over the upper age limit.​

  • Ex-Servicemen: allowed to deduct period of service plus up to 3 years, as per rules; detailed formula as in notification.​

  • One-time upper age relaxation is available only for certain candidates of earlier Constable exam (as per Govt notification) for Post Codes 5/26, 6/26, 8/26 and 9/26.​

Physical Standards (PST) – Key Points

Only highlights are given here; candidates should check post-wise tables in the notification for full details.​

  • Constable (IRBn/Civil Police/Fireman – Male):

    • General: Height 165 cm; Chest 79–84 cm.​

    • APST (other than Tirap/Changlang/Longding): Height 160 cm.​

    • APST (Tirap/Changlang/Longding): Height 152 cm.​

    • Ex-Servicemen: Height 157 cm (where applicable).​

  • Constable Civil Police (Female):

    • General: Height 157 cm.​

    • APST: 152 cm.​

  • Special Tiger Guard (STPF):

    • Male (General): 163 cm; APST: 152 cm; chest 79–84 cm.​

    • Female (General): 150 cm; APST: 145 cm; chest 74–79 cm.​

Vision standards: Better eye 6/6 (corrected), worse eye 6/12 (corrected), near vision J1/J2; no colour blindness.​

Application Fees

  • APST candidates: ₹150 (non-refundable).​

  • Unreserved candidates: ₹200 (non-refundable).​

  • Fee to be paid online only; no other mode is accepted.​

Selection Process – Stages

Selection will be done through multiple stages depending on the post.​

For Post Codes 5/26 to 10/26

  • Stage I: Written Examination – Objective Type, 200 marks, 2 hours.​

    • General Awareness – 50 marks

    • General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability – 50 marks

    • Arithmetical & Numerical Ability – 50 marks

    • English Language & Comprehension – 50 marks​

    • Minimum 33% aggregate marks required; no negative marking.​

  • Stage II: Physical Standard Test (PST), Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Trade Test (where applicable).​

    • For Constable Band & Bugler: Trade Test in playing band/bugle.​

    • Candidates shortlisted for Stage II in 1:3 ratio, subject to written exam cut-off.​

    • Ex-Servicemen exempted from PET & Trade Test but must qualify PST.​

  • Stage III: Medical Fitness Test.​

For Post Code 11/26 (Special Tiger Guard)

  • Stage I: Written Examination (same pattern).​

  • Stage II: PST & PET as per standards.​

PST, PET, Trade Test and Medical Fitness Test are qualifying in nature; final merit is based on written exam and preference of posts.​

General Instructions (Key Points)

  • Applications submitted in any mode other than online will be rejected.​

  • Candidates must carefully fill all details; no modification after closing date.​

  • Multiple applications for the same post: only latest application will be considered.​

  • Admit Cards will be available only on www.apssb.nic.in; no individual admit card will be sent.​

  • Candidates must carry the same Photo ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID, DL, PAN or Govt ID) used in application along with admit card to exam centre.​

  • Use of mobile phones, calculators, smart watches and electronic gadgets is strictly prohibited in the exam hall.​

How to Apply Online for APSSB Special Recruitment Drive 2026

Follow the steps below to submit the online application form on the APSSB portal.​

  1. Visit the official website www.apssb.nic.in within the application window (23-03-2026 to 10-04-2026 up to 3 PM).​

  2. Click on the relevant link for “Special Recruitment Drive for Uniformed Services Combined Examination 2026 (Advt 04/26)”.​

  3. Complete the registration using basic details, mobile number and email ID, if required by the portal.​

  4. Login and fill the online application form with personal details, educational qualification, category, and communication details.​

  5. Select your post preferences and Department/Office carefully; once submitted, preference cannot be changed later.​

  6. Upload scanned passport size photograph and signature in the prescribed format and size.​

  7. Pay the application fee online (₹150 for APST, ₹200 for UR) using available payment modes.​

  8. Submit the application form and take a printout of the final submitted form and fee receipt for future reference.​

  9. Download the admit card from the APSSB website when released and keep it safely till the recruitment process is over.​

AP Staff Nurse Eligibility Criteria 2026

Educational Qualification

The candidate must possess General Nursing & Midwifery (GNM) or B.Sc (Nursing) qualification from a recognised institution as on the date of this notification. Candidates must also hold a valid registration certificate with A.P.N.M.C or any other council constituted under the relevant rules for the specific course. The marks obtained in GNM / B.Sc (Nursing) qualification will be taken for reckoning weightage for contract/outsource/honorarium service and for waiting period weightage after completion of the qualification.

If an applicant possesses an equivalent qualification, they must enclose a copy of the Government orders to that effect along with the application; failing which the application will be rejected.

AP Staff Nurse Selection Process 2026

Selection will be based on a merit list prepared out of a total of 100 marks. The merit criteria are as follows.

  • Academic Marks (75%): 75% weightage will be allocated for the aggregate marks obtained in all years of the qualifying examination (GNM / B.Sc Nursing) or equivalent qualification.
  • Experience Weightage (up to 10 marks): 1.0 mark per completed year after acquiring the requisite qualification as mentioned in the pass certificate. Weightage will be reckoned up to the date of notification as per Govt. Memo No. 4274/D1/2013, HM&FW (D1) Dept., Dt. 10.07.2014.
  • Contract / Outsourcing / Honorarium Service Weightage (up to 15%): Candidates working on contract/outsourcing/honorarium basis including COVID-19 service will be given up to 15% weightage subject to satisfactory service certified by the competent authority. COVID-19 weightage is 0.8 marks per completed month for service less than 6 months.
  • Weightage based on Working Area: 2.5 marks per six months in Tribal Area; 2.0 marks per six months in Rural Area; 1.0 mark per six months in Urban Area.
  • CHOs (MLHPs) Weightage: As per G.O.RT.No.108, HM&FW(E1), service rendered in the cadre of CHOs (MLHPs) working in Village Health Clinics will also be considered for service weightage for future recruitment of Staff Nurse on contract basis.

The merit list of this notification is valid for one year from the date of publishing on the website. The Selection Committee reserves the right to terminate contract services at any time with one month's notice or as per Government directions.

Documents to be Enclosed with Application

Candidates must enclose self-attested copies of the following certificates along with the filled-in application. Applications without the required documents will be summarily rejected.

  • SSC or its equivalent certificate (for date of birth proof)
  • Pass certificates of GNM / B.Sc (Nursing) qualification
  • Proof of appearance for qualifying examination wherever applicable
  • Marks memos of all years of qualifying examination
  • Valid registration certificate with A.P.N.M.C or relevant council
  • Study certificates from Class IV to Class X (for local candidature status)
  • Valid Caste Certificate — SC candidates must submit latest certificate specifying Sub Groups I, II & III
  • Latest EWS (Economically Weaker Sections) certificate issued by competent authority (if applicable)
  • Certificate of disability issued in SADAREM (if applicable)
  • Ex-Servicemen: Service certificate from the controlling officer concerned
  • Service certificate from DM&HO / DCHS / Principals of GMCs / Superintendent of GGH / any competent authority for claiming contract/outsourcing/honorarium service weightage
  • Any other certificates as relevant and applicable
  • Self-addressed envelope 10 × 4 with Postal Stamp worth ₹40/-

Note: Candidates must submit clear, visible documents. Applications without the above documents will be summarily rejected. The self-attested copy of the appointment order must be enclosed along with the service certificate; otherwise, weightage for contract/outsourcing/honorary service will not be considered for final merit.

Important Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted offline only — no online or any other mode of application will be entertained. Any application sent through a mode other than the prescribed offline mode (physical application) will not be entertained under any circumstances.
  • The filled-in application must be submitted to the Office of the Regional Director of Medical and Health Services, Aswini Hospital Backside, Old Itukulabatti Road, Guntur on or before 25.03.2026 by 05:00 PM.
  • An acknowledgment must be obtained from the concerned Office of the Regional Director of Medical and Health Services on receipt of the application with a check-slip of enclosures.
  • Candidates must ensure they are eligible for the post applied for. Any candidate furnishing incorrect information or making false declarations at any stage is liable to be debarred from this and future recruitments conducted by the department.
  • The application proforma is available on the portal http://cfw.ap.nic.in from 10:00 AM on 17.03.2026. Candidates are advised to check the official website regularly for further information.
  • Candidates claiming service weightage must submit the original contract/outsourcing/honorarium service certificate in the enclosed proforma issued by the competent authority along with a copy of appointment orders. Applications without service certificates will not be considered for service weightage. If additional period of service is there, a fresh certificate to that effect must be obtained and enclosed.
  • Contract service will be reckoned up to the date of notification (17.03.2026) only.
  • Reservations are applicable as per Rule 22 of AP State and Subordinate Services Rules, including BC, SC, ST, EWS, Differently Abled, Ex-Servicemen, and Meritorious Sports Persons as per the relevant Government Orders in force.
  • The Presidential Order is applicable as per GO M.s No 674 GA (SPF.A) Dept dated 28.10.1975 and related orders regarding local candidature. Candidates migrated from Telangana must submit certificate of local candidature as per GO No 132 & 133 dt. 13.06.2017.
  • If selected, the candidate should stay at the Bonafide Head Quarters compulsorily and must abide by the Government rules in force regularly from time to time.
  • The tenure of appointment is initially one year from the date of joining, which may be extended as per Government instructions. The Selection Committee reserves the right to terminate contract services at any time with one month's notice.
  • Submission of application by the candidate is authentication that he/she has read the notification and shall abide by the terms and conditions laid down therein.
  • The decision of the department regarding acceptance or rejection of candidature, conduct of counselling and selection at all stages shall be final and binding on all concerned.
  • Candidates must submit clear, visible documents — applications with unclear or missing documents will be summarily rejected.

How to Apply for AP Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply for AP Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 in offline mode by following the steps below.

Eligibility criteria - South Central Railway Act Apprentice 2025-26

1) Educational qualification​

  • 10th class/SSC passed under 10+2 system with minimum 50% aggregate marks from a recognised board.

  • ITI certificate in the relevant notified trade from an institute recognised by NCVT/SCVT (trade-wise: AC Mechanic, Carpenter, COPA, Diesel Mechanic, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Fitter, Industrial Electronics, Machinist, MMTM, Motor Mechanic Vehicle, Painter, Welder).

  • Candidate must possess required qualification as on date of online application submission.

  • Engineering graduates and diploma holders are not eligible for this Act Apprentice notification (covered under separate scheme).

2) Age limit (as on 11.04.2026)​

  • Minimum age: 15 years.

  • Maximum age: 24 years.

Category-wise permissible date of birth range:

Category Date of birth between
UR / EWS 11-04-2002 and 11-04-2011
SC / ST 11-04-1997 and 11-04-2011
OBC-NCL 11-04-1999 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (UR) 11-04-1992 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (SC/ST) 11-04-1987 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (OBC) 11-04-1989 and 11-04-2011

Relaxations included in above ranges:

  • SC/ST: +5 years.

  • OBC-NCL: +3 years.

  • PwBD: +10 years.

  • Ex-Servicemen: +10 years up to length of service in Defence Forces (no extra relaxation for their children).

3) Residential / jurisdiction eligibility​
Candidates must reside in districts under South Central Railway jurisdiction and provide valid proof of residence. Eligible areas:

  • Telangana: all districts.

  • Andhra Pradesh: all districts except Manyam, Srikakulam, Vizianagaram.

  • Maharashtra: Akola, Amaravati, Aurangabad, Beed, Chandrapur, Hingoli, Jalna, Latur, Nanded, Nasik, Parbhani, Washim, Yavatmal.

  • Karnataka: Balki, Bellari, Belgaum, Bidar, Gulbarga/Kalaburgi, Raichur, Yadgir.

  • Tamil Nadu: Vellore.

  • Madhya Pradesh: Burhanpur, Khandwa.

4) Category certificates (for reservation)​

  • SC/ST: Central Government format caste certificate (Annexure-B).

  • OBC-NCL: caste + NCL certificate (issued within 3 years) in Central format (Annexure-C) + self-declaration (Annexure-D).

  • EWS: valid Income & Asset certificate (Annexure-E).

  • PwBD: disability ≥40% in prescribed format (Annexure-G/H).

5) Salary/Stipend

  • Selected candidates will be paid a stipend during the apprenticeship at the prescribed rates as per extant instructions.

SCR Apprentice Selection Process 2025-26

  • Merit List Basis: Selection for SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 will be done purely on merit, by taking the average of percentage marks in 10th (minimum 50% aggregate) and ITI marks, giving equal weightage to both.
  • No Exam / Interview: There will be no written test or viva-voce for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26.
  • Tie-breaking: If two candidates have the same aggregate percentage, older candidate (higher age) will be preferred; if DOB is also same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred.
  • Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates will be called for DV where all original certificates (education, ITI, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, RDAT registration, medical fitness) will be verified.
  • Medical Fitness: Candidates must produce medical fitness certificate from a government-authorised doctor (Gazetted, not below Asst. Surgeon) in prescribed format at DV; without this, they will not be considered.
  • Training & Stipend: Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training as per Central Apprenticeship Council syllabus and receive stipend at prescribed rates during training.
  • No Job Guarantee: SCR apprenticeship 2025-26 provides training only; there is no guarantee of regular railway job after completion of apprenticeship.

South Central Railway Apprentice Application Form 2026

  • Application Mode: Online only via RRC/SCR portal; no offline forms will be accepted.
  • Application Dates: SCR Apprentice online form 2026 is available from 12 March 2026 (17:00 hrs) to 11 April 2026 (23:59 hrs).
  • Fee: ₹100 for applicable categories; SC/ST, female/Transgender and PwBD candidates are exempt from fee payment.
  • Multiple Trades: Candidates with ITI in more than one trade can submit separate SCR Apprentice application 2026 for each trade.
  • Communication: All updates regarding SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 application form, merit list and DV will be sent via registered email/SMS and uploaded on RRC-SCR webpage only.

How to Apply for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26

  1. Visit the official South Central Railway website: https://scr.indianrailways.gov.in and go to About Us → RRC-SCR to open the ONLINE ACT APPRENTICE APPLICATION link.
  2. Read the detailed SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 notification carefully and ensure you belong to the eligible states/districts and possess required 10th + ITI qualification.
  3. Complete Registration: select state and district, upload address proof, enter valid mobile number and email ID, create a password and verify OTPs sent to mobile and email.
  4. Login as a registered candidate and fill in personal details (name, DOB, category, etc.) and educational/technical details (10th marks, ITI trade, ITI marks, RDAT registration number).
  5. Select your priority/preference of training units (Divisions/Workshops/Sheds) only for trades you are eligible for; options once submitted cannot be changed.
  6. Upload a recent colour photograph (JPEG, ≤1 MB, not older than 3 months), signature image (≤1 MB) and required certificates (10th, ITI, RDAT form, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, medical certificate) in PDF format (≤2 MB).
  7. Ensure you have completed RDAT/NAPS registration at www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and obtained registration number before filling the SCR apprentice application.
  8. Check all details in the Preview page carefully; after clicking Submit, no modification will be allowed.
  9. Pay the application fee (if applicable) through online payment gateway (Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI) and generate e-receipt.
  10. Download/print the final submitted SCR Apprentice application form 2026 and keep it along with fee receipt and uploaded documents for Document Verification.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Disc Code 101 – Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 102 – Technician Apprentice (Electrical): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 103 – Technician Apprentice (Instrumentation): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 104 – Technician Apprentice (Civil): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Civil Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 105 – Technician Apprentice (Electrical & Electronics): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 106 – Technician Apprentice (Electronics): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 107 – Trade Apprentice (Fitter): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Fitter) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 108 – Trade Apprentice (Electrician): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Electrician) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 109 – Trade Apprentice (Electronics Mechanic): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Electronics Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 110 – Trade Apprentice (Instrument Mechanic): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Instrument Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 111 – Trade Apprentice (Machinist): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Machinist) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 112 – Graduate Apprentice (BA/B.Com/B.Sc/BBA): Regular full-time Graduate in any discipline with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 113 – Trade Apprentice – Data Entry Operator (Fresher): Class 12th (but below graduate) with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/Board.
  • Disc Code 114 – Trade Apprentice – Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Class 12th (but below graduate) plus Skill Certificate of 'Domestic Data Entry Operator' for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.
  • Qualification must be from a recognized University/Institute as a full-time regular course. Qualifications acquired through Part-time / Correspondence / Distance Learning mode are NOT ELIGIBLE.
  • For Graduate and Technician disciplines, qualification must be acquired between 01.04.2022 and 28.02.2026.
  • For Trade Apprentices (ITI/Data Entry Operator), qualification must be acquired between 01.04.2021 and 28.02.2026.
  • Candidates possessing higher qualifications such as B.E./B.Tech., MBA, MCA, CA, ICWA, LLB or equivalent are NOT ELIGIBLE.
  • Diploma holders under lateral entry scheme (Class XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year) are also eligible subject to prescribed percentage in aggregate of all semesters.
  • A candidate may undergo a maximum of two apprenticeship trainings, and the second training shall not be in the same trade.

Salary / Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973 and Apprentices Rules 1992/2019/2025 as amended from time to time.
  • The exact stipend amount is not specified in the notification; candidates are advised to refer to the latest Apprentices Rules for updated stipend rates.

Age Limit (as on 28-02-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 Years
  • Maximum Age: 24 Years
  • SC/ST candidates: Age relaxation of 5 years (maximum up to 29 years)
  • OBC-NCL candidates: Age relaxation of 3 years (maximum up to 27 years)
  • PwBD candidates: Age relaxation of up to 10 years (up to 15 years for SC/ST PwBD; up to 13 years for OBC-NCL PwBD)
  • Cutoff/Reckoning date for age criteria: 28.02.2026

Application Fee

  • No Application Fee has been mentioned in the official notification.
  • Candidates apply through NAPS / NATS portals; any charges levied by the portal (if any) are not specified in this notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 11/03/2026
Opening of Online Application 11/03/2026 from 10:00 AM onwards
Last Date for Submission of Online Application 26/03/2026 up to 5:00 PM
Document Verification Date To be intimated on registered email ID / IOCL website
Cutoff / Reckoning Date (Age & Qualification) 28/02/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates must register successfully on NAPS/NATS portal and apply against the notification to be considered for the selection process.
  • There will be no written test or interview.
  • A merit list will be prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential prescribed qualification for the respective post.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification.
  • Shortlisted candidates must complete a Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test and be adjudged medically fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical format.
  • Candidates whose documents and Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Certificate are found in order shall be issued an Offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training.
  • Opportunities not filled through the initial shortlisting shall be filled by eligible candidates from the merit cum panel list for the same opportunity.

General Information / Instructions

  • Candidates must apply only for ONE discipline code. Applications for more than one discipline code will be summarily rejected.
  • Applicants must submit applications only against vacancies notified under the states of Western Region (Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, UT of Daman & Diu, UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli). Selection of training locations outside notified states will result in rejection.
  • Candidate profile on the portal must be 100% complete (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category, etc.).
  • The candidature of the applicant shall be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates and testimonials.
  • Any false or incorrect information furnished at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature and liability for criminal prosecution.
  • Candidates should maintain the same registered email ID and mobile number till completion of apprenticeship training.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats shall be considered subject to fulfilling standards applicable to General category candidates.
  • PwBD candidates are NOT eligible to apply for Discipline Codes 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110, 111.
  • Reservation will be applicable as per the prescribed percentage for the respective States/UT.
  • No. of seats indicated is tentative and may increase or decrease at the absolute discretion of management.
  • Upon completion of the Apprenticeship period, IOCL shall have NO obligation to offer employment, nor can an Apprentice claim the right for employment.
  • A minimum one-year gap between two apprenticeship trainings is required, provided the previous training is completed.
  • All future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on IOCL website: https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships.
  • For OBC-NCL category, candidates must submit a latest caste certificate not more than 12 months old from 28.02.2026 in the Proforma prescribed by Govt. of India.
  • Canvassing of any kind shall disqualify the candidate.

How to Apply

  • Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria must apply online only through the NAPS/NATS Portal.
  • For Trade Apprentice (ITI/Data Entry Operator): Register at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/ (NAPS)
  • For Technician Apprentice (Diploma) and Graduate Apprentice: Register at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php (NATS)
  • After registration, login to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using your User ID/Email ID and APPLY for apprenticeship openings using the following Establishment IDs of IOCL (Marketing Division) – Western Region:
    • NATS Establishment ID: WMHMCC000053
    • NAPS Establishment ID: E01172700332
  • Application window: 11.03.2026 (10:00 AM) to 26.03.2026 (5:00 PM).
  • No other means or mode of application will be accepted.
  • Ensure your profile is 100% complete with Personal Details, Educational Details, and Category before applying.
  • Before applying, keep ready: PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account details with Cheque Book (name printed), and scanned copies of Educational Qualification Certificates.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well in advance before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.
  • Candidates registered with Local/State Employment Exchange(s) / Vocational Rehabilitation Centre for PwBD and meeting prescribed eligibility criteria must apply through NAPS/NATS Portal.

  • Disc Code 102 – Technician Apprentice (Electrical): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 103 – Technician Apprentice (Instrumentation): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 104 – Technician Apprentice (Civil): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Civil Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 105 – Technician Apprentice (Electrical & Electronics): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 106 – Technician Apprentice (Electronics): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 107 – Trade Apprentice (Fitter): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Fitter) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 108 – Trade Apprentice (Electrician): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Electrician) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 109 – Trade Apprentice (Electronics Mechanic): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Electronics Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 110 – Trade Apprentice (Instrument Mechanic): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Instrument Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 111 – Trade Apprentice (Machinist): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Machinist) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 112 – Graduate Apprentice (BA/B.Com/B.Sc/BBA): Regular full-time Graduate in any discipline with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 113 – Trade Apprentice – Data Entry Operator (Fresher): Class 12th (but below graduate) with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/Board.
  • Disc Code 114 – Trade Apprentice – Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Class 12th (but below graduate) plus Skill Certificate of 'Domestic Data Entry Operator' for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.
  • Qualification must be from a recognized University/Institute as a full-time regular course. Qualifications acquired through Part-time / Correspondence / Distance Learning mode are NOT ELIGIBLE.
  • For Graduate and Technician disciplines, qualification must be acquired between 01.04.2022 and 28.02.2026.
  • For Trade Apprentices (ITI/Data Entry Operator), qualification must be acquired between 01.04.2021 and 28.02.2026.
  • Candidates possessing higher qualifications such as B.E./B.Tech., MBA, MCA, CA, ICWA, LLB or equivalent are NOT ELIGIBLE.
  • Diploma holders under lateral entry scheme (Class XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year) are also eligible subject to prescribed percentage in aggregate of all semesters.
  • A candidate may undergo a maximum of two apprenticeship trainings, and the second training shall not be in the same trade.

Salary / Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973 and Apprentices Rules 1992/2019/2025 as amended from time to time.
  • The exact stipend amount is not specified in the notification; candidates are advised to refer to the latest Apprentices Rules for updated stipend rates.

Age Limit (as on 28-02-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 Years
  • Maximum Age: 24 Years
  • SC/ST candidates: Age relaxation of 5 years (maximum up to 29 years)
  • OBC-NCL candidates: Age relaxation of 3 years (maximum up to 27 years)
  • PwBD candidates: Age relaxation of up to 10 years (up to 15 years for SC/ST PwBD; up to 13 years for OBC-NCL PwBD)
  • Cutoff/Reckoning date for age criteria: 28.02.2026

Application Fee

  • No Application Fee has been mentioned in the official notification.
  • Candidates apply through NAPS / NATS portals; any charges levied by the portal (if any) are not specified in this notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 11/03/2026
Opening of Online Application 11/03/2026 from 10:00 AM onwards
Last Date for Submission of Online Application 26/03/2026 up to 5:00 PM
Document Verification Date To be intimated on registered email ID / IOCL website
Cutoff / Reckoning Date (Age & Qualification) 28/02/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates must register successfully on NAPS/NATS portal and apply against the notification to be considered for the selection process.
  • There will be no written test or interview.
  • A merit list will be prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential prescribed qualification for the respective post.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification.
  • Shortlisted candidates must complete a Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test and be adjudged medically fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical format.
  • Candidates whose documents and Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Certificate are found in order shall be issued an Offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training.
  • Opportunities not filled through the initial shortlisting shall be filled by eligible candidates from the merit cum panel list for the same opportunity.

General Information / Instructions

  • Candidates must apply only for ONE discipline code. Applications for more than one discipline code will be summarily rejected.
  • Applicants must submit applications only against vacancies notified under the states of Western Region (Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, UT of Daman & Diu, UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli). Selection of training locations outside notified states will result in rejection.
  • Candidate profile on the portal must be 100% complete (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category, etc.).
  • The candidature of the applicant shall be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates and testimonials.
  • Any false or incorrect information furnished at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature and liability for criminal prosecution.
  • Candidates should maintain the same registered email ID and mobile number till completion of apprenticeship training.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats shall be considered subject to fulfilling standards applicable to General category candidates.
  • PwBD candidates are NOT eligible to apply for Discipline Codes 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110, 111.
  • Reservation will be applicable as per the prescribed percentage for the respective States/UT.
  • No. of seats indicated is tentative and may increase or decrease at the absolute discretion of management.
  • Upon completion of the Apprenticeship period, IOCL shall have NO obligation to offer employment, nor can an Apprentice claim the right for employment.
  • A minimum one-year gap between two apprenticeship trainings is required, provided the previous training is completed.
  • All future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on IOCL website: https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships.
  • For OBC-NCL category, candidates must submit a latest caste certificate not more than 12 months old from 28.02.2026 in the Proforma prescribed by Govt. of India.
  • Canvassing of any kind shall disqualify the candidate.

How to Apply

  • Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria must apply online only through the NAPS/NATS Portal.
  • For Trade Apprentice (ITI/Data Entry Operator): Register at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/ (NAPS)
  • For Technician Apprentice (Diploma) and Graduate Apprentice: Register at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php (NATS)
  • After registration, login to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using your User ID/Email ID and APPLY for apprenticeship openings using the following Establishment IDs of IOCL (Marketing Division) – Western Region:
    • NATS Establishment ID: WMHMCC000053
    • NAPS Establishment ID: E01172700332
  • Application window: 11.03.2026 (10:00 AM) to 26.03.2026 (5:00 PM).
  • No other means or mode of application will be accepted.
  • Ensure your profile is 100% complete with Personal Details, Educational Details, and Category before applying.
  • Before applying, keep ready: PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account details with Cheque Book (name printed), and scanned copies of Educational Qualification Certificates.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well in advance before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.
  • Candidates registered with Local/State Employment Exchange(s) / Vocational Rehabilitation Centre for PwBD and meeting prescribed eligibility criteria must apply through NAPS/NATS Portal.

Gauhati High Court Stenographer Grade III Selection Process 2026

The selection process consists of three stages:

Stage I – Stenography Test (Dictation & Transcription) – 90 Marks

  • Voice testing before dictation (2 minutes).
  • Dictation in shorthand at 80 wpm (total 560 words in 7 minutes).​
  • Time allowed for testing computer: 3 minutes.​
  • Time for transcription on computer: 20 minutes

Stage II – Written Test (Descriptive) – 100 Marks, 2 Hours (Qualifying)

  • English Language Segment – 80 marks (Composition, Essay, Grammar).​
  • Mizo Language Segment – 20 marks.​
  • Candidates in ratio of 1:10 from the stenography merit list will be called for the written test.​
  • Minimum qualifying marks:
  • 40% in English segment (32/80).​
  • 40% in Mizo segment (8/20).​
  • Written test is qualifying in nature and marks will not be counted for final merit.​

Stage III – Interview / Viva‑Voce – 30 Marks

  • Minimum qualifying marks: 60% (18 out of 30) in Interview/Viva‑Voce.​

Final selection will be based on total marks obtained in Stenography Skill Test and Interview/Viva‑Voce only. If two or more candidates secure the same grand total, higher marks in the stenography test will be given preference; if still tied, the candidate senior in age will be preferred.

AAI Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

  • Nationality / Domicile: Only Indian Nationals who are domiciles of Chandigarh, Delhi, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, Leh Ladakh, Madhya Pradesh, Punjab, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, and Uttarakhand are eligible.
  • Qualification – Graduate / Diploma: Candidates must possess a full-time (regular) four-year degree or three-year (regular) diploma in Engineering in the above-mentioned streams, recognized by AICTE, Government of India.
  • Qualification – ITI Trade: Candidates must possess an ITI/NCVT certificate in Computer Operator Programming Assistant (COPA) and Steno trades from institutions recognized by AICTE, Government of India.
  • Year of Passing: Candidates who passed their degree/diploma in or after 2022 are eligible.
  • Previous Apprenticeship: Candidates who have already completed or terminated their apprenticeship midway, or are currently pursuing apprenticeship in other organizations or in AAI with the same qualification level, are NOT eligible.
  • Job Experience: Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training/job experience for a period of 1 year or more after attaining the essential qualification are NOT eligible.
  • Candidates applying for more than one discipline will not be considered and their application will be rejected.

AAI Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

  • No Application Fee is being charged for this recruitment.

AAI Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

  • Minimum Age: 18 Years
  • Maximum Age: 26 Years
  • Age Relaxation: Relaxation in upper age limit for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD and other categories as per Government of India guidelines is applicable.

AAI Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend

  • Graduate (Degree) Apprentices: Rs. 15,000 per month
    • AAI Share: Rs. 10,500
    • Government Share (through DBT): Rs. 4,500
  • Technical (Diploma) Apprentices: Rs. 12,000 per month
    • AAI Share: Rs. 8,000
    • Government Share (through DBT): Rs. 4,000
  • Trade Apprentices (ITI): Rs. 9,600 per month
  • Stipend is payable as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as amended from time to time).
  • AAI has no obligation to offer regular employment to apprentices after completion of training. Apprentices shall have no right to claim regular employment from AAI on the basis of this apprenticeship at any point of time.

AAI Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates

Last Date for Submission of Online Application 22/03/2026
Age Reckoning Date 31/03/2026
Document Verification Date To be intimated via registered email ID
Period of Apprenticeship Training 12 Months (from commencement of Contract of Apprenticeship)

AAI Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

  • Provisional selection based on percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying examination.
  • Document verification.
  • Medical examination.

How to Apply

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AAI Various Posts Recruitment 2026.

  • Candidates must apply online only through the NATS or NAPS portal as applicable:
    • For Graduate / Diploma Apprentices: Apply through BOAT/NATS portal at www.nats.education.gov.in
    • For ITI Trade Apprentices: Apply through NAPS portal at www.apprenticeshipindia.org
  • Search for Establishment: Airports Authority of India – RHQ NR, New Delhi
    • BOAT Establishment ID: NDLSWC000002
    • NAPS Establishment ID: E05200700101
  • Click on the Apply button on the establishment page. After successful application, the portal will display the message: "Successfully applied for the training position. Based on availability, you will be contacted by the establishment."
  • Candidates must register themselves on the respective portal (NATS/NAPS) before applying. Please refer to Annexure I, II & III attached with the official notification.
  • Only registered applications received online through NATS/NAPS portal will be considered. No other mode of application will be entertained.
  • Last date for application: 22.03.2026.
  • No Application Fee is required.
  • Candidates applying for more than one discipline will be rejected.

Punjab Police Constable Selection Process 2026

The Punjab Police Constable Recruitment 2026 selection process consists of three stages:

Stage-I: Computer Based Test (CBT)

The CBT comprises two papers:

Paper-I (100 marks, 2 hours duration)

Section Topics Number of Questions
General Awareness Constitution, Central & State Legislature, History, Geography, Culture & Economy of Punjab, Health & Nutrition, Current Affairs 35
Quantitative Aptitude and Numerical Skills Simplification, Average, Decimal & Fractions, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Profit & Loss, Simple Interest, Time & Work 20
Mental Ability & Logical Reasoning Number & Letter Series, Sequencing, Statements & Conclusions, Pattern Completion, Order & Ranking, Direction & Distances, Relationship Problems 20
English Language Skills Reading Comprehension, Punjabi to English Translation, Sentence rearrangement & correction, Error Spotting, Fill in the Blanks, Spelling Correction, Vocabulary 10
Punjabi Language Skills ਸ਼ੁੱਧ/ਅਸ਼ੁੱਧ, ਸਮਾਨਾਰਥਕ/ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਸ਼ਬਦ, ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਅਖਾਣ ਅਤੇ ਮੁਹਾਵਰੇ, ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਤੋਂ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਅਨੁਵਾਦ, etc. 10
Digital Literacy & Awareness Fundamentals of Computers, MS Office, Internet, Email Communication, Mobile Phones 05
Total   100

Paper-II (50 marks, 1 hour duration) – Mandatory Qualifying Paper

  • Punjabi Language test of Matriculation standard
  • Qualifying criteria: 50% marks (25 out of 50)
  • Note: Marks obtained in Paper-II will NOT be counted for merit calculation

Minimum Qualifying Marks (Paper-I after normalization):

  • SC/BC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen: 35%
  • Other categories: 40%

Important Points:

  • No negative marking
  • Normalization will be applied as CBT conducted in multiple shifts
  • Answer key will be published after exam; candidates can raise objections within 48 hours (Rs. 50 per objection)

Stage-II: Physical Screening Test (PST) & Physical Measurement Test (PMT)

Candidates qualifying Paper-I and Paper-II will be shortlisted for Stage-II based on merit.

Physical Screening Test (PST):

Candidate Category Physical Tests
Male (including Ex-servicemen below 35 years) • 1600 meters race in 6 min 30 sec (1 chance)
• Long Jump 3.80 meters (3 chances)

• Long Jump 3.00 meters (3 chances)
• High Jump 0.95 meters (3 chances)
Ex-Servicemen Female (above 35 years) • 800 meters run in 6 minutes (1 chance)

Physical Measurement Test (PMT):

  • Height measurement as per eligibility criteria mentioned above
  • Candidates not meeting minimum height will be disqualified

Stage-III: Document Scrutiny

Candidates qualifying Stage-II will be called for document verification. Required documents include:

  • Matriculation certificate (proof of age)
  • 10+2 or equivalent certificate
  • Punjabi qualification proof
  • Domicile certificate (for female candidates applying under General category)
  • Category certificate (SC/BC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen, etc.)
  • NOC (for serving government employees)
  • Photo identity proof (Aadhaar, Driving License, PAN, Voter ID, or Passport)

Note: Candidates unable to produce original documents will not be considered for selection.

SECL Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026

SECL Apprentice eligibility criteria include age limit, educational qualification and other conditions. All conditions must be fulfilled as on 31.03.2026.

Age Limit & Relaxation 2026

Particulars Details
Minimum Age 18 years (must be completed as on 31.03.2026)

Note: The SECL Apprentice 2026 notification does not provide any age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen or any other category. Only the minimum age requirement of 18 years as on the last date of application (31 March 2026) must be met. Candidates failing to satisfy the minimum age criterion will be ineligible.

SECL Apprentice Educational Qualification 2026

Educational and professional qualifications for SECL Apprenticeship 2026 are stream-specific and must be from Government-recognised institutions in full-time regular mode only.

  • Graduate Apprentices: 4-year B.E./B.Tech / B.Sc. / B.Com / BBA / BCA in relevant discipline.
  • Technician Apprentices: 3-year Diploma in relevant engineering branch (after 10th or 2 years after 12th with lateral entry allowed; 1-year Diploma not permitted).

Candidates must be registered on NATS 2.0 portal and should not have undergone apprenticeship training earlier or completed one-year employment/service.

SECL Apprentice Selection Process 2026

The SECL Apprentice Selection Process 2026 is purely merit-based:

  • Shortlisting on the basis of Date of Passing (earlier passing gets higher rank)
  • Tie-breaker: Percentage of marks in Degree/Diploma → 12th/10th marks → Date of Birth
  • Two separate seniority lists: Level-1 (Chhattisgarh & Madhya Pradesh) and Level-2 (other states)
  • Document Verification + Medical Fitness Examination (as per Mines Rules 1955 / Apprenticeship Rules 1992)

SECL Apprentice Stipend 2026

Selected candidates will receive the following monthly stipend as per Rule 11(2) of Apprenticeship Rules 1992:

  • Graduate Apprentices: ₹12,300 per month
  • Technician Apprentices: ₹10,900 per month

50% stipend paid by SECL and 50% by Government through DBT in Aadhaar-linked bank account.

How to Apply for SECL Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply for SECL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 by following the steps given below.

  1. First register on NATS 2.0 portal at https://nats.education.gov.in
  2. Visit official SECL website www.secl-cil.in → HRD → Apprentice section and click on the online application link
  3. Complete SECL registration using your NATS-registered email ID
  4. Login and fill all mandatory details in the application form (Basic Information, Educational Details, Photograph & Signature, Bank Details)
  5. Upload required documents (SSC/HSC certificates, Degree/Diploma marksheets & certificates, NATS registration document, Aadhaar, etc.)
  6. Verify all details and click Final Submit before 31.03.2026 (12:00 Midnight)
  7. Take printout of the submitted application for future reference

Important Instructions

  • Only candidates registered on NATS 2.0 portal are eligible to apply
  • Applications sent by post, email or any other mode will not be accepted
  • No change in any data filled in the application form will be entertained after submission
  • Selected candidates will NOT be absorbed in any regular employment in SECL
  • No TA/DA or accommodation will be provided for document verification or training
  • Medical fitness certificate must be issued after the date of this notification
  • OBC certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 only will be accepted
  • SECL reserves the right to increase/decrease seats or cancel the entire process without notice
  • All announcements will be made only on the official SECL website; candidates are advised to visit regularly

Eligibility Criteria

  • Disc Code 101 – Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 102 – Technician Apprentice (Electrical): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 103 – Technician Apprentice (Instrumentation): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 104 – Technician Apprentice (Civil): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Civil Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 105 – Technician Apprentice (Electrical & Electronics): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 106 – Technician Apprentice (Electronics): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 107 – Trade Apprentice (Fitter): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Fitter) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 108 – Trade Apprentice (Electrician): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Electrician) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 109 – Trade Apprentice (Electronics Mechanic): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Electronics Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 110 – Trade Apprentice (Instrument Mechanic): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Instrument Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 111 – Trade Apprentice (Machinist): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Machinist) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 112 – Graduate Apprentice (BA/B.Com/B.Sc/BBA): Regular full-time Graduate in any discipline with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 113 – Trade Apprentice – Data Entry Operator (Fresher): Class 12th (but below graduate) with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/Board.
  • Disc Code 114 – Trade Apprentice – Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Class 12th (but below graduate) plus Skill Certificate of 'Domestic Data Entry Operator' for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.
  • Qualification must be from a recognized University/Institute as a full-time regular course. Qualifications acquired through Part-time / Correspondence / Distance Learning mode are NOT ELIGIBLE.
  • For Graduate and Technician disciplines, qualification must be acquired between 01.04.2022 and 28.02.2026.
  • For Trade Apprentices (ITI/Data Entry Operator), qualification must be acquired between 01.04.2021 and 28.02.2026.
  • Candidates possessing higher qualifications such as B.E./B.Tech., MBA, MCA, CA, ICWA, LLB or equivalent are NOT ELIGIBLE.
  • Diploma holders under lateral entry scheme (Class XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year) are also eligible subject to prescribed percentage in aggregate of all semesters.
  • A candidate may undergo a maximum of two apprenticeship trainings, and the second training shall not be in the same trade.

Salary / Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973 and Apprentices Rules 1992/2019/2025 as amended from time to time.
  • The exact stipend amount is not specified in the notification; candidates are advised to refer to the latest Apprentices Rules for updated stipend rates.

  • Minimum Age: 18 Years
  • Maximum Age: 24 Years
  • SC/ST candidates: Age relaxation of 5 years (maximum up to 29 years)
  • OBC-NCL candidates: Age relaxation of 3 years (maximum up to 27 years)
  • PwBD candidates: Age relaxation of up to 10 years (up to 15 years for SC/ST PwBD; up to 13 years for OBC-NCL PwBD)
  • Cutoff/Reckoning date for age criteria: 28.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates must register successfully on NAPS/NATS portal and apply against the notification to be considered for the selection process.
  • There will be no written test or interview.
  • A merit list will be prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential prescribed qualification for the respective post.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification.
  • Shortlisted candidates must complete a Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test and be adjudged medically fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical format.
  • Candidates whose documents and Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Certificate are found in order shall be issued an Offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training.
  • Opportunities not filled through the initial shortlisting shall be filled by eligible candidates from the merit cum panel list for the same opportunity.

General Information / Instructions

  • Candidates must apply only for ONE discipline code. Applications for more than one discipline code will be summarily rejected.
  • Applicants must submit applications only against vacancies notified under the states of Western Region (Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, UT of Daman & Diu, UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli). Selection of training locations outside notified states will result in rejection.
  • Candidate profile on the portal must be 100% complete (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category, etc.).
  • The candidature of the applicant shall be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates and testimonials.
  • Any false or incorrect information furnished at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature and liability for criminal prosecution.
  • Candidates should maintain the same registered email ID and mobile number till completion of apprenticeship training.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats shall be considered subject to fulfilling standards applicable to General category candidates.
  • PwBD candidates are NOT eligible to apply for Discipline Codes 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110, 111.
  • Reservation will be applicable as per the prescribed percentage for the respective States/UT.
  • No. of seats indicated is tentative and may increase or decrease at the absolute discretion of management.
  • Upon completion of the Apprenticeship period, IOCL shall have NO obligation to offer employment, nor can an Apprentice claim the right for employment.
  • A minimum one-year gap between two apprenticeship trainings is required, provided the previous training is completed.
  • All future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on IOCL website: https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships.
  • For OBC-NCL category, candidates must submit a latest caste certificate not more than 12 months old from 28.02.2026 in the Proforma prescribed by Govt. of India.
  • Canvassing of any kind shall disqualify the candidate.

How to Apply

  • Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria must apply online only through the NAPS/NATS Portal.
  • For Trade Apprentice (ITI/Data Entry Operator): Register at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/ (NAPS)
  • For Technician Apprentice (Diploma) and Graduate Apprentice: Register at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php (NATS)
  • After registration, login to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using your User ID/Email ID and APPLY for apprenticeship openings using the following Establishment IDs of IOCL (Marketing Division) – Western Region:
    • NATS Establishment ID: WMHMCC000053
    • NAPS Establishment ID: E01172700332
  • Application window: 11.03.2026 (10:00 AM) to 26.03.2026 (5:00 PM).
  • No other means or mode of application will be accepted.
  • Ensure your profile is 100% complete with Personal Details, Educational Details, and Category before applying.
  • Before applying, keep ready: PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account details with Cheque Book (name printed), and scanned copies of Educational Qualification Certificates.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well in advance before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.
  • Candidates registered with Local/State Employment Exchange(s) / Vocational Rehabilitation Centre for PwBD and meeting prescribed eligibility criteria must apply through NAPS/NATS Portal.

KRCL Trainee Apprentices Recruitment 2026

KRCL Trainee Apprentices Selection Process

Selection will be based on:

  1. Merit List: Aggregate percentage of all semesters/years (no rounding, no weightage per semester).
  2. Tie-Breaker: Older age, then earlier matriculation exam pass date.
  3. Shortlisting: 3 times the vacancies called for first round of Document Verification (DV); more if needed.
  4. Final medical fitness by KRCL.

No written exam or interview. Candidature cancelled if discrepancies found.

  • Graduate Apprentices: ₹9,000 per month (₹4,500 Govt share via DBT + ₹4,500 KRCL share).

  • No lodging/boarding provided; candidates arrange own.

SMC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Mechanical / Automobile Engineer: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical or Automobile Engineering from a recognised university, plus basic computer knowledge and Gujarati/Hindi proficiency.

Note: For post-wise qualifications, please refer to the official notification. We have provided the qualifications for only some of the posts.

SMC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

  • For Surat Municipal Corporation Recruitment 2025-26, the upper age limit is generally 35 years for most posts and 45 years for some higher posts, with relaxations as per Gujarat government rules.
  • Most technical/specialist posts (Engineers, Food Safety Officer, X‑Ray Technician, etc.): maximum 35 years; age relaxable for reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC, etc.) as per applicable rules.
  • Certain senior Town Planning/Planning Officer posts: maximum 45 years, with similar category-wise relaxations.
  • For existing Surat Municipal Corporation employees, the upper age limit condition is not applied in some cadres, as specifically mentioned in the notification.

SMC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

  • For General / OBC (Creamy Layer) candidates, the application fee is ₹500 per application.
  • For OBC (Non‑Creamy Layer) / SC / ST candidates, the application fee is ₹250.
  • PwD (Persons with Disabilities / Divyang) candidates are exempted from payment of any application fee.

  • Interview (for selected cadres): Certain higher or specialist posts may also have an interview/viva‑voce round in addition to the written test, as decided by the corporation.
  • Preparation of merit list and waiting list: A merit list (and waiting list) is prepared based on marks obtained in the written/skill test and interview (if held), following reservation rules and post-wise weightage notified by SMC.
  • Document verification and final appointment: Shortlisted candidates are called for verification of original certificates, and appointments are issued from the approved list/waiting list subject to successful verification and medical fitness where applicable.

IDBI Bank JAM Grade O Eligibility Criteria 2026

Nationality / Citizenship

Candidate must be: a citizen of India OR a subject of Nepal/Bhutan OR a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 01 January 1962 OR a person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries, subject to a Government of India eligibility certificate where applicable.​

Educational Qualification (as on 01 March 2026)

  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a University recognized/approved by Government / Govt. bodies (AICTE, UGC, etc.).​

  • Minimum 60% marks for General/EWS/OBC and 55% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates.​

  • Only a diploma is not acceptable; candidates must possess a full degree.​

  • Candidate must have valid semester-wise or consolidated mark sheets and degree/provisional degree certificate dated on or before 01 March 2026.​

  • Candidates are expected to have proficiency in computers/IT.​

Age Limit 2026 (as on 01 March 2026)

  • Minimum age: 20 years.​

  • Maximum age: 25 years.​

  • Candidate must have been born not earlier than 02 March 2001 and not later than 01 March 2006 (both dates inclusive).​

Age Relaxation 2026

  • SC/ST: up to 5 years.​

  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): up to 3 years.​

  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): up to 10 years.​

  • Ex-Servicemen / ECOs / SSCOs with at least 5 years military service and released on eligible terms: up to 5 years.​

  • Persons affected by 1984 riots: up to 5 years.​

Language Proficiency & Domicile

  • Candidate must be proficient (reading, writing and understanding) in at least one of the languages specified for the chosen zone.​

  • Candidate must furnish a valid self-domicile certificate for the state of the applied zone or Class X/XII mark sheet/certificate showing knowledge of the indicated language.

 Age Limit

  • Minimum Age Limit: 20 Years
  • Maximum Age limit: 25 Years
  • Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

IDBI Bank JAM Grade O Salary 2026

  • On joining as Grade “O”, the compensation on Cost to Company (CTC) basis is expected to range between ₹6.14 lakh to ₹6.50 lakh per annum (for Class A cities) at the time of joining.
  • Selected candidates will be covered under IDBI Bank Ltd. New Pension Scheme (IBLNPS) rules, 2011, as amended from time to time.
  • Career progression: Grade “O” officers may be considered for promotion to Grade “A” after completion of 3 years of service, subject to performance, vacancies and applicable promotion policy.

IDBI Bank JAM Grade O Apply Online 2026

Step-by-step Application Process

  1. Visit the IDBI Bank careers page: https://www.idbi.bank.in/idbi-bank-careers-current-openings.aspx.
  2. Click on “Recruitment of Junior Assistant Manager (JAM) Grade 'O' – Regional: 2026–27” and then select “Apply Online”.
  3. Click on “Click here for New Registration”, enter basic details (name, contact, email) and obtain Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  4. Log in with the registration details and fill the online application form with personal, educational, category and zone choice details (only one zone can be selected).
  5. Upload scanned copies of:
    • Recent passport-size photograph
    • Signature
    • Left thumb impression
    • Handwritten declaration (as per prescribed text)
  6. Verify all details using the “Save & Next” and “Preview” options, then click “Complete Registration”. No changes are allowed after final submission.
  7. Pay the application fee/intimation charges online using Debit/Credit Card, Internet Banking, UPI or wallets.
  8. On successful transaction, download/print the e-receipt and final submitted application form for future reference.

Important: Candidates must apply only through online mode within the specified dates and should ensure they meet all eligibility criteria before paying the fee, as fee once paid will not be refunded.

  • Disc Code 110 – Trade Apprentice (Instrument Mechanic): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Instrument Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 111 – Trade Apprentice (Machinist): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Machinist) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 112 – Graduate Apprentice (BA/B.Com/B.Sc/BBA): Regular full-time Graduate in any discipline with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.

General Information / Instructions

  • Candidates must apply only for ONE discipline code. Applications for more than one discipline code will be summarily rejected.

  • Any false or incorrect information furnished at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature and liability for criminal prosecution.
  • Candidates should maintain the same registered email ID and mobile number till completion of apprenticeship training.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats shall be considered subject to fulfilling standards applicable to General category candidates.
  • PwBD candidates are NOT eligible to apply for Discipline Codes 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110, 111.
  • Reservation will be applicable as per the prescribed percentage for the respective States/UT.
  • No. of seats indicated is tentative and may increase or decrease at the absolute discretion of management.
  • Upon completion of the Apprenticeship period, IOCL shall have NO obligation to offer employment, nor can an Apprentice claim the right for employment.
  • A minimum one-year gap between two apprenticeship trainings is required, provided the previous training is completed.
  • All future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on IOCL website: https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships.
  • For OBC-NCL category, candidates must submit a latest caste certificate not more than 12 months old from 28.02.2026 in the Proforma prescribed by Govt. of India.
  • Canvassing of any kind shall disqualify the candidate.

MECON Limited Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

Junior Engineer (Mechanical):

  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering. Minimum 16 years post-qualification experience in construction/supervision of projects in Hydrocarbon industry (process plants, pipelines, refinery, LPG plant, depots, compressor/pumping stations etc.).
  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering & NDT Level-2 Certification. Minimum 16 years post-qualification experience in construction/supervision of projects in Hydrocarbon industry.

Junior Engineer (Civil)

  • Diploma in Civil Engineering. Minimum 16 years post-qualification experience in design/site supervision for building construction/industrial projects.
  • Diploma in Civil Engineering. Minimum 16 years post-qualification experience in construction/supervision of industrial projects, preferably in Hydrocarbon industry.

Junior Engineer (Electrical)

  • Diploma in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engineering (or combination where Electrical is one branch). Minimum 16 years post-qualification experience in design/construction of electrical works for building/infrastructure/industrial projects.

Junior Officer (HR)

  • BBA / Graduate in any discipline. Minimum 16 years post-qualification experience in the entire gamut of HR.

Junior Officer (Admin.)

  • BBA / Graduate in any discipline. Minimum 16 years post-qualification experience in administrative work.

Age Limit (as on 02.02.2026)

Post Codes Grade Upper Age Limit Pay Scale
01 to 07 E-0 50 years (before relaxations and additional experience-based relaxation) Rs. 30,000–3%–1,20,000/- (IDA)

Upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL), and by 10/13/15 years for PwD (UR/OBC/SC-ST) as per Government of India guidelines. Candidates domiciled in J&K during 01.01.1980–31.12.1989, Ex-Servicemen and other categories receive relaxation as per rules, subject to a maximum age not exceeding 52 years on the cut-off date.

Additionally, 1 year of age relaxation is provided for every 1 year of additional relevant experience, limited to a maximum of 3 years, within the overall upper age cap of 52 years.

Work Experience Definition

Only full-time, regular salary-based work in relevant areas will be considered towards the required 16 years of post-qualification experience. Freelance, entrepreneurial, teaching, research, articleship/internship (other than certain PSU training and apprenticeship as specified) will not be counted.

MECON reserves the right to change the mode of selection if required, raise minimum eligibility standards, and increase/decrease or cancel vacancies at its discretion. Eligibility Criteria

  • Minimum Educational Qualification: Candidates must have passed the 10th class examination or its equivalent with a minimum of 50% (aggregate) marks from recognized Boards, as on the date of issue of Notification.
  • Technical Qualification: Candidates must also possess a National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the designated trade in which this administration is imparting training, issued by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT). Mere completion of a course is not sufficient.
  • Note: Candidates who are awaiting results pertaining to ITI/NTC as on the date of this Notification are NOT eligible to apply. Candidates who have failed in ITI/NTC should not apply.
  • Higher Qualification: Engineering Graduates and Diploma Holders are NOT ELIGIBLE to apply for undergoing Apprenticeship Training in response to this Notification, as they are governed by a separate scheme of Apprenticeship.
  • Employment Exchange Registration (Mandatory): The candidates who have registered their names with the local Employment Exchanges are only eligible to apply. The registration should be current and valid as on the date of issue of this Notification. Preference will be given to those candidates who have registered in Employment Exchanges within the jurisdiction of State of Karnataka.
  • Wards of Serving Railway Employees: Wards of Serving Railway employees all over the Indian Railways are also eligible to apply. Serving Railway employees should ensure that the applications of their wards are sent through their respective Controlling Officials in the prescribed proforma as per Annexure-D. Registration of names of their wards with Employment Exchanges is not necessary for this category.
  • Only full-time regular courses will be considered. All minimum essential qualifications must be from recognized Boards / NCVT.

Stipend / Salary

  • Fitter, Machinist, Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), Turner, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic: Stipend of ₹12,261/- per month during the period of apprenticeship training.
  • CNC Programming cum-Operator (COE Group): Stipend of ₹10,899/- per month during the period of apprenticeship training.
  • Stipend rates are as per extant rules amended from time to time.
  • Note: As per the Act, it is not obligatory on the part of the Railways to offer any employment to the Apprentices on completion of their Apprenticeship training. The Act Apprentices imparted training in Railway establishments will have no claim to seek employment on Railways on the basis of such training.

Age Limit (as on 01-03-2026)

  • The candidate should have completed 15 years of age and should not have completed 24 years of age as on 01.03.2026 (i.e. date of issue of Notification).
  • Age Relaxation:
    • SC / ST candidates: Upper age limit relaxable by 5 years
    • OBC candidates: Upper age limit relaxable by 3 years
    • Age relaxation as per extant instructions of Railway Board and as amended from time to time.
  • Candidates who want to avail the benefit of reservation of SC/ST must produce his/her caste certificate on Govt. of India format issued by appropriate authority as per Annexure-B.
  • Candidates who want to avail the benefit of reservation of OBC must produce caste certificate and Non-Creamy Layer Certificate issued on or after 01.07.2025 on Govt. of India format as per Annexure-C.

Application Fee

  • Application Fee: ₹100/- (One Hundred only) as processing fee in the form of an Indian Postal Order (IPO) / Demand Draft from any Nationalised Bank, drawn in favour of 'Principal Financial Adviser / Rail Wheel Factory'.
  • Exempted Categories: No fee is required to be paid by SC / ST / Physically Handicapped / Women candidates.
  • Applications not accompanied with the processing fee, wherever required, will be summarily rejected.
  • The IPO/DD instruments should not have been issued earlier to the date of issue of this Notification (28.02.2026).
  • The processing fee is non-refundable.

Training Period

  • Fitter, Machinist, Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), Turner, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic: Training period is One Year.
  • CNC Programming cum-Operator (COE Group): Training period is Six Months.
  • Training will be arranged in accordance with the standards and syllabus prescribed by the Central Apprenticeship Council.
