Selection Process

  • The selection of candidates will be made on the basis of merit list prepared based on the percentage of marks obtained by the candidate in 10th Std / Matriculation or its equivalent with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks.
  • For the purpose of calculation of percentage of marks in 10th Std, marks obtained by the candidates in all the subjects as indicated in the said marks sheet will be reckoned and not on the basis of marks of any subject or a group of subjects.
  • Tie-breaking Rule: In case of two candidates having the same marks, the candidate with older age shall be preferred. In case dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed the 10th Std / Matriculation or its equivalent examination earlier shall be considered first.
  • A final merit list would be prepared equal to the number of designated trades proposed to be filled up, duly ensuring reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PH/Ex-Servicemen candidates, in descending order of percentage of marks obtained.
  • Candidates finally enlisted to undergo training would be subjected to verification of original testimonials.
  • Medical Fitness: Candidates must satisfy minimum standards of physical fitness as prescribed in the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 as amended from time to time. The selected candidates will have to submit a prescribed medical examination certificate in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-E) before their engagement. Physical fitness will be certified by a government authorized Doctor (Gazetted) not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon of Central/State Hospital.

General Information / Instructions

  • Rail Wheel Factory Administration is the nodal agency for processing of applications from candidates and preparation of their merit list.
  • Before commencement of the Apprenticeship training, selected candidates have to execute a Contract of Apprenticeship with the Employer. If the candidate is a Minor, then his/her guardian has to enter into a contract of Apprenticeship with the Employer.
  • Selected candidates are required to register the contract of Apprenticeship in online mode at the Apprenticeship portal: https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/candidate-login. Candidates are advised to register at the earliest without waiting for the final select list to be published.
  • On completion of training, the candidate, on passing a test to be conducted by NCVT in Vocational Trades, will be given a certificate of proficiency in the trade by the National Council.
  • Candidates should ensure that their Name, Father's/Mother's name/Guardian's name and Date of Birth in the application form exactly match as recorded in their Matriculation or equivalent certificates and other certificates including Aadhaar certificates. Any deviation found during document verification will lead to cancellation of candidature and debarment from undergoing training.
  • Reservation and age relaxation for various categories/communities is as per the Govt. of India Rules for the purpose and as revised by the Railway Board from time to time.
  • Candidates employed in Government / Quasi-Government / PSU should send their application through proper channel.
  • Candidates will have no claim to seek employment on Railways on the basis of such training as per the Apprentices Act, 1961.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • No Hostel facility will be provided. The selected candidates should make their own arrangements for their stay during their period of training.
  • The candidates attending the office for verification of documents will not be paid any TA/DA.
  • The caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC) should be in the form notified by the Government of India. If the caste certified by the candidate does not appear in the Central Gazette, then he/she will be treated as belonging to 'UR' community.
  • The applicant should submit only one application form. Multiple applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates are required to furnish the correct and complete postal address with Pin Code in their application.
  • The list of selected candidates will be displayed at https://rwf.indianrailways.gov.in. Important messages will be sent by SMS/E-mail.
  • Help Desk: For any queries related to the submission of applications, candidates can call on 080-28072616 from 09:00 hrs. to 16:50 hrs. (Monday to Friday) on all working days and from 09:00 hrs. to 12:20 hrs. on Saturday (except Sundays and Holidays).

Documents Required (Self-Attested Photocopies)

  • 10th Std / Matriculation or its equivalent marks certificate with at least 50% marks, with Date of Birth as proof of age.
  • National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the designated trade issued by NCVT.
  • Copy of caste certificate (SC/ST candidates in proforma Annexure-B and OBC candidates in proforma Annexure-C).
  • Physically Handicapped / Disability certificate duly issued by the competent medical board.
  • Two identical passport size photographs duly self-attested and firmly stitched in a separate cover to the application form (apart from one copy pasted on the application form).
  • Discharge certificate / serving certificate for wards of Ex-Servicemen / serving Railway employee.
  • Employment Registration card, registered in Employment Exchanges within the State of Karnataka (for Karnataka candidates) or respective local employment exchanges (for other state candidates), with renewal being current.
  • Wards of serving Railway employees should produce a certificate issued by the respective controlling officers in proforma Annexure-D.
  • IPO / Demand Draft of ₹100/- as processing fee (where applicable).

How to Apply

  • Download the Application Form (Annexure-A) and all other Annexures (B, C, D & E) from the official website of Rail Wheel Factory: https://rwf.indianrailways.gov.in. No other format shall be entertained.
  • Fill the application form carefully. Ensure that Name, Father's/Mother's/Guardian's name and Date of Birth exactly match as recorded in Matriculation and other certificates. Any deviation will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Affix a recent colour passport size photograph duly signed/attested by the candidate on the application form.
  • Enclose all required self-attested documents including 10th marks sheet, NTC, caste certificate, Employment Exchange registration card, photographs and IPO/DD as applicable.
  • Fill and sign the checklist in Annexure-F. Applications submitted without duly filled in checklist and signed by the candidate will not be considered.
  • The application (Annexure-A) can either be dropped in the sealed Drop Box kept in the Office of the Principal Chief Personnel Officer, Personnel Department, Rail Wheel Factory, Yelahanka, Bangalore-560064 on all working days (Monday to Friday: 09:00 hrs to 16:50 hrs; Saturday: 09:00 hrs to 12:20 hrs).
  • Alternatively, the application can be sent by REGISTERED POST ONLY to the below address, superscribing on the cover as "Application for undergoing training under the Apprentices' Act, 1961 for the year 2025-26 in Rail Wheel Factory":
    The Senior Personnel Officer-II, Personnel Department, Rail Wheel Factory, Yelahanka, Bangalore – 560 064.
  • Applications should be submitted to this office before 17:00 hrs. of the closing date i.e., 01.04.2026. Applications received after the closing date will not be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Candidates are advised to submit applications well in advance before the closing date to avoid last minute rush.

Eligibility Criteria – FCRI Walk-In Interview 2026

1) Trainee Graduate Engineers (Level‑1 & Level‑2) – Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Instrumentation

  • Educational Qualification​

    • Full‑time degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant discipline (Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Instrumentation / Electrical Sciences).

      • Less than 1 year experience in relevant areas, including candidates with at least 2 months of relevant internship / practical exposure.

  • Educational Qualification​

  • Experience​

    • Level‑1:

      • Freshers or candidates with less than 1 year experience in relevant trade areas (shop floor, fabrication, installation/maintenance, troubleshooting, etc.).

    • Level‑2:

      • Minimum 1 year experience in relevant trade areas as described (workshop/machining, plumbing & piping systems, electrical fault rectification, AC & refrigeration systems, etc.).

Eligibility Criteria

  • Executive Assistant: Degree in any discipline from a recognized University. Higher Grade Certificate in Typewriting (English) KGTE or equivalent. Lower Grade Certificate in Typewriting (Malayalam) KGTE or equivalent.Lower Grade Certificate in Short Hand (English) KGTE or equivalent.Lower Grade Certificate in Short Hand (Malayalam) KGTE or equivalent.

  • Assistant Gr.II/Junior Assistant: Must have 3 (three) years regular service in any cadre in the Member society affiliated to The Kerala State Co-operative Federation For Fisheries Development Limited and should be in service of the Member society not only on the date of application but also on the date of appointment to the new post. Degree of a recognized University with JDC/HDC OR B.Com with Co-operation. OR B.Sc (Co-operation and Banking) from Kerala Agricultural University.
  • Peon/Watchman: Pass in Standard VI (New) or equivalent.

 Age Limit

  • Minimum Age Limit: 18 Years
  • Maximum Age limit: 50 Years
  • Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is required.

Important Dates

  • Last Date for Apply Online: 01-04-2026

Salary

  • Executive Assistant: Rs 37,400 – 79,000/-
  • I Grade Overseer / I Grade Draftsman (Civil): Rs 37,400 – 79,000/-
  • Assistant Gr.II/Junior Assistant: Rs 26,500 - 60,700/-
  • Peon/Watchman: Rs 24,500 – 42,900/-

How to Apply

Candidates must register as per 'ONE TIME REGISTRATION ' with the Official Website of Kerala Public Service Commission 'www.keralapsc.gov.in' before applying for the post. Candidates who have registered can apply by logging on to their profile using their User-ID and password. Candidates must click on the 'Apply Now' button of the respective posts in the Notification Link to apply for a post.

Candidates who create new Profile should upload their Photograph taken within a period of 6 months. Name of the candidate and the date of photograph taken should be printed legibly at the bottom portion. The photograph once uploaded meeting all requirements shall be valid for 10 years from the date of uploading. .

There is no change in other instructions regarding the uploading of photographs. No application fee is required. Candidates are responsible for the correctness of the personal information and secrecy of password. Before the final submission of the application on the profile candidates must ensure correctness of the information in their profile. They must quote the User-ID for further communication with the Commission. Application submitted is provisional and cannot be deleted or altered after submission. Candidates are advised to keep a printout or soft copy of the online application for future reference.

Candidates can take the printout of the application by clicking on the link 'My applications' in their profile. All correspondences with the Commission, regarding the application should be accompanied with the printout of the application. The application will be summarily rejected if noncompliance with the notification is found in due course of processing. Documents to prove qualification, age, Community etc. have to be produced as and when called for.

Candidates who have AADHAAR card should add AADHAAR Card as ID Proof in their profile.

Last date for receipt of applications: 01.04.2026 Wednesday up to 12 midnight

Selection Process

  • Written / OMR / Online Test

General Information/Instructions

  • Direct Recruitment from Part-Time employees in KSFE Limited.
  • Ranked List valid until candidates advised against NCA vacancies.
  • Second NCA Notification due to paucity of candidates.
  • Advice cancellation if mistake found.
  • Termination within probation or 240 days if advice cancelled.

Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC) under Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), Department of Space, Government of India has released the VSSC Authorised Medical Officer & Dermatologist Recruitment 2026 notification for contract-based positions of Authorised Medical Officer (Allopathy) at Parassala, Authorised Medical Officer (Homeopathy) at Nemom, and Dermatologist in Thiruvananthapuram.
 
Candidates must possess MBBS with permanent Medical Council Registration for Allopathy, BHMS with Registration in the Council of Indian Systems of Medicine for Homeopathy, and MD/DNB Dermatology or PG Diploma in Dermatology with additional qualification registration for the Dermatologist post, along with minimum two years of relevant experience after registration/graduation and their own well-equipped consultation room with good facilities at the specified locations (Parassala / Nemom / Thiruvananthapuram city). Preference will be given to doctors below 70 years of age.
 
All these latest ISRO doctor jobs on contract basis are offered initially for 6 months (extendable with mutual consent) with attractive remuneration ranging from ₹12,000–₹54,000 per month for Authorised Medical Officer (Allopathy) based on files assigned, fixed ₹12,500 per month for Homeopathy Medical Officer, and ₹400 per consultation for Dermatologist, making this one of the attractive government medical positions for experienced doctors looking for opportunities in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.

VSSC ISRO Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Post Name Location Nature
Authorised Medical Officer (Allopathy) Parassala, Thiruvananthapuram Contract
Authorised Medical Officer (Homeopathy) Nemom, Thiruvananthapuram Contract
Dermatologist Thiruvananthapuram City Contract

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications – Authorised Medical Officer (Allopathy) at Parassala, Thiruvananthapuram:
    • MBBS with permanent Medical Council Registration.
    • Minimum two years of experience after permanent registration with Medical Council.
    • Should have a consultation room with good facilities at Parassala.
  • Qualifications – Authorised Medical Officer (Homeopathy) at Nemom, Thiruvananthapuram:
    • BHMS with Registration in The Council of Indian Systems of Medicine.
    • Minimum two years of experience after graduation and Registration with the Medical Council.
    • Should have own consultation room with good facilities in Nemom.
  • Qualifications – Dermatologist (Thiruvananthapuram City):
    • MBBS with permanent Medical Council Registration; AND
    • MD/DNB Dermatology; OR PG Diploma in Dermatology with registration of additional qualification in Medical Council.
    • Minimum two years of experience after completion of PG Degree/Diploma in Dermatology.
    • Should have a consultation room with good facilities in Thiruvananthapuram city.
  • Age: Preference will be given to doctors below 70 years for all the above posts.
  • Desirable (Dermatologist): In case of selection, applicants may provide exclusive parking space at the location for beneficiaries visiting the clinic.
  • Only Indian Nationals need apply.
  • The consultation room should be ready for inspection on or immediately after the date of personal interview.

Salary / Stipend

  • Authorised Medical Officer (Allopathy): ₹12,000/- to ₹54,000/- per month, based on the number of files assigned.
  • Authorised Medical Officer (Homeopathy): Fixed amount of ₹12,500/- per month.
  • Dermatologist: ₹400/- per consultation.
  • All positions are on Contract Basis initially for 6 months, extendable with mutual consent.
  • Selection does not warrant any claim for regular employment in VSSC or any other Centres of ISRO/Department of Space.

Age Limit 

  • No specific minimum or maximum age limit is mentioned in the notification.
  • Preference will be given to doctors below 70 years of age for all the above posts.

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Date 17-03-2026
Last Date for Submission of Application (via Email) 31-03-2026
Interview Date To be intimated to shortlisted candidates via email/phone

Selection Process

  • Step 1 – Shortlisting: Applications received will be screened and only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Shortlisted candidates will receive intimation about the details of the interview through email/phone.
  • Step 2 – Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend a Personal Interview in person along with Bio-data form (in prescribed format downloaded from www.vssc.gov.in), original certificates proving educational qualification, age, experience, registration etc., along with any other relevant information.
  • Step 3 – Inspection of Consultation Room: The consultation room of the candidate will be inspected on or immediately after the date of personal interview. Only candidates with a consultation room with good facilities at the required location will be considered.
  • Candidates should enclose self-attested true copies of the relevant certificates/testimonials along with the application and submit the same on the date of interview.
  • Candidates possessing the advertised qualification, skill, and experience alone will be allowed to attend the interview.

General Information / Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals need apply.
  • Candidates should appear for the interview in person along with the Bio-data form (in prescribed format), original certificates proving educational qualification, age, experience, registration etc.
  • Candidates are advised to make their own arrangements for stay at their own cost, if required.
  • Selection does not warrant any claim for regular employment in VSSC or any other Centres of ISRO/Department of Space.
  • The Centre reserves the right to terminate the appointment at any time before completion of the tenure if it so decides.
  • The Centre reserves the right not to fill up the positions, if it so decides.
  • No interim correspondence will be entertained.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • Government strives to have a workforce which reflects gender balance and women candidates are encouraged to apply.

How to Apply

  • Download the application form from the official website: www.vssc.gov.in.
  • Fill in the prescribed application/Bio-data form duly and completely.
  • Submit the filled application form along with scanned copies of educational qualification/registration certificates and experience certificates via email to: [email protected].
  • Email Subject Line must be: 'Application to the position of AMO (Allopathy) / AMO (Homeopathy) / Dermatologist on contract' (as applicable to the post applied for).
  • Applications must be submitted on or before 31-03-2026.
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Shortlisted candidates will receive information about interview date, time and venue through email/phone.
  • On the day of interview, candidates must bring the Bio-data form, original certificates of educational qualification, age, experience, registration etc., and self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents.

SECL Apprentice eligibility criteria include age limit, educational qualification and other conditions. All conditions must be fulfilled as on 31.03.2026.

Only the minimum age requirement of 18 years as on the last date of application (31 March 2026) must be met. Candidates failing to satisfy the minimum age criterion will be ineligible.

SECL Apprentice Educational Qualification 2026

Educational and professional qualifications for SECL Apprenticeship 2026 are stream-specific and must be from Government-recognised institutions in full-time regular mode only.

  • Graduate Apprentices: 4-year B.E./B.Tech / B.Sc. / B.Com / BBA / BCA in relevant discipline.
  • Technician Apprentices: 3-year Diploma in relevant engineering branch (after 10th or 2 years after 12th with lateral entry allowed; 1-year Diploma not permitted).

Candidates must be registered on NATS 2.0 portal and should not have undergone apprenticeship training earlier or completed one-year employment/service.

SECL Apprentice Selection Process 2026

The SECL Apprentice Selection Process 2026 is purely merit-based:

  • Shortlisting on the basis of Date of Passing (earlier passing gets higher rank)
  • Tie-breaker: Percentage of marks in Degree/Diploma → 12th/10th marks → Date of Birth
  • Two separate seniority lists: Level-1 (Chhattisgarh & Madhya Pradesh) and Level-2 (other states)

50% stipend paid by SECL and 50% by Government through DBT in Aadhaar-linked bank account.

  6. Verify all details and click Final Submit before 31.03.2026 (12:00 Midnight)
  7. Take printout of the submitted application for future reference

  • Applications sent by post, email or any other mode will not be accepted
  • No change in any data filled in the application form will be entertained after submission
  • Selected candidates will NOT be absorbed in any regular employment in SECL
  • No TA/DA or accommodation will be provided for document verification or training
  • Medical fitness certificate must be issued after the date of this notification
  • OBC certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 only will be accepted
  • SECL reserves the right to increase/decrease seats or cancel the entire process without notice
  • All announcements will be made only on the official SECL website; candidates are advised to visit regularly

Eligibility Criteria

  • Disc Code 101 – Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 102 – Technician Apprentice (Electrical): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 103 – Technician Apprentice (Instrumentation): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 104 – Technician Apprentice (Civil): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Civil Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 105 – Technician Apprentice (Electrical & Electronics): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 106 – Technician Apprentice (Electronics): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 107 – Trade Apprentice (Fitter): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Fitter) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.

Eligibility Criteria for MPESB Group-5 Paramedical 2026

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must have passed the Higher Secondary (10+2) examination with Biology, Chemistry, and Physics from a recognized board. In addition, candidates must hold a relevant Diploma/Degree/Certificate in the concerned subject from a recognized institution, along with a valid registration with the Madhya Pradesh Para-Medical Council (MP Sah-Chikitsiya Parishad). The exact minimum educational qualification varies post-wise as specified in Chapter-2 of the official notification. Some examples are as follows:

  • Staff Nurse: 10+2 with Biology group + 3-year General Nursing programme OR 4-year GNM Diploma from a recognized institution + registration with a recognized Nursing Council.
  • Pharmacist Grade-2: 10+2 with Biology group + Degree/Diploma in Pharmacy + registration with MP Pharmacy Council.
  • Dental Technician: 10+2 with Biology, Chemistry & Physics + Diploma in relevant subject from a recognized institution + MP Para-Medical Council registration.
  • Ayurvedic Compounder: 10+2 (Higher Secondary) from a recognized board + 1-year Ayurvedic Compounder training from a recognized institution + registration with MP Para-Medical Council.
  • Lab Attendant / Dresser Grade-2 / Dissection Hall Attendant: 10+2 with Biology, Chemistry, and Physics.
  • Compounder (Aushadhi Sanyojak): 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology + Diploma in Pharmacy from an MP Govt.-recognized institution + Pharmacy Council registration + minimum 3 years of work experience as a Compounder.

Candidates must possess the required qualification as on the date of application submission. Qualifications acquired after the closing date of the application will not be considered.

2. Age Limit

The age limit for MPESB Group-5 Paramedical Recruitment 2026 is:

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 40 years (General/Unreserved)
  • Maximum Age: 45 years for SC/ST/OBC/Women (Reserved & Unreserved)/PwD/Government Employees/Home Guards of Madhya Pradesh
  • Age Relaxation: As per MP Government norms for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen
  • Age Calculation Date: 01 January 2026
  • Note: In no case shall the maximum age exceed 45 years (except for contractual employees and categories mentioned in Rule 14).

3. Nationality

Candidates must be Indian citizens or citizens of Nepal as specified under MP Civil Services Recruitment Rules 1961. Candidates who are not permanent residents of Madhya Pradesh can only apply for unreserved/open category posts and will not be entitled to any reservation or age relaxation benefits.

Selection Process for MPESB Group-5 Paramedical 2026

Candidates will be selected based on the following process as specified in the official notification:

  • Online Written Examination: A single objective-type question paper of 100 marks will be conducted online. The paper consists of two sections: (a) General Knowledge, General Hindi, General English, General Mathematics, General Science & General Aptitude — 25 marks; (b) Technical/Trade-based questions — 75 marks. Duration: 2 hours per shift.
  • Negative Marking: 0.25 marks will be deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Normalisation: Results will be prepared using the Normalised Equi-Percentile (NEP) scaling technique in case the exam is held in multiple shifts.
  • Merit List: Candidates will be shortlisted based on percentile scores obtained in the written examination.
  • Document Verification: Selected candidates' documents (educational, technical, professional qualifications) will be verified by the concerned recruiting department.
  • Medical Examination: Candidates must be physically and mentally fit as per the requirements of the post.

Note: MP-ESB is responsible only for conducting the written examination and declaring its result. All subsequent appointment procedures including document verification and issuing of appointment orders will be carried out by the respective recruiting departments.

Application Fee for MPESB Group-5 Paramedical 2026

  • General/Unreserved (UR) Candidates: ₹500/- per question paper
  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD (MP Domicile only): ₹250/- per question paper

  • MP Online Portal Charge (via Registered Citizen User/Self): ₹20/-

  • Payment Mode: Online — Debit Card (Visa/Master/Maestro), Credit Card (Visa/Master), Net Banking, or via MP Online authorized Kiosk
  • Note: Fee concessions are applicable only to MP domicile candidates belonging to reserved categories. Candidates from other states will be treated as unreserved/general category.

Salary/Stipend for MPESB Group-5 Paramedical 2026

The pay scale varies post-wise as per the official notification. As per MP Government order dated 12 December 2019, during the probation period, candidates will receive a stipend — 70% of the minimum pay scale in the 1st year, 80% in the 2nd year, and 90% in the 3rd year. Full pay scale will be granted upon successful completion of the probation period. Post-wise salary details are as follows:

How to Apply for MPESB Group-5 Paramedical Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can apply online for MPESB Group-5 Paramedical 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official MP Online website: www.mponline.gov.in or the ESB website: www.esb.mp.gov.in
  2. Go to "Citizen Services" → "Application" → "ESB" link on the MP Online portal
  3. Read the official notification and examination rules carefully before proceeding
  4. Click on "Apply Online" and fill in the application form with correct and complete details
  5. Upload required documents — colour photograph (white background, taken within 3 months), signature, and self-written declaration in own handwriting
  6. Enter Aadhaar Card number / Aadhaar VID (mandatory)
  7. Select post preferences and priority order for all eligible posts
  8. Upload educational qualification mark sheets and other required certificates
  9. Pay the application fee online via Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or via an authorized MP Online Kiosk (Portal charge ₹60/- via kiosk, ₹20/- via self-login)
  10. Submit the application form and note down / save the Application Form Number for future reference (Admit Card will be issued using this number)
  11. Application corrections/modifications can be made from 13/03/2026 to 01/04/2026 by paying the prescribed modification fee

Important Notes:

  • Aadhaar registration is mandatory for all candidates.
  • Candidates must register with the Employment Office of Madhya Pradesh (Rozgar Karyalay).
  • Candidates from special Adivasi communities (Baiga, Sahariya/Sahriya, and Bhariya) must apply in hard copy directly to the concerned recruiting department — not to ESB.

Such widows even with children will be, however, eligible only if they have not remarried.

  • Garhwalis.
  • Ladakher.
  • Tribals of recognized tribal areas.

Note: Domicile and Caste certificate will be considered to determine applicability of height relaxation.

Application Fee

  • Examination Fee: Rs 250/- per application for all categories.
  • Payment Mode: Online (through the website during application).

Important Dates

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 13-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 01-04-2026
  • Online Exam Dates: 01/06/2026 to 15/06/2026 (Tentative)
  • Firm dates for online exam will be announced later on the website.

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates. Admission to the examination will be purely on the basis of Admit Card. The CEE will be conducted at designated centres tentatively between 01 Jun 2026 to 15 Jun 2026.
  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. Shortlisted candidates will attend the Recruitment Rally at designated venue where the Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical Test and Document Verification will be conducted.

Physical Fitness Test (PFT) (At Rally Site)

  • 1.6 Km Run
    • Group I: Upto 7 Min 45 Secs - Excellent
    • Group II: 7 Min 46 Sec to 8 Min 30 Sec - Good
  • Long Jump: 10 Feet (Need to qualify)
  • High Jump: 3 Feet (Need to qualify)

Note: Provisions for extra time for 1.6 Km run in hilly terrain and lower timing for Long Jump and High Jump in such cases.

Medical Standards

  • Candidates must be in good physical and mental health, free from any disability likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties.
  • Detailed medical examination as per Army standards.

Final Merit List

  • Final merit list will be based on aggregate of marks scored in CEE and performance in PFT (if applicable).
  • Recruitment is purely based on merit depending on available vacancies.

Note: Selection in the Indian Army is 'Fair & Transparent' and on merit only. At no stage any bribe is to be paid to anyone for selection or recruitment in the Indian Army. Candidates should not fall prey to unscrupulous persons posing as recruiting agents.

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official website: www.joinindianarmy.nic.in.
  2. If new user, complete the registration process by providing basic details and creating a login ID.
  3. Login using the credentials and fill the online application form carefully.
  4. Upload required documents, photographs, and signatures as per specifications.
  5. Pay the examination fee of Rs 250/- online.
  6. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

Note: Applications invited from domiciles of all districts of Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, UT of Chandigarh & Delhi. Any change in policy or details published in notification will be intimated on registered email/mobile number and with a ticker on the www.joinindianarmy.nic.in web portal.

Documents Required

Candidates must carry the following documents in original along with self-attested photocopies at the rally site (Phase II):

  • Admit Card.
  • 20 copies of passport size photographs.
  • Education Certificates (Marksheets, Degree, etc.).
  • Domicile Certificate.
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable for relaxation).
  • Religion Certificate (if required).

  • Character Certificate from Village Sarpanch/Municipal Corporation.
  • Unmarried Certificate.

  • Affidavit on Rs 10 stamp paper as per format.
  • Single Bank A/C, PAN Card & AADHAR Card.
  • Police Verification Form.
  • Certificate from serving personnel for wards of serving soldiers (if applicable).
  • Any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

Salary Structure

Agniveers will be paid a customized package with fixed yearly increment. In addition, Risk and Hardship, Ration, Dress and Travel allowances as applicable.

Date of Circular 12/02/2026

  • Applications received through proper channel only.
  • Scrutiny of applications by the concerned authority.
  • Selection on deputation/absorption basis as per eligibility.

  • Number of vacancies may increase or decrease due to administrative reasons.
  • Selected officers appointed under normal terms and conditions of Govt of India.

EIL Management Trainee Eligibility Criteria 2026

Age Limit (as on 01.07.2026)

  • General: 25 years
  • OBC (NCL): 28 years
  • SC/ST: 30 years
  • PwD (General): 35 years | PwD (OBC-NCL): 38 years | PwD (SC/ST): 40 years

  • Civil → CE

Note: Only Indian Nationals are eligible. No application fee.

GATE 2026 Requirement

Candidates must have appeared in GATE 2026 (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering) and must have cleared the exam in the relevant engineering discipline paper (CH / ME / CE / EE) as applicable for the post applied. Candidates who appeared in GATE 2024 or GATE 2025 but not in GATE 2026 are not eligible.

EIL Management Trainee Stipend & Pay

  3. Personal Interview (at Delhi/Gurugram).

  • Constable (Carpenter): 18 to 25 years
  • Constable (Nursing Orderly): 18 to 27 years

Age Relaxation

  • SC/ST: 5 years
  • OBC: 3 years
  • Ex-Servicemen: 3 years after deduction of military service rendered from actual age.
  • Departmental candidates (Central Government employees) and special categories such as J&K/Ladakh domiciles and dependents of 1984 riot victims get relaxation as per notified limits.

SSB Constable Educational Qualification 2026

Educational and professional qualifications for SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Recruitment 2026 are post-specific and must be from recognised boards/ITI/Institutes.

  • Constable (Veterinary): 10th pass with Science as main subject from a recognised board and 1 year experience in treatment of different species of animals in a recognised veterinary hospital.
  • Constable (Driver) – Male: 10th pass from a recognised board and must possess a valid Heavy Vehicle Driving Licence.
  • Constables (Gardener, Water Carrier, Cobbler, Tailor, Washerman, Barber, Waiter): Matriculation or equivalent plus either 2 years work experience in the respective trade, or 1 year certificate course from recognised ITI/Vocational institute with at least 1 year experience, or 2 years diploma from recognised ITI in the trade or similar trade; must qualify trade test; multi-skilled candidates will be given preference.
  • Constable (Carpenter): Matriculation or equivalent and either 2 years work experience in the trade, or 1 year ITI/Vocational certificate with 1 year experience, or 2 years ITI diploma in the trade; must qualify trade test.
  • Constable (Nursing Orderly): 10th pass, First Aid certificate from St. John’s Ambulance Organisation or Red Cross Society of India, and minimum 1 year working experience as Nursing Orderly in a 50-bedded hospital/institution recognised by Central/State Government.

Candidates who are appearing in examination/awaiting results or not in possession of educational/professional certificates on the last date of application need not apply.

SSB Constable Selection Process 2026

The SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Selection Process 2026 comprises multiple stages, and only those candidates who qualify each stage as per SSB norms will be considered for final appointment.

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): For Constables (Veterinary, Driver, Gardener, Water Carrier, Cobbler, Tailor, Washerman, Barber, Waiter, Carpenter & Nursing Orderly), PET consists of 4.8 km race in 24 minutes for male candidates and 2.4 km race in 18 minutes for female candidates; Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must attend other stages.
  • Physical Standard Test (PST): Candidates who qualify PET will undergo PST where height and chest (for male candidates) are measured as per category and region-wise standards; those not meeting minimum standards are rejected.
  • Written Examination: Objective-type written test as per SSB pattern for Constable posts (detailed scheme to be provided on official website/notification).
  • Trade/Skill Test: Practical trade test for Tradesman posts and driving/maintenance test for Driver post to assess hands-on skills.
  • Documentation & Medical Examination: Verification of original documents, certificates, category proofs followed by medical examination as per SSB medical standards.

SSB Constable Exam Pattern 2026

The SSB Constable written exam pattern 2026 for Tradesman, Driver and other posts will generally include questions from General Knowledge, Elementary Mathematics, Reasoning and Trade-related subjects as per SSB guidelines.

Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed exam scheme and syllabus published on the official SSB website and in the detailed recruitment notification before starting preparation.

SSB Constable Salary 2026

All SSB Constable Tradesman, Driver, Veterinary, Carpenter and Nursing Orderly posts are placed in Pay Level-3 (₹21,700–69,100) of the 7th Central Pay Commission.

In addition to basic pay, Constables are entitled to Dearness Allowance, Ration Money Allowance, House Rent Allowance and other admissible allowances, and will be covered under Defined Contributory Pension Scheme or Unified Pension Scheme as applicable for new central government entrants.

SSB Constable Application Fee 2026

  • UR, EWS and OBC category candidates will require to pay examination fee amounting to Rs. 100/- (Rupees one hundred) only (Non Refundable) through netbanking/credit card/debit card/UPI. However, SC, ST, Ex-Serviceman and female candidates are exempted from payment of examination fees.
  • The exact SSB Constable application fee 2026, payment mode and category-wise exemptions will be notified in the detailed online application instructions.
  • Applications submitted without successful online fee payment (where applicable) will be rejected, so candidates must carefully follow the payment steps on the SSB recruitment portal.

How to Apply for SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply online for SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Recruitment 2026 within 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News by following the steps given below.

  1. Visit the official SSB recruitment website and open the Constable online application link for Advertisement No. 524/RC/SSB/Combined Advt./CT to SI (Non-GD)/2025.
  2. Complete the registration using a valid email ID and mobile number, then log in and fill in personal, educational and communication details in the SSB Constable online application form.
  3. Select only one post from the available Constable posts (a candidate can apply for only one post) and upload scanned copies of photograph, signature and required documents in the prescribed format and size.
  4. Pay the application fee online, if applicable, through the available digital payment methods and submit the form; take a printout of the final submitted application for future reference.

Important Instrctions

Only eligible candidates may apply and minutely go through all the provisions & requirement in the notification to ensure that he/she is eligible for the post for which he/she is applying.Candidates should bring all original documents i.e. matriculation,technical pass certificate alongwith self attested Photostat copies of the same at the time of documentation, failing which candidature of candidate will be rejected in the documentation stage of recruitment.

Name, Father's Name & Date of Birth should be mentioned exactly as recorded in Matriculation certificate. In case of change the same must be supported by necessary documents, otherwise, the candidature will be rejected.

Candidates canvassing in any form/ bringing outside influence/pressure/ offering illegal gratification/ blackmailing/threatening to blackmail any person connected with recruitment will be disqualified. Mere qualifying all the prescribed tests in SSB recruitment does not confer the right to any candidate for final selection.

Candidates who are not in possession of certificate of minimum education qualification by closing date of receipt of applications i.e. 30 (thirty) days from the date of publication of this advertisement in the Employment News need not to apply.

Calculator, Digital Diary, Cellular Phone, pager, Whiteners, blade etc. are prohibited in the recruitment venue.The candidates will not be considered for recruitment if involved convicted/arrested in any criminal case under IPC or any other Act of the Central Government or State Govenment.

Post Name Total Vacancies

Agniveer MR – 02/2027 Batch Not mentioned (vacancies earmarked in a state-wise manner)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Online applications are invited from unmarried male candidates for enrolment as sailors in Medical Branch for SSR (Med) in 02/2027 batch.
  • Candidates must satisfy eligibility conditions as laid down by the Government of India for enrolment as sailors in the Indian Navy.
  • Candidates must have qualified in 10+2 examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology (PCB) from Boards of School Education recognised by Ministry of Education, Government of India.
  • Passed Matriculation from any recognised board
  • Candidates must have scored at least 50% marks in aggregate and a minimum of 40% in each subject (Physics, Chemistry and Biology) in the 10+2 examination.
  • Candidates who are appearing in class 12th Board Exam of academic year 2025-26 are also eligible to apply, provided they fulfil all other eligibility criteria.
  • Such appearing candidates will be selected only when they produce the original marksheet during subsequent stages of recruitment and secure the minimum prescribed marks in aggregate as well as in individual subjects.
  • Candidates must be born between 01 May 2005 and 31 October 2009 (both dates inclusive) to be eligible for SSR (MED) 02/2027 batch.
  • Candidates born between 01 May 2005 and 31 October 2009 are also eligible to apply for INET 2026 and will be considered for Stage II recruitment of the respective batch as per age criteria.
  • Candidates must be in good physical and mental health, free from any disease or disability likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties at sea and ashore in peace as well as war conditions.
  • Minimum height standard for male candidates is 157 cm, with height relaxations regulated as per Government orders; detailed regulations are available on the official website.
  • Visual standards required are uncorrected vision 6/12, 6/12 and corrected vision 6/6, 6/6 with colour perception CP Pass.
  • Permanent body tattoos are only permitted on inner face of forearms (from inside of elbow to the wrist) and on the reverse side of palm/back (dorsal) side of hand; permanent tattoos on any other part of the body are not acceptable and will lead to bar from recruitment.
  • Insurance cover (on contribution) of Rs. 75 lakhs is applicable for sailors.
  • Candidates must meet medical standards as assessed by authorised military doctors during Recruitment Medical Examination and Pre-Enrolment Medicals at INS Chilka.

Salary/Stipend

  • During the initial training period, a stipend of Rs. 14,600/- per month will be admissible to candidates.
  • On successful completion of initial training, candidates will be placed in Level 3 of the Defence Pay Matrix (Rs. 21,700 – Rs. 69,100) with Military Service Pay (MSP) of Rs. 5,200/- per month plus Dearness Allowance as applicable.
  • Promotion prospects exist up to the rank of Master Chief Petty Officer-I, corresponding to Level 8 of the Defence Pay Matrix (Rs. 47,600 – Rs. 1,51,100) plus MSP Rs. 5,200/- per month plus DA as applicable.
  • During training and service, sailors are provided books, reading material, uniforms, food and accommodation as per entitlement.
  • Sailors are entitled to medical treatment, Leave Travel Concession for self and dependents, Group Housing benefits, Annual and Casual leave, Children Education and House Rent Allowances, and post-retirement benefits including pension, gratuity and leave encashment as per service conditions and Government orders.

 Age Limit (as on 01-05-2005 to 31-10-2009)

  • Candidates should be born between 01 May 2005 and 31 October 2009 (both dates inclusive).
  • Candidates born within these dates are eligible to apply for Stage I – INET 2026 and will be considered for Stage II of SSR (MED) 02/2027 batch as per stated age criteria.
  • Only unmarried male candidates meeting the age range are eligible for enrolment as sailors in SSR (Med) 02/2027 batch.

Application Fee

  • An examination fee of Rs. 550/- (Rupees Five hundred fifty only) plus 18% GST is to be paid by candidates during Stage I – INET application.
  • The fee must be paid in online mode using net banking, Visa/Master/RuPay Credit/Debit Card or UPI.
  • Admit card will be issued only to candidates who have successfully paid the examination fee.
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, nor can it be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.
  • Candidates found to have registered multiple times will be rejected and debarred from the examination, and reimbursement of exam fee will not be carried out in such cases.
  • In case of unsuccessful payment where money has been deducted without admit card generation, candidates are advised to wait for 7 working days for automatic refund to their account.
  • Fee will be charged only during Stage I – INET application, and there will be no separate fee for Stage II process.

Important Dates

Event Date / Period
Stage I – INET 2026 SSR (MED) 02/2027 Application Window 14 March 2026 (00:01 hrs) to 06 April 2026 (17:00 hrs)
Correction Window for Stage I – INET Application 10 April 2026 to 11 April 2026
Stage I – INET 2026 Examination May 2026
Result Declaration of Stage I – INET May – June 2026
Stage II – SSR (MED) 02/2027 Shortlisting & Issue of Call-up Letters February 2027
Stage II for SSR (MED) 02/2027 March 2027
Induction at INS Chilka for SSR (MED) 02/2027 May 2027
Last Date of Online Application 06 April 2026 (17:00 hrs)

Selection Process

  • The selection process consists of Stage I – INET (Indian Navy Entrance Test) followed by Stage II (Physical Fitness Test, Written Examination and Recruitment Medical) and Pre-Enrolment Medicals.
  • Stage I – INET is a computer-based examination with 100 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions, each carrying 1 mark.
  • The Stage I question paper is bilingual (Hindi & English) and comprises four sections: English, Science, Biology and General Awareness.
  • The standard of Stage I question paper is that of 10+2, and syllabus and sample papers are available on the official website.
  • The duration of Stage I examination is one hour, and candidates are required to pass in all sections as well as in aggregate; pass marks in each section and aggregate are determined by the Indian Navy.
  • Negative marking is applicable in Stage I – one fourth (0.25) marks will be deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Centre allocation for INET (online examination) is at the discretion of the Indian Navy.
  • In case of extraneous circumstances causing non-conduct of INET or as per service requirement, Indian Navy reserves the right to shortlist candidates based on marks obtained in qualifying examinations (10th/12th board exams).
  • Results of Stage I – INET (Pass/Fail) along with marks scored will be uploaded on the candidate’s online dashboard.
  • Candidates eligible for Stage II as per age criteria will be shortlisted for SSR (Medical) 02/2027 batch based on marks obtained in Stage I – INET 2026.
  • Shortlisting for Stage II will be carried out state wise, and cut-off marks for next stage will vary from state to state as vacancies are allotted state-wise.
  • If candidates with the same percentage exceed required numbers, shortlisting will be done based on Date of Birth, with earlier DOB (fewer chances) given priority.
  • Sponsor candidates and NCC ‘C’ certificate holders who upload original sponsor and NCC certificates during Stage I application and whose certificates are verified will be exempted from Stage I – INET and will be directly issued call-up for Stage II based on eligibility.
  • Stage II begins with Physical Fitness Test (PFT), which is mandatory; candidates undergoing PFT do so at their own risk.
  • PFT standards for male candidates are: 1.6 km run in 6 min 30 sec, 20 Squats (Uthak Baithak), 15 Push-ups and 15 Bent Knee Sit-ups.
  • The Stage II written exam is conducted only for candidates who qualify the PFT and consists of 100 objective-type questions of 1 mark each.
  • The Stage II written exam question paper is bilingual (Hindi & English) and comprises four sections: English, Science, Biology and General Awareness, with 10+2 level standard and one-hour duration.
  • Candidates must pass in all sections and in aggregate in the Stage II written exam; pass marks are set by the Indian Navy.
  • Recruitment Medical Examination is carried out for candidates who qualify PFT; candidates who qualify Recruitment Medical are considered for the merit list.
  • Candidates found medically unfit in Recruitment Medical may appeal for review at a designated military hospital within 5 days; medical certificates from other hospitals are not accepted and no further review/appeal is permissible.
  • Provisional Select List is prepared based on performance in Stage II written exam, subject to qualification in PFT and Recruitment Medical; merit list for SSR (Medical) is state-wise and cut-off for call-up to INS Chilka varies by state.
  • Pre-Enrolment Medical formalities are conducted at INS Chilka and induction is subject to qualifying these formalities; candidates not qualifying pre-enrolment medicals will be rejected.

Selection Process

  • Selection is based on two stages: Written Examination (500 Marks) + Personality Test/Interview (100 Marks) = Total 600 Marks.

    • Paper-I (Code No. 1): General Medicine and Paediatrics – 250 Marks | 120 Questions (96 from General Medicine + 24 from Paediatrics) | Duration: 2 hours
    • Paper-II (Code No. 2): Surgery, Gynaecology & Obstetrics, Preventive & Social Medicine – 250 Marks | 120 Questions (40 from each part) | Duration: 2 hours
    • Both papers are completely Objective Type (Multiple Choice Answers). Question papers are in English only.
    • Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) of marks assigned to that question will be deducted for each wrong answer. No penalty for unanswered questions.
  • Personality Test/Interview (Part-II) – 100 Marks: Candidates qualifying the written examination will be called for Interview/Personality Test conducted by the Commission to assess General Knowledge, academic ability, intellectual curiosity, balance of judgment, integrity of character, initiative and leadership.
  • Tie-Breaking Principle:
    • If Final Marks are equal: candidate securing more marks in Written Total ranked higher.
    • If still equal: senior in age ranked higher.
    • If Date of Birth also same: candidate whose date of completion of Internship is earlier ranked higher.
    • If tie persists: resolved at the discretion of the Commission.

Contract Basis: The selection process is Shortlisting-cum-Interview. If a large number of applications are received, the Bank may conduct an Online Exam. A Psychometric Test and Group Discussion may also be conducted as additional assessment tools. Interviews will be held at Mumbai only.

IAF Agniveervayu Sports Intake 02/2026 – Eligibility Criteria

Advertisement

1. Age Limit

  • Date of Birth: Candidate must be born between 02 July 2005 and 02 January 2009 (both dates inclusive).
  • Upper Age on Enrolment: Maximum 21 years as on date of enrolment (for those clearing all stages).

2. Marital Status

  • Only unmarried male candidates are eligible.
  • Candidates must undertake not to marry during the four-year engagement period; marriage during engagement will lead to discharge.

3. Educational Qualification

Science Subjects (any one):

  • 10+2/Intermediate with Mathematics, Physics and English from recognised Board with minimum 50% aggregate and 50% in English, OR
  • 3 years Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Automobile/Computer Science/Instrumentation Technology/IT) with 50% aggregate and 50% in English in Diploma or in 10+2/Matric, OR
  • 2 years Vocational Course with non-vocational subjects Physics and Mathematics with 50% aggregate and 50% in English in Vocational or in 10+2/Matric.

Other than Science Subjects (any one):

  • 10+2/Intermediate in any stream with 50% aggregate and 50% in English, OR
  • 2 years Vocational Course with 50% aggregate and 50% in English in Vocational or in 10+2/Matric.

4. Sports Achievements

  • Represented India in Junior/Senior International competitions recognised by IOC/IOA in notified disciplines, OR
  • Minimum 5th place in Junior Nationals, Senior Nationals, All India Inter University, or Khelo India Nationals in listed sports, OR
  • Represented State/UT in National/All India Inter University/Khelo India in team events.
  • Special conditions apply for Cricket, Shooting and Chess (BCCI trophies/NSCC rankings/FIDE rating ≥ 2150).

5. Medical & Physical Standards

  • Minimum height 152 cm; chest 77 cm with minimum 5 cm expansion.
  • PFT: 1.6 km run in 7 minutes + 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups, 20 squats within prescribed time.
  • Visual standard: 6/12 each eye, correctable to 6/6, with specified refractive limits; other IAF medical standards apply.

IAF Agniveervayu Sports 02/2026 – Application / Registration Fee

  • Registration Fee: ₹100/- plus applicable taxes to be paid online via Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking during application at agnipathvayu.cdac.in.

    • One Tier (Technical) – Post Codes 07/26, 08/26, 09/26, 10/26, 11/26, 13/26, 14/26, 16/26, 18/26, 19/26, 20/26: One Tier exam (I-T-T) of 2 hours duration. Total 200 MCQ questions of 200 marks. Section-A: General Awareness, General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability, Arithmetical & Numerical Ability, Test of Hindi Language & Comprehension, Test of English Language & Comprehension (20 marks each; 100 questions: 100 marks). Section-B: Objective type MCQs on the subject concerned as per the qualification prescribed for the post (100 questions: 100 marks). Mandatory minimum qualifying marks applicable only in domain subject specific Section-B, not in Section-A. Combined marks of both sections reckoned for final merit list.
    • Two Tier (General) – Post Code 12/26: Two-tier exam (II-T-G). Tier-I (2 hours): 200 MCQ questions of 200 marks (qualifying in nature). Tier-II (3 hours, one session): Part-I MCQ (200 questions: 200 marks, subject-related) + Part-II Descriptive (50 marks) = Grand Total 250. Part-II: Essay in English (30 marks) + Letter writing/Expansion of ideas in English (20 marks). In Tier-II, mandatory minimum qualifying marks applicable in domain subject specific Part-I; combined marks of both parts reckoned for final merit list.

How to Apply

  • Before submitting online applications, the candidate must ensure that he/she is registered on DSSSB's portal i.e. https://dsssbonline.nic.in. Registration with DSSSB is a one-time exercise.
  • Eligible candidates may apply online through the website https://dsssbonline.nic.in from 27th February 2026 (12.00 Noon) up to 28th March 2026 (till 11:59 PM), thereafter the link will be disabled.
  • Candidates must go through the instructions carefully while filling up the online application form for the post concerned.
  • Candidates must submit their application through Online Mode only. No other mode of application shall be accepted. Applications received through any other mode i.e. by post / by hand / by mail etc. will not be accepted.
  • Pay the application fee of ₹100/- through SBI e-Pay only. No other mode of payment shall be accepted.
  • Before submission of the online application, candidates must check and ensure that they have filled correct details. Once the online application form is submitted, no request for change/correction/modification (including change of category) shall be entertained.
  • Candidates are advised to submit the online application much before the closing date and not to wait till the last date.
  • If an applicant submits multiple registrations and appears in the examination more than once, his/her candidature will be cancelled and he/she will be debarred from the examinations of the Board.
  • Candidates are advised to upload a recent and clear colour photograph. The background should be plain white or off-white, with full face, front view, eyes open.
  • Candidates must fill their correct and active e-mail addresses and mobile numbers in the online application form.
  • After successful submission, candidates should take a printout of the online application form for their own records.

Eligibility criteria - BFUHS Food Safety Officer Recruitment 2026

1) Educational qualification​

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s or Doctorate degree in any of the following (or equivalent notified by Central Government/FSSAI): Food Technology, Dairy Technology, Biotechnology, Oil Technology, Agricultural Science, Veterinary Sciences, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemistry or Medicine.

  • Additionally, other disciplines recognised by FSSAI for Food Safety Officer, including MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, BUMS, BSMS, BSRC and degrees listed under “Food Technology” and “Agricultural Science” in FSSAI notifications (e.g. Food Engineering, Food Processing & Preservation, Food Safety & Quality Management, Agriculture, Dairy Technology, Horticulture, etc.).​

  • Candidate must successfully complete FSSAI‑specified training at a recognised institute after recruitment, before being notified as Food Safety Officer under Section 37 of FSS Act, 2006.​

  • Candidates having any financial interest in manufacture, import or sale of any article of food are not eligible to be appointed as FSO.​

2) Punjabi language requirement​

  • Must have passed Matriculation with Punjabi as a compulsory or elective subject OR any equivalent exam in Punjabi language as specified by Punjab Government.

  • For Group‑C posts, must also pass a qualifying Punjabi Language test equivalent to Matric level with at least 50% marks, conducted by the recruitment agency in addition to the competitive exam; failing this disqualifies the candidate from final merit list.​

  • Certain war‑hero/defence‑personnel categories have relaxed Punjabi requirement as per Punjab Govt rules.​

3) Age limit (as on 31.12.2025)​

  • General age limit: 18 to 37 years.

  • Relaxations:

    • SC/BC: +5 years.

    • Persons with Disabilities: +10 years.

    • Ex‑Servicemen: deduct full service in Armed Forces from actual age; if resultant age does not exceed upper age limit by more than 3 years, considered within age limit.

    • Punjab Govt/Boards/Corporations/Commissions/Authorities employees & all State/Central Govt employees: upper age relaxable up to 45 years.

    • Widows, divorcees and certain other categories of married women: upper age relaxable up to 40 years as per letter No. 1/50/83-5PP(1368)-3454 dated 23.04.1984.​

4) Nationality​

  • Citizen of India, or

  • Citizen of Nepal, or

  • Subject of Bhutan, or

  • Tibetan refugee who came to India before 01.01.1962 to settle permanently, or

  • Person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries (Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, several East African countries, Ethiopia, Vietnam) with intention of permanent settlement in India, with eligibility certificate from Govt. of Punjab, Home Affairs & Justice.​

5) Other conditions​

  • Degrees/diplomas from non‑recognised institutions or certain distance‑learning courses within India are not accepted.

  • Candidates must meet all qualifications and conditions by the last date of application.

BFUHS Food Safety Officer Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

  • Written Test (100 Marks): Candidates will be selected purely on merit of a written examination of 100 marks conducted by BFUHS, Faridkot.
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: Candidates scoring at least 33% in the written test will be treated as eligible; those scoring below 33% will be declared ineligible.
  • Merit & Tie-breaking: Final selection will be based on inter‑se merit of written test, subject to verification of original certificates and other conditions; if marks are equal, candidate older in age will be given preference.
  • Punjabi Language Test: For Group‑C posts, candidates must also qualify a separate Punjabi language test (Matric level) with minimum 50% marks; failing this will exclude them from final merit list irrespective of written‑test marks.
  • Document & Police Verification: Appointment is subject to satisfactory verification of certificates, experience (if applicable), police verification, and no pending disciplinary proceedings in case of Government employees.
  • No Extra Weightage: No additional weightage is given for higher qualifications beyond prescribed eligibility.

Eligibility Criteria

Jr. Overman, T&S Gr-C – Essential Qualifications:

  • Diploma in Mining Engineering of 03 years duration or Degree in Mining Engineering or other equivalent qualifications approved in that behalf by the Central Government from any recognized Institute.
  • Valid Overman Competency Certificate (Un-Restricted) issued by Directorate General of Mines Safety (DGMS) under Coal Mines Regulation 2017 for working in both Open Cast (OC) & Under Ground (UG) Mines or any other certificate in Mining which entitle to work as Overman as per Coal Mines Regulation 2017 for working in both OC & UG Mines.
  • Valid First Aid Certificate.
  • Valid Gas Testing Certificate.

Mining Sirdar, T&S Gr-C – Essential Qualifications:

  • Senior Secondary school examination or intermediate examination (10+2) or equivalent Examination from any recognized Board of Examination OR Diploma in Mining Engineering of 03 years duration or Degree in Mining Engineering or other equivalent qualifications approved in that behalf by the Central Government from any recognized Institute.
  • Valid Mining Sirdarship Certificate of Competency (Un-Restricted) from DGMS under Coal Mines Regulation 2017 for working in both Open Cast (OC) & Under Ground (UG) Mines or any other certificate of Competency in Mining which entitle the applicant to work as Mining Sirdar as per Coal Mines Regulation 2017 for working in both OC & UG Mines.
  • Valid First Aid Certificate.
  • Valid Gas Testing Certificate.

Surveyor, T&S Gr-B – Essential Qualifications:

  • Senior Secondary school examination or intermediate examination (10+2) or equivalent Examination from any recognized Board of Examination OR Diploma in Mining/Mine Surveying Engineering of 03 years duration or Degree in Mining/Mine Surveying Engineering or other equivalent qualifications approved in that behalf by the Central Government from any recognized Institute.
  • Valid Survey Certificate of Competency (Un-Restricted) granted by Directorate General of Mines Safety (DGMS) as per Coal Mines Regulation 2017 for working in both Open Cast (OC) & Under Ground (UG) Mines.

Translator (Tr.) OL Clerical Gr. III – Essential Qualifications:

  • B.A. or equivalent with Hindi & English.
  • Govt. Diploma Holder in Hindi Translation preferred.

Technician (Pathology) Tr. T&S Gr-C – Essential Qualifications:

  • Diploma in Pathology from an Institute recognized by the Government.

Salary/Stipend

  • Jr. Overman T&S Gr-C: Basic Pay Rs. 47,330.25 per month (NCWA-XI). Besides basic pay, the post carries other allowances and fringe benefits as per Company's Rules/National Coal Wage Agreement-XI.
  • Mining Sirdar T&S Gr-C: Basic Pay Rs. 47,330.25 per month (NCWA-XI). Besides basic pay, the post carries other allowances and fringe benefits as per Company's Rules/National Coal Wage Agreement-XI.
  • Surveyor T&S Gr-B: Basic Pay Rs. 51,103.12 per month (NCWA-XI). Besides basic pay, the post carries other allowances and fringe benefits as per Company's Rules/National Coal Wage Agreement-XI.
  • Translator (Tr.) OL Clerical Gr. III: Basic Pay Rs. 41,966.51 per month (NCWA-XI). Besides basic pay, the post carries other allowances and fringe benefits as per Company's Rules/National Coal Wage Agreement-XI.
  • Technician (Pathology) Tr. T&S Gr-C: Basic Pay Rs. 47,330.25 per month (NCWA-XI). Besides basic pay, the post carries other allowances and fringe benefits as per Company's Rules/National Coal Wage Agreement-XI.

 Age Limit

  • Minimum Age: 18 years as on 06/04/2026.
  • Maximum Age: 30 years as on 06/04/2026 for General (UR) & EWS category candidates.
  • The Cut-Off date for determining Age Limit Criteria will be the last date of receipt of application i.e. 06/Apr/2026.
  • The Actual upper Age Limit of the applicant (except Departmental candidates) on the crucial date i.e. 06/Apr/2026 shall not exceed 56 years.
  • There will be no age bar for Departmental candidates i.e. any employee of CIL & its subsidiary companies having the requisite qualification.
  • Age Relaxation:
    • UR / EWS: No relaxation
    • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Central List: 03 years
    • SC / ST: 05 years
    • Ex-Servicemen (ESM): Actual period of service rendered in defence services + 3 years
    • Departmental Candidates (all employees of CIL & its subsidiary companies): No upper age limit
    • Persons with Disabilities (Only for Translator OL and Technician Pathology): By 10 years for General (UR) candidate, By 13 years for OBC-NCL candidate, By 15 years for SC/ST candidates

Application Fee

  • General (UR) / OBC (Creamy Layer & Non-Creamy Layer) / EWS candidates: Rs. 1,000/- plus applicable GST – Rs. 180/- totalling Rs. 1,180/- (Non-Refundable).
  • Exempted Categories: SC / ST / PwBD / ESM / Female candidates / Employees of Coal India Limited and its Subsidiaries are exempted from payment of application fee.
  • Application fee can be paid through online mode only i.e. Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking etc. There will be no other mode of payment of application fee.
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Candidates are therefore advised to verify their eligibility conditions before applying.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification / Advertisement Date 21/02/2026
Starting Date of Online Application & Payment Gateway 16/03/2026 (10:00 AM)
Last Date of Submission of Online Application 06/04/2026 (11:50 PM)
Cut-off Date for Age & Eligibility 06/04/2026
Tentative Date of Downloading Admit Card for Eligible Candidates Will be notified in the website
Tentative Date of Computer Based Test (CBT) Will be notified in the website
Tentative Date of Declaration of Results Will be notified in the website

Selection Process

  • The Selection methodology will comprise of Computer Based Test (CBT) only. No personal interview will be held.
  • Eligible Candidates, as declared by them, will be provisionally called for Computer Based Test (CBT) on the basis of their declaration regarding their eligibility such as age, educational/technical qualification, Valid Statutory Certificate etc. as laid down in this notification/advertisement.
  • The CBT will comprise of objective type questions with multiple choice of answers and there will be no negative marking for wrong answers. The instructions will be Bilingual (English/Hindi).
  • The CBT will consist of two sections i.e. "A" & "B". Section "A" will comprise question specific to General Awareness/Aptitude and will comprise 20 questions of "One" mark each. Section "B" of the test paper will comprise questions relating to Technical knowledge and will comprise 80 questions of "One" mark each, with a total of 100 marks.
  • Qualifying marks (CBT): General/EWS candidates – 45 marks (i.e. 45% of 100); OBC(NCL) candidates – 40 Marks (i.e. 40% of 100); SC/ST candidates – 35 marks (35% of 100).
  • Based on the merit order of marks secured by the candidates in CBT, the shortlisted qualified candidates in the ratio of 1:3 will be called for document verification.
  • In case of a tie of marks obtained in the CBT, it will be resolved on the basis of Date of Birth (elder one being the first) and thereafter Name alphabets.
  • Successful shortlisted candidates will be notified to appear for scrutiny of their testimonials through the website of MCL. Candidates shall have to appear along with all original certificates/documents & photocopies thereof as per eligibility criteria notified in this advertisement.
  • Those who are working in Govt./Semi Govt./Autonomous Bodies/PSUs/CIL & Subsidiaries etc. must have to produce "No Objection Certificate" from their employer at the time of documents/certificates verification.
  • After verification of documents/certificates, 'Provisional Select List' of successful candidates will be published in the official website of MCL (https://mahanadicoal.in).
  • Finally, provisionally selected candidates will be issued offer of appointment based on their position in the merit list and with due consideration of the reservation policy of Govt. of India for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD/EWS/ESM. They have to undergo Initial Medical Examination (IME) by company's own doctors & their findings thereon will be final. Those who are found UNFIT, will be disqualified for employment.
  • The validity of the merit panel will be for 01 year or as per extant Govt. guidelines.
  • Exact schedule of CBT will be displayed on MCL website (https://mahanadicoal.in) in due course.

How to Apply

  • The candidates shall apply through online mode available on MCL website https://mahanadicoal.in only under CAREERS >>>> Recruitment section as per the qualification and eligibility criteria indicated above. No other means/mode of application will be accepted.
  • Before filling-up of the online application, keep the following details/documents/information ready: E-Mail ID, Mobile No., Personal and Educational qualification details, Scanned Copy of Matriculation (X) Certificate/Mark sheets/diploma/degree Mark sheets (in Jpg/Jpeg/PDF format), Scanned Copy of valid Caste Certificate for OBC (NCL)/SC/ST candidates and Income Certificates for EWS candidates (if Applicable), Scanned Copy of Ex-Servicemen Certificates (if Applicable), Scanned Copy of PwBD Certificates (if Applicable), Scanned Copy of competency certificate of Mining Sirdar/Overman/Surveyor, Gas testing & First Aid certificate (in Jpg/Jpeg/PDF format), Details of Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking for making application fee, Scanned Copy of candidates' Recent Photograph (not more than 3 weeks old in jpg/jpeg format), Scanned Copy of candidates' Signature with Black ink pen (in jpg/jpeg format).
  • Read Important Instructions and Click on (√) 'I Agree' Button.
  • Register by filling up necessary details (Post opted, name, Mobile No. and e-mail ID and click on Submit Button).
  • Check Application Sequence No., User ID & Password received on your e-mail and mobile number.
  • Re-login to your account by entering User ID and password received through e-mail.
  • Click on the option to go to Application Form and fill all the necessary details in the respective field and upload documents, Photo and Signature.
  • Check Preview of the Application Form and make corrections, if any.
  • Press Submit Button.
  • Make Online payment through Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking (as applicable).
  • Take Print out of application form for future record.
  • The last date for submission of application is 06/Apr/2026 up to 11:50 PM.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent degree in any discipline from a recognized University / Institution / Board.
  • Essential Qualification: Adequate knowledge in basic Computer skill with certification.
  • Other Conditions:
    • Candidate must be a citizen of India and a domicile of the State of Odisha.
    • Must be able to speak, read and write Odia and shall have Odia as a language subject in the H.S.C. Examination or an equivalent examination, or be declared to have passed a test in Odia language equivalent to the Middle School Standard.
    • Candidates possessing academic qualifications from Universities / Institutions / Councils / Boards outside Odisha must produce proof of equivalence from any recognized University / Institution / Council / Board of the State of Odisha, and affiliation of the institution to a recognized University/Council/Board.
    • Candidates furnishing certificates and mark-sheets with grades / grade-points must furnish numerical equivalence from the examining body, failing which they shall not be considered eligible.
    • Government servants having requisite educational qualification and within the prescribed age limit, whether temporary or permanent, are eligible to apply, provided they inform their respective head of office in writing and produce a "No Objection Certificate" from the employer before the date of document verification.

Salary / Stipend

  • Pay Scale for all posts (Junior Assistant & Junior Clerk): Group-C, Level-4, Cell-1
  • Junior Assistants in Government Degree Colleges, NCC, and BSE are posted as Government employees.
  • Junior Assistants in State Public Universities and OUHS are posted in Autonomous Body status.
  • Junior Clerks in Non-Govt. Aided Colleges are posted under Non-Govt. Aided Colleges status.
  • Note: HRA, encashment of unutilized leave, and a few other incentives are not available to Non-Govt. Aided Colleges employees.
  • All persons appointed shall not be eligible for pension as defined under Odisha Civil Service (Pension) Rules, 1992; but shall be covered by the defined Contributory Pension Scheme in accordance with the Odisha Civil Service (Pension) Amendment Rules, 2005.

 Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 21 Years
  • Maximum Age: 42 Years (candidate must have been born not earlier than 1st January 1984 and not later than 1st January 2005)
  • SC / ST / SEBC / Women / Ex-Servicemen: Upper age relaxable by 5 years (up to 47 years)
  • PwD candidates (permanent disability of 40% and above): Upper age relaxable by 10 years
  • PwD belonging to SEBC/SC/ST categories: Cumulative age relaxation of 15 years
  • A candidate coming under more than one category shall be eligible for only one benefit of relaxation, which shall be considered most beneficial to him/her.
  • PwD category with temporary disability will not avail age relaxation and will not be considered for subsequent selection processes.
  • Date of Birth mentioned in the High School Certificate or equivalent certificate issued by the concerned Board / Council will only be accepted as age proof.

Application Fee

  • Unreserved (UR) / SEBC Category: Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only) – Non-refundable and non-adjustable
  • Scheduled Tribe (ST) / Scheduled Caste (SC) / PwD Category: Rs. 200/- (Rupees Two Hundred only) – Non-refundable and non-adjustable
  • Mode of Payment: Online through SB Collect only. The link for SB Collect payment gateway is available in the online application form. Any other mode of payment will not be accepted under any circumstances.
  • Bank Account Details of SSB for Payment:
    Account No: 35396835756, State Bank of India, Govt. Treasury Branch, Bhubaneswar
    IFS Code: SBIN0009025
  • In case of non-payment of examination fee / application fee, the application form will be rejected.
  • After successful payment, the candidate will be able to download the application form from the SSB website after 48 hours.

Important Dates
