Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on performance in Written Test and Computer Skill Test – Total 250 Marks.
  • Written Test: 200 Marks (100 Questions, Multiple Choice type, answered on carbonless OMR Answer Sheets, duration: 2 hours)
    • General English up to Graduation Level – 60 Marks
    • General Knowledge and Current Affairs – 40 Marks
    • General Mathematics up to HSC Standard – 40 Marks
    • Reasoning & Mental Ability – 60 Marks
  • Computer Skill Test: 50 Marks (1 hour duration; minimum qualifying mark: 20 marks for all categories)
  • For each correct answer, 2 marks will be awarded; for each wrong answer, negative marking of 0.50 mark.
  • Qualifying marks in Written Examination: 40% for Unreserved category candidates; 30% for SC/ST/SEBC & PwD categories.
  • On the basis of the Written Test performance, candidates will be shortlisted two times the vacancy (category-wise & sub-category-wise for PwD) for the Computer Skill Test.
  • Candidates who qualify both the Written Test and Computer Skill Test shall be called for Document Verification at the SSB office.
  • For final selection, the marks secured in the Written Test and Computer Skill Test taken together shall be considered for candidates who have successfully completed the document verification process.
  • In case of a tie after the Written Test (for shortlisting for Computer Skill Test), merit position will be decided based on aggregate percentage of marks in Bachelor's Degree (up to 2 decimal). A further tie will be resolved by date of birth (earlier born preferred).
  • The final merit list will be prepared as per vacancy of the posts advertised category-wise and sub-category-wise.
  • SSB will prepare the final merit list and submit it to HED for counselling of university-wise Junior Assistants, Govt. Colleges, NCC, and district-wise Junior Clerk in Non-Government Aided Colleges.
  • Zone of Examination: Written Test will be held at 5 zones – Balasore, Berhampur, Bhubaneswar, Jeypore, and Sambalpur (depending on number of candidates per zone).
  • Computer Skill Test and Document Verification will be conducted at Bhubaneswar.
  • Scribe facility and compensatory time shall be allowed to PwD candidates having 40% or above permanent disability. The PwD candidate must arrange their own scribe and provide scribe information in the prescribed format available on the SSB website.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online through the link available on the official website of State Selection Board, Odisha: www.ssbodisha.ac.in
  • Read the detailed INSTRUCTIONS carefully before filling up the Online Application Form.
  • Enter the percentage of aggregate marks secured in Under-graduate (+3) degree, converting CGPA as per the conversion formula of the respective degree-awarding University/Institution.
  • Upload the latest passport size photograph (taken within fifteen days before the submission of application), scanned image of full signature, and left-hand thumb impression – all must be clearly identifiable/visible. Failure to do so will result in rejection of application.
  • Deposit the requisite application fee online through SB Collect only. In case of non-payment, the application form will be rejected. Ensure the Application ID No. allotted to you is entered correctly during payment.
  • After successful payment, the candidate can download the application form from the SSB website after 48 hours. Keep this form for future reference and during document verification.
  • Candidates are advised to submit the online application form well within the timeline without waiting for the closing date to avoid last-hour rush.
  • There is no edit option after final submission of the online application form. Candidates are advised to be very careful while filling up the form.
  • Application window: 11.03.2026 (02:30 PM) to 13.04.2026 (11:45 PM).

  • Female Staff Nurse: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Nursing OR Regular course in B.Sc. Nursing OR Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing from a recognized University/Institute. Registered as a Nurse or Nurse Mid-wife (RN or RM) with any State Nursing Council. Two and a half years' experience in a minimum 50-bedded hospital after acquiring the degree.
  • Counsellor: Masters' Degree in Psychology/Clinical Psychology from a recognized University AND One year Diploma in guidance & counselling from a recognized university or institution. Candidate should have studied local language up to Class VIII. Experience of working in residential school/EMRS preferable.
  • Vocational Skilled Trainer for Beauty & Wellness: Diploma/Advanced Certificate courses in Cosmetology/Beauty Therapy/Beauty Culture from recognized Institution/ITIs and NVTIs. Minimum 3 years' working experience in the profession.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Nationality

The candidate must be a citizen of India.

Educational Qualification

  • Must possess a BDS or equivalent Degree from a Medical College or Medical Institution recognized by the Dental Council of India (DCI).
  • Must possess a valid Registration Certificate under the Dentist Act, 1948.
  • Candidates having degrees from foreign universities must possess required Conversion Certificates recognized by DCI.

Additional Requirements

  • Houseman-ship/Internship Completion Certificate
  • Certificate relating to passing of the screening test conducted by the National Board of Examinations (for candidates from foreign universities)
  • Odia language test pass certificate, or must pass the required Odia examination within 4 years of joining service

Odia Language Requirement

Candidate must be able to read, write, and speak Odia and must have fulfilled any one of the following:

  • Passed Middle School Examination in Odia as a language subject; OR
  • Passed Matriculation or equivalent examination with Odia as medium of examination in non-language subject; OR
  • Passed in Odia as language subject in the final examination of Class-VII or above; OR
  • Passed a test in Odia in Middle English School standard conducted by the School and Mass Education Department.

Proviso: If a candidate has not passed Middle School Examination in Odia as a language subject, he/she shall be required to pass the examination conducted by the Board of Secondary Education, Odisha within 4 years of joining service. Failing this, no further increment will be sanctioned and promotion to Group-A (Senior Branch) will not be allowed.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Age Limit (as on 01 January 2026)

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 42 years
  • Candidate must not have been born earlier than 02 January 1984 and not later than 01 January 2005.

Age Relaxation

Category Upper Age Limit Relaxation
SEBC 5 years
SC 5 years
ST 5 years
Women candidates 5 years
Ex-Servicemen 5 years
PwBD (40% or more permanent disability) 10 years
PwBD belonging to SEBC/SC/ST categories 15 years (cumulative benefit)
  • A candidate who comes under more than one category shall be eligible for only one benefit of upper age relaxation, whichever is more beneficial.
  • Exception: PwBD candidates belonging to SEBC/SC/ST categories shall be eligible for 15 years cumulative age relaxation.
  • Date of birth in High School Certificate or equivalent certificate issued by the concerned Board/Council will only be accepted.
  • Save as provided above, the age limits prescribed can in no case be relaxed.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Salary & Pay Scale

Selected candidates will be appointed in Level-12, Cell-1 of the Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017 and will also be entitled to Dearness Allowance (DA) and other admissible allowances as sanctioned by the Government from time to time.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Application Fee

Category Examination Fee Refund Policy
UR, SEBC, OBC and other candidates ₹700 Fee refunded only to candidates who actually appear in both papers of Written Examination
SC, ST, PwBD candidates NIL (Exempted) Not applicable

Payment Mode: Online only through Credit Card, Debit Card, UPI, Net Banking, or Wallet.

  • Applications without payment of examination fee (except SC/ST/PwBD candidates) will be treated as incomplete and rejected.
  • Refunds will be processed to the original mode of payment used at the time of transaction.
  • Candidates must furnish bank account details in the online application form for refund in case of technical glitches.
  • Bank account must remain valid and active. The Commission will not entertain correspondence regarding incorrect bank details.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Selection Process

The selection shall be made on the basis of a Written Test as per the Odisha Medical Services (Method of Recruitment and Conditions of Service of Dental Surgeons) Rules, 2022 along with Amendment Rules, 2025.

Written Examination Pattern

Particulars Details
Total Marks 200
Total Questions 200
Question Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ)
Duration 3 hours (180 minutes)
Marking Scheme +1 mark for correct answer and -0.25 mark for wrong answer
Syllabus As per Dental Council of India (DCI) Syllabus for BDS
Qualifying Marks Will be decided by OPSC
Exam Date 21 June 2026 (Sunday) – Tentative
Exam Centre Cuttack / Bhubaneswar

Subject-wise Distribution of Marks

Sl. No. Discipline/Subject Marks Allocated
1 Anatomy 10
2 Physiology 10
3 Biochemistry 10
4 Pharmacology 10
5 Pathology 10
6 Microbiology 10
7 Dental Material 10
8 Dental Anatomy 10
9 Medicine 15
10 Surgery 15
11 Oral Pathology 10
12 Oral Medicine & Radiology 10
13 Pedodontics & Preventive Dentistry 10
14 Orthodontics 10
15 Periodontics 10
16 Oral Surgery 15
17 Prosthodontics 15
18 Public Health Dentistry 10
Total 200

Merit List Preparation

  • The Commission shall prepare a list of candidates in order of merit on the basis of the Written Test equal to the number of advertised vacancies.
  • If two or more candidates secure equal marks, the candidate securing higher marks in the BDS Examination will rank higher.
  • If marks in the BDS Examination are also equal, the candidate older in age will be placed above the younger candidate.
  • The recommendation list shall remain valid for one year from the date of recommendation or till the next recruitment is made by the Commission.
  • A Sports Person must secure the qualifying marks of his/her category for inclusion in the merit list.

Answer Key & Result

  • Provisional Answer Keys shall be uploaded on the website within 10 days of examination.
  • Candidates can submit objections/suggestions against the provisional answer key.
  • Candidates who do not challenge the provisional answer key shall forfeit their right to agitate the matter later.
  • Cut-off marks, answer keys, and individual marks will be declared only after publication of the final result and select list.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Apply Online – Step-by-Step Process

  1. Visit the official website: https://opsc.gov.in
  2. Read Advertisement No. 07 of 2025-26 carefully before applying.
  3. Click on the Apply Online link for Dental Surgeon recruitment from 17.03.2026 to 17.04.2026 (5:00 PM).
  4. Read detailed instructions available on the OPSC portal.
  5. Complete online registration to obtain a unique Permanent Public Service Account Number (PPSAN).
  6. Fill the automated online application form with accurate personal, contact, category, educational, registration, Odia test, and bank details.
  7. Upload scanned copies of required documents in the prescribed format and size.
  8. Upload recent passport size photograph, full signature, and left-hand thumb impression.
  9. Pay the examination fee online, if applicable.
  10. Verify all details carefully before final submission.
  11. Submit the application form successfully.
  12. Take a printout of the finally submitted application form for future reference.
  13. Note down your Application Number (USER ID) and PPSAN for future correspondence.

Documents to be Uploaded

  • 10th Pass Certificate & Mark Sheet
  • BDS Degree Certificate & All Mark Sheets
  • Houseman-ship/Internship Completion Certificate
  • Valid Registration Certificate under Dentist Act, 1948
  • Screening Test Certificate (for foreign degree holders)
  • Conversion Certificates, if applicable
  • Caste Certificate (SEBC/SC/ST)
  • PwBD Certificate
  • Sports Identity Card/Certificate
  • Ex-Serviceman Release Certificate & Affidavit, if applicable
  • Odia language test pass certificate
  • Proof of Identity (Aadhar/EPIC/DL/Passport/PAN Card)
  • Recent passport size photograph
  • Full signature
  • Left-hand Thumb Impression (LTI)

Important Guidelines

  • Submit the application well before the last date to avoid last-hour rush.
  • If any correction is needed after submission, the candidate must cancel the previous application and apply afresh within the closing date.
  • Applications submitted through offline mode, email, or post will not be accepted.
  • Uploaded documents must be clearly visible; otherwise, the application may be rejected.
  • Keep at least four copies of the same passport size photograph used in the application.
  • Ensure all details are correct because the application process is automated and system driven.

How to Apply for OPSC Dental Surgeon Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted in online mode only through https://opsc.gov.in from 17 March 2026 to 17 April 2026 (5:00 PM).

  • The Admit Card will be uploaded on the OPSC website before the exam date.
  • Candidates must download and produce the admit card at the examination centre.
  • No separate communication will be made for admit card issuance.
  • Notice for document verification shall also be uploaded on the OPSC website.
  • Candidates qualified in the written exam must bring hard copy of the online application along with self-attested copies and originals of all required certificates for verification.
  • Each document copy must mention: “Submitted by me and Certified as genuine and has not been cancelled” with full signature and date.
  • Government servants must inform their Head of Office in writing and furnish a No Objection Certificate during document verification.
  • Candidates debarred by OPSC, UPSC, or any other State PSC will not be eligible to apply during the debarment period.
  • Admission to the written examination will be purely provisional.
  • Any complaint regarding conduct of examination must be sent to the Grievance Wing by email within 7 days of completion of examination.

Eligibility criteria - South Central Railway Act Apprentice 2025-26

1) Educational qualification​

  • 10th class/SSC passed under 10+2 system with minimum 50% aggregate marks from a recognised board.

  • ITI certificate in the relevant notified trade from an institute recognised by NCVT/SCVT (trade-wise: AC Mechanic, Carpenter, COPA, Diesel Mechanic, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Fitter, Industrial Electronics, Machinist, MMTM, Motor Mechanic Vehicle, Painter, Welder).

  • Candidate must possess required qualification as on date of online application submission.

  • Engineering graduates and diploma holders are not eligible for this Act Apprentice notification (covered under separate scheme).

2) Age limit (as on 11.04.2026)​

  • Minimum age: 15 years.

  • Maximum age: 24 years.

Category-wise permissible date of birth range:

Category Date of birth between
UR / EWS 11-04-2002 and 11-04-2011
SC / ST 11-04-1997 and 11-04-2011
OBC-NCL 11-04-1999 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (UR) 11-04-1992 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (SC/ST) 11-04-1987 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (OBC) 11-04-1989 and 11-04-2011

Relaxations included in above ranges:

  • SC/ST: +5 years.

  • OBC-NCL: +3 years.

  • PwBD: +10 years.

  • Ex-Servicemen: +10 years up to length of service in Defence Forces (no extra relaxation for their children).

3) Residential / jurisdiction eligibility​
Candidates must reside in districts under South Central Railway jurisdiction and provide valid proof of residence. Eligible areas:

  • Telangana: all districts.

  • Andhra Pradesh: all districts except Manyam, Srikakulam, Vizianagaram.

  • Maharashtra: Akola, Amaravati, Aurangabad, Beed, Chandrapur, Hingoli, Jalna, Latur, Nanded, Nasik, Parbhani, Washim, Yavatmal.

  • Karnataka: Balki, Bellari, Belgaum, Bidar, Gulbarga/Kalaburgi, Raichur, Yadgir.

  • Tamil Nadu: Vellore.

  • Madhya Pradesh: Burhanpur, Khandwa.

4) Category certificates (for reservation)​

  • SC/ST: Central Government format caste certificate (Annexure-B).

  • OBC-NCL: caste + NCL certificate (issued within 3 years) in Central format (Annexure-C) + self-declaration (Annexure-D).

  • EWS: valid Income & Asset certificate (Annexure-E).

  • PwBD: disability ≥40% in prescribed format (Annexure-G/H).

5) Salary/Stipend

  • Selected candidates will be paid a stipend during the apprenticeship at the prescribed rates as per extant instructions.

SCR Apprentice Selection Process 2025-26

  • Merit List Basis: Selection for SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 will be done purely on merit, by taking the average of percentage marks in 10th (minimum 50% aggregate) and ITI marks, giving equal weightage to both.
  • No Exam / Interview: There will be no written test or viva-voce for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26.
  • Tie-breaking: If two candidates have the same aggregate percentage, older candidate (higher age) will be preferred; if DOB is also same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred.
  • Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates will be called for DV where all original certificates (education, ITI, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, RDAT registration, medical fitness) will be verified.
  • Medical Fitness: Candidates must produce medical fitness certificate from a government-authorised doctor (Gazetted, not below Asst. Surgeon) in prescribed format at DV; without this, they will not be considered.
  • Training & Stipend: Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training as per Central Apprenticeship Council syllabus and receive stipend at prescribed rates during training.
  • No Job Guarantee: SCR apprenticeship 2025-26 provides training only; there is no guarantee of regular railway job after completion of apprenticeship.

South Central Railway Apprentice Application Form 2026

  • Application Mode: Online only via RRC/SCR portal; no offline forms will be accepted.
  • Application Dates: SCR Apprentice online form 2026 is available from 12 March 2026 (17:00 hrs) to 11 April 2026 (23:59 hrs).
  • Fee: ₹100 for applicable categories; SC/ST, female/Transgender and PwBD candidates are exempt from fee payment.
  • Multiple Trades: Candidates with ITI in more than one trade can submit separate SCR Apprentice application 2026 for each trade.
  • Communication: All updates regarding SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 application form, merit list and DV will be sent via registered email/SMS and uploaded on RRC-SCR webpage only.

How to Apply for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26

  1. Visit the official South Central Railway website: https://scr.indianrailways.gov.in and go to About Us → RRC-SCR to open the ONLINE ACT APPRENTICE APPLICATION link.
  2. Read the detailed SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 notification carefully and ensure you belong to the eligible states/districts and possess required 10th + ITI qualification.
  3. Complete Registration: select state and district, upload address proof, enter valid mobile number and email ID, create a password and verify OTPs sent to mobile and email.
  4. Login as a registered candidate and fill in personal details (name, DOB, category, etc.) and educational/technical details (10th marks, ITI trade, ITI marks, RDAT registration number).
  5. Select your priority/preference of training units (Divisions/Workshops/Sheds) only for trades you are eligible for; options once submitted cannot be changed.
  6. Upload a recent colour photograph (JPEG, ≤1 MB, not older than 3 months), signature image (≤1 MB) and required certificates (10th, ITI, RDAT form, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, medical certificate) in PDF format (≤2 MB).
  7. Ensure you have completed RDAT/NAPS registration at www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and obtained registration number before filling the SCR apprentice application.
  8. Check all details in the Preview page carefully; after clicking Submit, no modification will be allowed.
  9. Pay the application fee (if applicable) through online payment gateway (Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI) and generate e-receipt.
  10. Download/print the final submitted SCR Apprentice application form 2026 and keep it along with fee receipt and uploaded documents for Document Verification.

  • TGT (Chemistry/Biology): Candidates should have studied Biology/Life Science/Botany/Zoology as Hons/Main Subject in at least 3 years/6 semesters with specified combinations of subsidiary subjects (Chemistry and Botany/Zoology) for at least one year or any 2 semesters; candidates under CBCS with these subjects are also eligible; desirable: Knowledge of Computer Applications.
  • TGT (Computer Science): B.Sc (Computer Science)/B.Sc (IT)/BCA or equivalent from recognized University with at least 50% marks in aggregate or equivalent CGPA; OR B.E/ B.Tech (Computer Science/IT/Computer Engineering) with at least 50% marks or equivalent CGPA; OR ‘A’ Level from ‘DOEACC’, Ministry of Information and Communication Technology with at least 50% marks or equivalent CGPA and a graduation degree in any subject from a recognized University; AND B.Ed Degree with at least 50% from NCTE recognized Institution/University; desirable: working knowledge of English and Hindi/other regional language and experience of working in a school.

  • PRT (Telugu) (Table-II, Sr. No. 08): 50% pass marks in Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary School Certificate Test or Intermediate or equivalent with Telugu as a subject at +2 level and two years Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed.) from recognized Institution; OR 50% pass marks in Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate or equivalent with Telugu as a subject in +2 level and four years B.El.Ed from recognized Institution; OR 50% pass marks in Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate or equivalent with Telugu as a subject in +2 level and two years Diploma in Education (D.Ed) from a recognized Institution with proficiency in teaching Telugu as 2nd/3rd language up to class VIII and knowledge of Telugu grammar; desirable: experience of working in a school and knowledge of working on computer.

Eligibility criteria - South Central Railway Act Apprentice 2025-26

1) Educational qualification​

  • 10th class/SSC passed under 10+2 system with minimum 50% aggregate marks from a recognised board.

  • ITI certificate in the relevant notified trade from an institute recognised by NCVT/SCVT (trade-wise: AC Mechanic, Carpenter, COPA, Diesel Mechanic, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Fitter, Industrial Electronics, Machinist, MMTM, Motor Mechanic Vehicle, Painter, Welder).

  • Candidate must possess required qualification as on date of online application submission.

  • Engineering graduates and diploma holders are not eligible for this Act Apprentice notification (covered under separate scheme).

2) Age limit (as on 11.04.2026)​

  • Minimum age: 15 years.

  • Maximum age: 24 years.

Category-wise permissible date of birth range:

Category Date of birth between
UR / EWS 11-04-2002 and 11-04-2011
SC / ST 11-04-1997 and 11-04-2011
OBC-NCL 11-04-1999 and 11-04-2011

Relaxations included in above ranges:

  • SC/ST: +5 years.

  • OBC-NCL: +3 years.

  • PwBD: +10 years.

  • Ex-Servicemen: +10 years up to length of service in Defence Forces (no extra relaxation for their children).

3) Residential / jurisdiction eligibility​
Candidates must reside in districts under South Central Railway jurisdiction and provide valid proof of residence. Eligible areas:

  • Telangana: all districts.

  • Andhra Pradesh: all districts except Manyam, Srikakulam, Vizianagaram.

  • Maharashtra: Akola, Amaravati, Aurangabad, Beed, Chandrapur, Hingoli, Jalna, Latur, Nanded, Nasik, Parbhani, Washim, Yavatmal.

  • Karnataka: Balki, Bellari, Belgaum, Bidar, Gulbarga/Kalaburgi, Raichur, Yadgir.

  • Tamil Nadu: Vellore.

  • Madhya Pradesh: Burhanpur, Khandwa.

4) Category certificates (for reservation)​

  • SC/ST: Central Government format caste certificate (Annexure-B).

  • OBC-NCL: caste + NCL certificate (issued within 3 years) in Central format (Annexure-C) + self-declaration (Annexure-D).

  • EWS: valid Income & Asset certificate (Annexure-E).

  • PwBD: disability ≥40% in prescribed format (Annexure-G/H).

5) Salary/Stipend

  • Selected candidates will be paid a stipend during the apprenticeship at the prescribed rates as per extant instructions.

SCR Apprentice Selection Process 2025-26

  • Merit List Basis: Selection for SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 will be done purely on merit, by taking the average of percentage marks in 10th (minimum 50% aggregate) and ITI marks, giving equal weightage to both.
  • No Exam / Interview: There will be no written test or viva-voce for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26.
  • Tie-breaking: If two candidates have the same aggregate percentage, older candidate (higher age) will be preferred; if DOB is also same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred.
  • Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates will be called for DV where all original certificates (education, ITI, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, RDAT registration, medical fitness) will be verified.
  • Medical Fitness: Candidates must produce medical fitness certificate from a government-authorised doctor (Gazetted, not below Asst. Surgeon) in prescribed format at DV; without this, they will not be considered.
  • Training & Stipend: Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training as per Central Apprenticeship Council syllabus and receive stipend at prescribed rates during training.
  • No Job Guarantee: SCR apprenticeship 2025-26 provides training only; there is no guarantee of regular railway job after completion of apprenticeship.

South Central Railway Apprentice Application Form 2026

  • Application Mode: Online only via RRC/SCR portal; no offline forms will be accepted.
  • Application Dates: SCR Apprentice online form 2026 is available from 12 March 2026 (17:00 hrs) to 11 April 2026 (23:59 hrs).
  • Fee: ₹100 for applicable categories; SC/ST, female/Transgender and PwBD candidates are exempt from fee payment.
  • Multiple Trades: Candidates with ITI in more than one trade can submit separate SCR Apprentice application 2026 for each trade.
  • Communication: All updates regarding SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 application form, merit list and DV will be sent via registered email/SMS and uploaded on RRC-SCR webpage only.

How to Apply for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26

  1. Visit the official South Central Railway website: https://scr.indianrailways.gov.in and go to About Us → RRC-SCR to open the ONLINE ACT APPRENTICE APPLICATION link.
  2. Read the detailed SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 notification carefully and ensure you belong to the eligible states/districts and possess required 10th + ITI qualification.
  3. Complete Registration: select state and district, upload address proof, enter valid mobile number and email ID, create a password and verify OTPs sent to mobile and email.
  4. Login as a registered candidate and fill in personal details (name, DOB, category, etc.) and educational/technical details (10th marks, ITI trade, ITI marks, RDAT registration number).
  5. Select your priority/preference of training units (Divisions/Workshops/Sheds) only for trades you are eligible for; options once submitted cannot be changed.
  6. Upload a recent colour photograph (JPEG, ≤1 MB, not older than 3 months), signature image (≤1 MB) and required certificates (10th, ITI, RDAT form, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, medical certificate) in PDF format (≤2 MB).
  7. Ensure you have completed RDAT/NAPS registration at www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and obtained registration number before filling the SCR apprentice application.
  8. Check all details in the Preview page carefully; after clicking Submit, no modification will be allowed.
  9. Pay the application fee (if applicable) through online payment gateway (Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI) and generate e-receipt.
  10. Download/print the final submitted SCR Apprentice application form 2026 and keep it along with fee receipt and uploaded documents for Document Verification.

Class 10th /Matric pass with 45% marks in aggregate of five basic subjects and min 33% marks in each of those five subjects. For boards following grading system, grades commensurate to percentages, as above, will be considered. Indian Gorkhas – Class 10th simple pass.

  • Garhwalis.
  • Ladakher.
  • Tribals of recognized tribal areas.

Note: Domicile and Caste certificate will be considered to determine applicability of height relaxation.

Application Fee

  • Examination Fee: Rs 250/- per application for all categories.
  • Payment Mode: Online (through the website during application).

Important Dates

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 13-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 01-04-2026
  • Online Exam Dates: 01/06/2026 to 15/06/2026 (Tentative)
  • Firm dates for online exam will be announced later on the website.

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates. Admission to the examination will be purely on the basis of Admit Card. The CEE will be conducted at designated centres tentatively between 01 Jun 2026 to 15 Jun 2026.
  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. Shortlisted candidates will attend the Recruitment Rally at designated venue where the Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical Test and Document Verification will be conducted.

Physical Fitness Test (PFT) (At Rally Site)

  • 1.6 Km Run
    • Group I: Upto 7 Min 45 Secs - Excellent
    • Group II: 7 Min 46 Sec to 8 Min 30 Sec - Good
  • Long Jump: 10 Feet (Need to qualify)
  • High Jump: 3 Feet (Need to qualify)

Note: Provisions for extra time for 1.6 Km run in hilly terrain and lower timing for Long Jump and High Jump in such cases.

Medical Standards

  • Candidates must be in good physical and mental health, free from any disability likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties.
  • Detailed medical examination as per Army standards.

Final Merit List

  • Final merit list will be based on aggregate of marks scored in CEE and performance in PFT (if applicable).
  • Recruitment is purely based on merit depending on available vacancies.

Note: Selection in the Indian Army is 'Fair & Transparent' and on merit only. At no stage any bribe is to be paid to anyone for selection or recruitment in the Indian Army. Candidates should not fall prey to unscrupulous persons posing as recruiting agents.

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official website: www.joinindianarmy.nic.in.
  2. If new user, complete the registration process by providing basic details and creating a login ID.
  3. Login using the credentials and fill the online application form carefully.
  4. Upload required documents, photographs, and signatures as per specifications.
  5. Pay the examination fee of Rs 250/- online.
  6. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

Note: Applications invited from domiciles of all districts of Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, UT of Chandigarh & Delhi. Any change in policy or details published in notification will be intimated on registered email/mobile number and with a ticker on the www.joinindianarmy.nic.in web portal.

Documents Required

  • 20 copies of passport size photographs.
  • Education Certificates (Marksheets, Degree, etc.).
  • Domicile Certificate.

  • Character Certificate from Village Sarpanch/Municipal Corporation.
  • Unmarried Certificate.

  • Affidavit on Rs 10 stamp paper as per format.
  • Single Bank A/C, PAN Card & AADHAR Card.
  • Police Verification Form.
  • Certificate from serving personnel for wards of serving soldiers (if applicable).
  • Any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

Salary Structure

Agniveers will be paid a customized package with fixed yearly increment. In addition, Risk and Hardship, Ration, Dress and Travel allowances as applicable.

All these latest bank jobs in SIDBI are offered on contractual basis for an initial period of 3 years (extendable up to 2 more years) with salary ranging from ₹12.00 lakh to ₹55.00 lakh per annum (CTC) plus Group Insurance and other facilities, along with provision for annual increments and variable component linked to performance, making this one of the attractive latest banking opportunities for experienced professionals in specialized technical and managerial roles.

SIDBI Specialist Officers Recruitment 2026 – Overview

Advertisement

Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI), the Principal Financial Institution for Promotion, Financing and Development of the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise (MSME) sector, has released Advertisement No. 15/2025-26 for engagement of Specialist Officers on Contractual Basis (Full-time) for 14 posts.

Particulars Details
Organization Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
Advertisement No. 15/2025-26
Post Name Data Scientist, AI Specialists, ML Engineers, Data Engineers, Data Protection Officer, Relationship Manager, Portfolio Manager, Strategic Partnerships Manager, Cluster Manager
Type of Post Contractual on Full-time Basis
Total Vacancies 14 posts
Salary ₹12.00 lakh to ₹55.00 lakh per annum (CTC)
Job Location Mumbai (for most posts), Thanjavur/Trichy/Madurai (for Cluster Manager)
Application Mode Email only
Selection Process Shortlisting & Personal Interview (Online)

SIDBI Specialist Officers Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

Notification PDF for SIDBI Specialist Officers Recruitment 2026 is available on the official SIDBI website under Advertisement No. 15/2025-26 titled "Engagement of Specialist Officers on Contractual Basis (Full-time) – 2025-26" dated March 18, 2026.

Download SIDBI Notification PDF

SIDBI Specialist Officers Vacancy 2026 Details

The SIDBI Specialist Officers Recruitment 2026 notification announces a total of 14 vacancies across 9 different specialist posts. All vacancies are for Unreserved (UR) category, and PwBD (Visually Impaired) reservation is horizontal within the parent category vacancies.

Portfolio Manager – Pre-IPO & Anchor Investments (PM) 07 02 01
Strategic Partnerships Manager (SPM) 08 02 01

Grand Total - 14 -

Note: One candidate can apply for only one post under this advertisement. Multiple candidatures will result in rejection of all applications.

Important Dates

  • Publication of SIDBI Specialist Officers notification: March 18, 2026
  • Last date to submit application via email: April 07, 2026
  • Mode of Selection: Shortlisting & Online Personal Interview (date to be notified)

SIDBI Specialist Officers Eligibility Criteria 2026

SIDBI Specialist Officers eligibility criteria vary by post and include age limit, educational qualification, and experience requirements that must be fulfilled as on February 28, 2026.

Age Limit (as on February 28, 2026)

  • Data Scientist (DS): Maximum 35 years
  • AI Specialists (AIS): Maximum 35 years
  • ML Engineers (MLE): Maximum 35 years
  • Data Engineers (DE): Maximum 40 years
  • Data Protection Officer (DPO): Maximum 45 years
  • Relationship Manager – Corporate Deposit (RM-CD): Maximum 35 years
  • Portfolio Manager (PM): Maximum 40 years
  • Strategic Partnerships Manager (SPM): Maximum 35 years
  • Cluster Manager (CM): Maximum 40 years

Age Relaxation

  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD: As per Government of India guidelines

SIDBI Specialist Officers Educational Qualification 2026

Educational qualifications for SIDBI Specialist Officers are post-specific and must be from recognized universities/institutes:

Post-wise Educational Qualification

  • Data Scientist (DS): Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, Quantitative Finance or related quantitative discipline. Desirable: PhD in relevant quantitative field, certifications in data science/ML/AI.
  • AI Specialists (AIS): Graduate degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science or related discipline. Post-graduate degree such as M.Tech, M.Sc. (Data Science/AI/ML) or equivalent. Desirable: Certifications in AI/ML/cloud AI.
  • ML Engineers (MLE): B.E./B.Tech or equivalent in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, Data Engineering, AI or related discipline. Desirable: Master's degree in computer science/AI/ML/Data Science, certifications in cloud/ML engineering.
  • Data Engineers (DE): B.E./B.Tech or equivalent in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or related discipline. Desirable: Master's degree in computer science/data engineering/information systems, certifications in cloud/data platforms.
  • Data Protection Officer (DPO): Bachelor's degree (graduation or equivalent) in any discipline. Desirable: Post-graduate in Law (LLM), Technology Law, MBA, Computer Science, Information Security; certifications like CIPP, CIPM, FIP, CIPT, CDPSE, CDPO, CDP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.
  • Relationship Manager (RM-CD): Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM (Finance)/CA/CFA or equivalent.
  • Portfolio Manager (PM): Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM (Finance)/CA/CFA or equivalent with strong exposure to capital markets/ECM/portfolio management.
  • Strategic Partnerships Manager (SPM): MBA/PGDM or Master's degree in Finance/Strategy/Marketing/Entrepreneurship/Economics or related field.
  • Cluster Manager (CM): Bachelor's degree in Agri Business/Rural Management/Business Administration/Finance/Commerce or related field. Desirable: MBA/PGDM in Agri Business/Rural Management/Sales/Marketing.

SIDBI Specialist Officers Experience Requirements 2026

Experience requirements (as on February 28, 2026) are post-specific and relevant experience certificates from employer are mandatory:

  • Data Scientist (DS): Minimum 3 years in data science/advanced analytics/ML modelling in Banks, NBFCs, DFIs, Fintechs or regulated financial institutions.
  • AI Specialists (AIS): Minimum 4 years in AI/ML development, deployment, and MLOps in banking, fintech or regulated financial services.
  • ML Engineers (MLE): Minimum 4 years in ML engineering/MLOps/backend engineering with ML systems exposure.
  • Data Engineers (DE): Minimum 8 years in data engineering/data platform roles in Banks, NBFCs, DFIs, fintechs or regulated financial institutions.
  • Data Protection Officer (DPO): 15 years in managerial/professional roles (preferably in IT, compliance, legal, risk, information security or finance) with minimum 4 years direct hands-on experience in data protection, privacy regulation, data governance or information security.
  • Relationship Manager (RM-CD): Minimum 6 years total in Banks/NBFCs with approximately 4 years in deposit mobilisation/institutional liabilities/treasury sales.
  • Portfolio Manager (PM): Minimum 10 years in portfolio management/investments, ECM/IPO/capital markets, merchant banking/investment banking, AMC/PMS/AIF/DFI/bank treasury roles.
  • Strategic Partnerships Manager (SPM): Minimum 8 years in strategic partnerships/ecosystem relationships, merchant banking/investment banking/transaction advisory, or DFI/NBFC/bank partnership roles.
  • Cluster Manager (CM): Minimum 3 years post-qualification experience in cluster & PDI activities/business development in banking/financial services or working with MSMEs, FPOs, or NBFC/microfinance institutions.

SIDBI Specialist Officers Selection Process 2026

The SIDBI Specialist Officers Selection Process 2026 consists of shortlisting of applications followed by Online Personal Interview before a Selection Committee.

  • Shortlisting: SIDBI will undertake preliminary screening of applications to prepare shortlist of eligible candidates. Merely fulfilling the requirements does not automatically entitle candidature for interview.
  • Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for online personal interview on a suitable date (to be informed in due course). Interview shall take place online, candidates must ensure availability of necessary infrastructure.
  • Merit List: Final merit list will be prepared in descending order based on scores obtained in interview only. In case of tie, candidates will be ranked by age in descending order.
  • Wait List: SIDBI reserves the right to draw wait lists of candidates and consider wait listed candidates for meeting actual requirement.

SIDBI Specialist Officers Salary 2026

SIDBI Specialist Officers are offered contractual appointments with attractive Cost to Company (CTC) remuneration varying by post:

Post Name Salary (CTC per annum)
Data Scientist (DS) Around ₹25.00 lakh
AI Specialists (AIS) Around ₹25.00 lakh
ML Engineers (MLE) Around ₹20.00 lakh
Data Engineers (DE) ₹35.00 to ₹40.00 lakh
Data Protection Officer (DPO) ₹50.00 to ₹55.00 lakh
Relationship Manager (RM-CD) ₹20 to ₹25 lakh
Portfolio Manager (PM) ₹45 to ₹55 lakh
Strategic Partnerships Manager (SPM) ₹25 to ₹30 lakh
Cluster Manager (CM) Around ₹12.00 lakh

Additional Benefits:

  • Group Insurance and other facilities
  • Provision for annual increment on CTC based on performance review
  • Suitable variable component linked to performance

Contract Period: Initial contract period of 3 years, subject to interim review, extendable for further period up to 2 years at sole discretion of the Bank. Contract can be terminated at 3 months' notice on either side or salary in lieu thereof.

Note: The remuneration figures are indicative ballpark ranges. A candidate's fit for the role in terms of skills, experience and alignment with SIDBI's mandate shall be evaluated first.

SIDBI Specialist Officers Application Fee 2026

There is NO APPLICATION FEE mentioned in the SIDBI Specialist Officers Recruitment 2026 notification.

How to Apply for SIDBI Specialist Officers Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply for SIDBI Specialist Officers Recruitment 2026 by sending duly filled application via email to [email protected] on or before April 07, 2026 by following the steps given below:

  1. Download the application format (in English or Hindi) from the SIDBI website.
  2. Fill the application form completely with all required details and paste a recent passport size photograph with full signature of the candidate across the photo with date.
  3. Prepare Curriculum Vitae (CV) in English or Hindi (typed only, handwritten applications/CV will be rejected).
  4. Attach self-attested copies of relevant certificates/documents in support of proof of identity, address, age, educational qualification (educational certificates/mark sheets), and work experience as mentioned in the application form.
  5. Send the application along with CV and all supporting documents via email to [email protected] on or before April 07, 2026.
  6. While forwarding the application, the subject line shall clearly indicate: "Application for the post of <<Post Code>>, <<Name of the Post>> <<Candidate Name>>"
  7. Example: "Application for the post of 01, Data Scientist John Doe"
  8. Keep a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Important: Applications not in prescribed format, not signed by candidate, incomplete in any respect, not accompanied by required certificates/documents, or received after due date will not be entertained.

Important Instructions

  • One candidate can apply for only one post under this advertisement. Multiple candidatures involving one or several posts shall result in rejection of all applications.
  • The candidate must be a citizen of India.
  • Relevant experience certificate from employer must specifically mention experience in the required field.
  • Applications without relevant experience certificate from employer will be rejected.
  • Handwritten applications or Curriculum Vitae shall be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates should indicate a working e-mail ID and mobile phone number in their application and maintain the same active for receiving communication (call letters/interview date advices etc.). Do not change email ID and mobile number during interview process.
  • Intimation/call letter for interview will be sent by email or uploaded on SIDBI website. NO HARD COPY WILL BE SENT.
  • The interview shall take place online. Candidates should ensure availability of necessary infrastructure as specified in call letter.
  • Candidates serving in Govt./Quasi Govt./Public Sector undertakings including Nationalized Banks and Financial Institutions are advised to submit 'No Objection Certificate' from their employer at the time of interview.
  • Candidates should not furnish any false, tampered/fabricated particulars or suppress any material information while applying.
  • Appointments will be subject to medical fitness, satisfactory character and background verification, satisfactory report from previous employer and completion of all pre-recruitment formalities.
  • If false information or suppression of material facts is detected at any stage, candidature will stand cancelled. If detected after appointment, services will be liable for termination.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification of candidature.
  • Decisions of SIDBI in all matters regarding eligibility, shortlisting, conduct of interview, selection, calling for joining etc. would be final and binding. No representation or correspondence will be entertained.
  • SIDBI reserves the right to raise/modify eligibility criteria to restrict number of candidates commensurate with number of posts.
  • SIDBI reserves the right to draw wait lists and consider wait listed candidates for meeting actual requirements.
  • The number of vacancies are provisional and may vary. SIDBI reserves the right to change designation/name of post at any time without prior notice.

NaBFID Senior Analyst Salary 2026

For Regular Basis positions, the annual fixed compensation for Senior Analyst grade is approximately ₹24.81 lakh. In addition, variable pay (performance bonus) of up to 20% on fixed compensation may be paid based on performance, as decided by the Bank from time to time. Compensation may be revised at suitable intervals as approved by the Board. Group Insurance (Medical, Accidental & Term Life) will be provided over and above the compensation.

For Contract Basis positions, remuneration will be offered based on qualification, experience, suitability, last drawn salary and market benchmark and shall not be a limiting factor for suitable candidates. The Fixed Term engagement will be for a minimum of 5 years, which may be renewed at NaBFID's discretion.

NaBFID Senior Analyst Selection Process 2026

The selection process differs for Regular and Contract basis appointments as follows.

Regular Basis: The selection process comprises an Online Examination followed by a Personal Interview. If fewer applications are received for any stream, the Bank may change the process to Shortlisting-cum-Interview. The online exam consists of 50 objective-type questions (Professional Knowledge) carrying 100 marks to be completed in 60 minutes. There is a negative marking of ¼ mark for each wrong answer. Minimum qualifying marks are 40% for UR/EWS and 35% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates. Final selection is based on Online Exam (70% weightage) and Interview (30% weightage).

Contract Basis: The selection process is Shortlisting-cum-Interview. If a large number of applications are received, the Bank may conduct an Online Exam. A Psychometric Test and Group Discussion may also be conducted as additional assessment tools. Interviews will be held at Mumbai only.

  • Candidates called for Interview will be reimbursed actual travel expenses up to a maximum of IInd AC rail fare of mail express train, upon submission of to & fro tickets.

  • Any legal proceedings arising out of this advertisement can be instituted only in Mumbai. Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • No change in category of any candidate is permitted after registration of online application.

How to Apply for NaBFID Senior Analyst Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply online for NaBFID Senior Analyst Recruitment 2026 from 18.03.2026 to 08.04.2026 by following the steps below.

  2. Click on "Click here for New Registration", enter your Name, Contact details and Email ID. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated and sent to your registered email/mobile.
  3. Fill in all personal, educational and professional details in the online application form. Use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save your progress. No changes are permitted after clicking "COMPLETE REGISTRATION".

  6. Proceed to the payment tab and pay the application fee online through the available digital payment methods.

Selection Process

  • The selection process may comprise of various shortlisting and selection tools such as Computer Based Test (CBT) / Written Test / Typing Test, Group Task, Psychometric Assessment, Skill Test, Moot Court, Personal/Technical Interview, Physical Fitness Efficiency Test (if applicable) etc., depending upon the position requirement.
  • Computer Based Test (CBT): Consists of objective questions (subjective as well for Legal HR Officers) and comprises two parts:
    • Part I – General Aptitude: English Language, Quantitative Aptitude Test & Intellectual Potential Test (Logical Reasoning and Data Interpretation).
    • Part II – Technical / Professional Knowledge: Questions related to qualifying degree / educational background required for the applied position.
  • CBT will be conducted tentatively on 3rd May 2026. HPCL reserves the right to reschedule the date of CBT.
  • Questions will be based on syllabus hosted on Careers Page on corporate website (indicative, not exhaustive).
  • Candidates qualifying in CBT, in order of merit and predetermined ratio, will be advised to upload supporting documents for certain positions.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Group Task and/or Personal Interview based on scrutiny of application, uploaded documents, and merit list.
  • Candidates' document verification shall be conducted before Personal Interviews.
  • Candidates may be required to undergo Psychometric Assessments before/after Group Task/Personal Interview.
  • Candidates must secure minimum qualifying marks in each applicable selection stage (CBT, Group Task, and Personal Interview) to be considered for further selection.
  • A category and discipline-wise merit list will be drawn for all candidates who qualify in all applicable stages.
  • The selected candidates would be required to join HPCL as per the date of joining mentioned in the Offer of Appointment.

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • All computations of age / relevant experience / qualification shall be done with respect to the last date of receipt of online application i.e. 25th March 2026.
  • All qualifications should be full-time regular courses from AICTE approved / UGC recognized University / Deemed University.
  • Teaching & Research experience in an academic institute will not be considered as relevant work experience.
  • Candidates currently employed at HPCL are not eligible to apply for Lateral Positions (positions where minimum experience is sought).
  • Selected candidates will be on Probation for one year from the Date of Joining.
  • Selected candidates will have to execute a service bond to serve the corporation for a minimum period of three years. Bond Amount: General – ₹3,00,000/-; EWS/OBC(NC)/SC/ST/PwBD – ₹50,000/-.
  • A Retention Amount of ₹5,000/- per month will be deducted for Pay Scales ₹30,000–1,20,000 or ₹40,000–1,40,000 during the first 12 months of probation.
  • A Retention Amount of ₹8,000/- per month will be deducted for Pay Scales from ₹50,000–1,60,000 till ₹90,000–2,40,000 during the first 12 months of probation.
  • Appointment is subject to candidate being medically fit as per standards prescribed by the Corporation.
  • Candidates would be required to clear Physical Fitness Efficiency Test (PFET) comprising Working at Height Test, Endurance Test, and Agility Test after PEME (wherever applicable).
  • Depending upon the requirement of the Corporation, selected candidates can be placed anywhere in India or overseas at the discretion of the Management.
  • Maximum upper age of applicants shall not exceed 56 years including all possible age relaxations.
  • Court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Mumbai.
  • Any further corrigendum / addendum would be uploaded only on www.hindustanpetroleum.com.

How to Apply

  • Online Application will be accepted from 1300 hrs on 25th February 2026 till 2359 hrs on 25th March 2026.
  • Candidates are requested to apply online only at www.hindustanpetroleum.com → Careers → Current Openings, after reading the detailed advertisement.
  • No other means / mode of application shall be accepted.
  • Applications with incomplete / wrong particulars or not in the prescribed format will not be considered.
  • The email ID and mobile number provided in the online application should remain valid for at least one year. Applications with pseudo / fake email IDs will attract appropriate action under the law.
  • Upload the photograph and signature of the candidate during application. In case of wrong / missing photo / signature, the candidature will be cancelled.
  • All details given in the online form will be treated as final and no changes will be entertained.
  • Pay the applicable application fee online via Debit Card / Credit Card / UPI / Net Banking and ensure the payment status shows "Completed". Take a printout of the acknowledgment of payment for future reference.
  • Queries must be emailed with subject formatted as "Position Name – Application Number" at [email protected].
  • Candidates are advised to apply online well before the closing date and not wait till the last date.
  • Candidates currently employed in Government Departments / PSUs / Autonomous Bodies must submit their application through proper process and produce No Objection Certificate at the time of Personal Interview.

NCCS Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

  • Project Associate - I (Sr. No. 01): Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / MVSc or bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent.
  • Project Associate - I (Sr. No. 01): Four years Bachelor's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences/Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences/BVSc. /B. Pharm or Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized university or equivalent. Experience in molecular biology, ELISA, mice handling and all culture is required. Animal handling is desirable not essential.
  • Project Research Scientist – II (Non-Medical) (Sr. No. 02): Post Graduate Degree*, including the integrated PG degrees, with three years post qualification Experience. *(Microbiology / Life Sciences /Biotechnology / Biomedical Science/Biochemistry/Plant Biology/Animal Biology) OR PhD in any branch of Life Sciences. Excellent skills in genetics, molecular biology and protein biochemistry. Experience in tissue culture, gene-editing and advanced microscopy is advantageous. Track record of high-quality research in the form of peer reviewed publications, competitive fellowships etc. Prior postdoctoral research experience in reputed research laboratories is desirable.
  • Project Technical Support - III (Sr. No. 03): Three Years Graduate degree* in relevant subject / field + three Years post qualification experience *(Biotechnology/ Biochemistry/ Microbiology/ Life Sciences/ Biomedical Science) OR PG in relevant subject/field*. Experience in handling mammalian cell culture, PCR, cloning, expression and purification of recombinant proteins, western blot, immunofluorescence, cell-based assays etc.
  • Project Technical Support - III (Sr. No. 06): Three years Graduate degree* in relevant subject / field + Three years post qualification experience *(Biotechnology/ Biochemistry/ Microbiology/ Life Sciences/ Biomedical Science) OR PG in relevant subject/field*. Experience in handling mammalian cell culture, western blot, immunofluorescence, protein biochemistry and cell-based assays. Experience in Mass spectrometry-based proteomic data analysis and proteomic-based sample preparation. Work experience in Drosophila model system would be preferred.
  • Junior Research Fellow (JRF) (Sr. No. 05): Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through a process described through any one of the following: A. Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests – CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and/or GATE. B. The selection process through National Level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MOE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc. Candidate should have some experience with the following techniques: 1. Cell culture handling and subcellular fractionation of organelles. 2. Protein purification using Affinity & gel-exclusion chromatography. 3. In-vivo and In-vitro protein-protein interaction and western blotting. 4. Gene cloning and RT-PCR.

BARC Junior Research Fellowships Vacancy 2026 Details 

Post Name No. of Fellowships
Junior Research Fellowships 105 (Indicative)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates must be Indian nationals with consistently good academic record.
  • Only those who have successfully cleared and possess valid certificate for at least one of the following national level examinations are eligible: UGC-CSIR-NET Fellowship (SLET/Lectureship not eligible), JEST, ICMR-JRF Test, ICAR-JRF Test, DBT-JRF Biotechnology Eligibility Test, GATE in Physics/Chemistry/Life Sciences/Biotechnology, or JGEEBILS.
  • Candidates should have secured minimum 60% aggregate in B.Sc. and 55% aggregate in M.Sc. from a recognized University.
  • Candidates with five years Integrated M.Sc./B.S-M.S. (Dual degree) should have secured minimum 55% aggregate.
  • Candidates having a 4-year / 8-semester bachelor’s degree (B.S with fourth year Research) with minimum 75% marks in aggregate are also eligible to apply.
  • Candidates who have completed but are awaiting final results of M.Sc., Integrated M.Sc., B.S-M.S. (Dual degree) or B.S. (with fourth year Research) may also apply, subject to specified minimum aggregates up to the previous semester and completion of degree requirements before 10-08-2026.
  • M.Sc. / Integrated M.Sc. / B.S-M.S. (Dual degree) / B.S. (with fourth year Research) in Physics with Mathematics as one of the subjects at B.Sc. level is eligible.
  • M.Sc. / Integrated M.Sc. / B.S-M.S. (Dual degree) / B.S. (with fourth year Research) in Chemistry (General/Applied/Organic/Inorganic/Physical/Analytical) with Physics as ancillary subject at B.Sc. level and Mathematics at H.Sc. level is eligible, subject to passing marks in these subjects.
  • M.Sc. / Integrated M.Sc. / B.S-M.S. (Dual degree) / B.S. (with fourth year Research) in Life Sciences disciplines (including Life Science, Botany, Zoology, Agriculture, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Marine Biology, Bioinformatics, Genetics, Plant Science, Plant Breeding, Plant Pathology, Entomology, Animal Science, Biomedical Sciences, Biosciences, Food Science, Food Science and Technology) with Physics or Chemistry or Biochemistry or Agriculture Chemistry or allied Chemistry as one of the subjects at B.Sc./five-year integrated M.Sc. level is eligible.
  • Candidates with specializations listed as not eligible in Physics, Chemistry and Life Sciences (such as Electronics and Instrumentation, Industrial Chemistry, Polymer Chemistry, Textile Chemistry, Environmental Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Petroleum Chemistry, Nanoscience, Nanotechnology, Fisheries, Horticulture, Forestry, Agronomy, Animal Husbandry, Bio-analytical Sciences, Polymer Science, Medicine/Medical Science, Pharmaceutical Science, Home Science, and B.Tech./M.Tech. in Life Sciences disciplines) are not eligible.
  • All academic requirements for the qualifying degree must be completed before 10-08-2026, and relevant proof must be produced at joining.

Salary/Stipend

  • Selected candidates will initially be considered as Junior Research Fellows (JRF) and will be paid a stipend of ₹37,000/- per month for a period of two years.
  • On satisfactory performance and review, the fellowship will be upgraded to Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) from the third year onwards with a stipend of ₹42,000/- per month (consolidated).
  • The total duration of the fellowship is five years.
  • Candidates are entitled to a contingency grant including book allowance of ₹60,000/- per year.
  • Financial assistance to attend one International Conference abroad during the PhD Programme may be provided, subject to conditions updated by HBNI.

Age Limit 

  • The candidate should be less than 28 years of age as on 01-08-2026.
  • Age relaxation is applicable up to 3 years for Other Backward Class Non-Creamy Layer (OBC-NCL) applicants.
  • Age relaxation is applicable up to 5 years for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe applicants.
  • Additional 10 years of age relaxation is applicable for persons with benchmark disabilities (PwBD) applicants.
  • Age, qualification, community status and creamy layer status will be reckoned as on 01-08-2026 for submission of online application.

Application Fee

  • Application fee of ₹500/- is payable at the time of submission of online application.
  • Mode of payment of the application fee is online only, using net banking, debit card, credit card, UPI, etc.
  • Application fee is exempted for Women candidates and candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and Person with Benchmark Disabilities.
  • After submission of the online application, the applicant has to make online payment of application fee using the Application Number generated; applications without fee payment will be treated as incomplete and rejected.
  • Candidates must use the ‘Make Payment’ option under the ‘My Account’ menu to pay the fee, selecting the generated application number from the drop-down list.
  • Detailed guidelines for payment of application fee are available under the menu “How to pay Application fee.”
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances and cannot be held in reserve for any other recruitment.
  • Application fee should be paid on or before the last date of receipt of online application.

Important Dates

Event Date
Receipt of applications (Start date) 10/03/2026
Receipt of applications (Last date) 31/03/2026
Interview (tentative dates) June-July 2026

Selection Process

  • Applications will be scrutinized and candidates will be screened in for interview based on eligibility as per the national level exam and their score in the qualifying exam.
  • The number of candidates to be called for interview will be decided by the Selection Committee.
  • Final selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in the selection interview only.
  • Allotment of research project will be on the basis of performance in the selection interview; in case of a tie, marks obtained in M.Sc./B.Sc. will be considered.
  • The recommendation/decision of the Selection Committee will be final and binding.

How to Apply

  • Facility for submission of online application will be available from 10/03/2026 to 31/03/2026 at the specified application portal.
  • Applications will be accepted online only and candidates should not submit multiple applications.
  • Candidates must read the instructions in the advertisement and online application form carefully before making any entry or selecting any option, and keep necessary documents/certificates ready.
  • All Educational and Professional Qualifications must be indicated under the ‘Educational & Professional Qualifications’ column; otherwise, the application will not be processed.
  • Candidates “pursuing” relevant degrees must choose the correct option from the ‘Name of Examination’ drop-down box, while those who have completed the degree must choose the appropriate completed option.
  • A valid e-mail ID and mobile number are mandatory, and the email ID must remain active till declaration of results; call letters or instructions may be sent by email or made available on the website.
  • Photo and signature must be clearly visible in preview; a recent front-facing passport size photograph in JPEG format of size not exceeding 50 KB must be uploaded, otherwise the application will be rejected.
  • Candidates must upload SSC/H.Sc./B.Sc./M.Sc./Integrated M.Sc./B.S-M.S. (Dual degree)/B.S. (with fourth year Research) mark sheets and Degree Certificates, valid Qualifying Examination Score Card and Caste Certificate (if applicable); applications without these attachments will be disqualified.
  • Before final submission, candidates should verify that all details, including name and date of birth, are correct as per SSC; no change or correction will be allowed after final submission.
  • If original educational documents have been submitted to another institution, copies may be uploaded and a letter from the Head of that institution must be produced at the time of interview.
  • In case of any difficulty in applying online or uploading documents, candidates should email complaints with screenshots to the specified email address given in the notification.

  • Clinical Psychologist: i) Having a recognized qualification in Clinical Psychology from an institution approved and recognized by the Rehabilitation Council of India or ii) Post-Graduate Degree in Psychology or Clinical Psychology or Applied Psychology and a Master of Philosophy in Clinical Psychology or Medical and Social Psychology obtained after completion of a full time course of two years which includes supervised clinical training from any University recognized by UGC and approved and recognized by RCI or such recognized qualifications as may be prescribed & at least 15 years' experience in field.
  • Mental Health Nurse: Diploma / Degree in General Nursing or Diploma / Degree in psychiatric nursing recognized by the Nursing Council of India and Registered as such with the State Nursing Council with at least 15 years' experience in field.
  • Persons representing persons who have or have had mental illness: No specific qualification mentioned.
  • Persons representing care-givers of persons with mental illness or organizations representing care-givers: Person who resides with a person with mental illness and is responsible for providing a care to that person includes a relative or any other person or Organization representing care-givers.
  • Persons representing non-governmental organizations which provide services to persons with mental illness: Representatives of registered NGO’s with 10 years’ experience in the field of Mental Health.

  • For Medical Officer (MBBS) – 766 Posts: MBBS degree from a statutory university OR equivalent qualification as specified in the First or Second Schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (102 of 1956).
  • For Medical Officer (Specialist) – 674 Posts: Postgraduate Degree/Diploma in the specified subjects (as mentioned in Para 4.2 of the advertisement) from a statutory university, OR PG Degree/Diploma equivalent as specified in the First or Second Schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956.
  • Internship: Candidates must have completed their Internship on or before the last date of application. The Internship completion certificate must be uploaded with the application; otherwise, the application will be cancelled.
  • Registration: A valid Maharashtra Medical Council (MMC) / National Medical Commission (NMC) registration certificate or renewal receipt as on the date of application is mandatory. Without this, the application will not be accepted.
  • Foreign-educated Candidates: Candidates who obtained MBBS from outside India must have cleared the NBE (National Board of Examinations) examination. Their NBE marksheet must be submitted with the application; failure to do so will result in cancellation of application.
  • Domicile: Valid Maharashtra Domicile (Adhivas) certificate as on the date of application is mandatory. Benefits of reservation are available only to permanent residents of Maharashtra.
  • Candidates other than those holding qualifications mentioned in Para 8.1, 8.2, and 8.3 are not eligible to apply.
  • Candidates possessing PG qualification in subjects other than those notified (Para 4.2) may apply as plain MBBS candidates, subject to their written consent in the application form.
  • Currently serving regular Medical Officers of Maharashtra Medical and Health Service Group-A (S-20) are NOT eligible to apply.

Public Health Department Maharashtra Medical Officer, Group-A (S-20) Application Fee 2026

  • Unreserved (General) Category: Rs. 1000/- (Non-refundable)
  • Reserved Category / EWS / Orphan (Anath) / PwD (Divyang): Rs. 700/- (Non-refundable)
  • Bank charges and applicable taxes will be extra over and above the above fee.
  • Fee must be paid only through the Online mode via the official website. Fee paid through any other mode will not be accepted.
  • Once paid, the application fee will NOT be refunded under any circumstances.

Public Health Department Maharashtra Medical Officer, Group-A (S-20) Age Limit 2026

  • Minimum Age: 18 Years
  • Maximum Age:
    • Unreserved / OBC (NCL): 38 Years
    • Reserved Category (SC/ST/OBC/SEBC/EWS): 43 Years
    • Sports Person (Unreserved): Up to 45 Years
    • Sports Person (Reserved/EWS): Up to 43 Years
    • PwD (Divyang) – Unreserved: 43 Years
    • PwD – Reserved/EWS: 43 Years
    • Orphan (Anath) candidates: 43 Years
  • A candidate who qualifies under more than one relaxation category (Reserved/PwD/Sports Person) shall be entitled to only one (maximum) relaxation benefit.

Public Health Department Maharashtra Medical Officer, Group-A (S-20) Salary 2026

  • Pay Scale: 7th Pay Commission Pay Level S-20 – Rs. 56,100 to Rs. 1,77,500 per month.
  • Promotion opportunity is available to Maharashtra Medical and Health Service Group-A (S-23, Pay Level Rs. 67,700 – 2,08,700) subject to fulfilling the required qualifications for that post.
  • Selected candidates cannot engage in any kind of private practice; however, they will be entitled to Practice Prohibition Allowance as per rules.
  • All persons appointed shall be covered by the Contributory Pension Scheme as per Odisha Civil Service (Pension) Amendment Rules (reference: service rules applicable to the post).
  • Selected candidates will have a probation period of 2 years.
  • Specialist candidates placed as plain MBBS (due to non-availability of specialist posts) will not be entitled to 3/6 additional increments at the time of appointment.

Public Health Department Maharashtra Medical Officer, Group-A (S-20) Selection Process 2026

  • Selection will be based on a Merit List prepared on the basis of marks/weightage assigned as per the scoring system (no written examination).
  • Scoring System (Total: 100 Marks) for MBBS candidates:
    • Average percentage of marks secured in all years of MBBS degree: Up to 50 marks (converted from percentage to 50 marks).
    • PG Degree / Diploma (if held): 20 marks
    • Experience as Contract/Bond Medical Officer in Government Service: Up to 30 marks (maximum):
      • For every 11 months of service in Tribal / Naxal-affected / Hilly areas: 10 marks
      • For every 11 months of service in Non-tribal / Non-naxal / Non-hilly areas: 05 marks
  • For Specialist candidates: separate merit lists will be prepared subject-wise (Specialist) and for plain MBBS, in the following priority order:
    • Super Specialist
    • MD / MS / DNB
    • Diploma from recognized university
    • FCPS
  • For foreign-educated candidates, NBE examination marks will be considered for screening.

  • Applications submitted by post or any other means will not be entertained.

HVF Avadi Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026-27

HVF Avadi Apprenticeship eligibility criteria include educational qualification, domicile, year of passing, age as per Apprenticeship Rules, reservation norms and physical standards as prescribed in Apprenticeship Rule 1992.

Educational Qualification

  • Category I – Graduate Apprentices (Engineering / Technology): Full-time Degree in Engineering or Technology in relevant discipline granted by a Statutory University, Institution empowered by an Act of Parliament, or Graduate examination of professional bodies recognized as equivalent by State/Central Government.
  • Category II – Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: Full-time Diploma in Engineering or Technology in relevant discipline granted by State Technical Education Board, University, or Institution recognized by State/Central Government.
  • Category III – Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentices: Full-time Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce/Humanities such as BA/B.Sc/B.Com/BBA/BBM/BCA etc. from Statutory/Deemed University in relevant discipline (UGC approved).

Not Eligible: Candidates with Distance Education / Correspondence degrees, Open University degrees or Post Graduates (PG) are not eligible for Apprenticeship.

Year of Passing & Domicile

  • Candidates must be Graduate/Diploma holders who passed in 2022, 2023, 2024 or 2025.
  • Candidates must hail from Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana or Puducherry.

Age Limit

Age limit will be followed as per Apprenticeship Rules.

Reservation of Vacancies

  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD will be as per Apprentices Act guidelines.
  • Candidates claiming SC/ST/OBC/PwD reservation must produce valid certificates in Government-prescribed format; otherwise their claim will be treated as General category.
  • BC/MBC candidates claiming OBC (Non-creamy layer) must produce OBC (NCL) certificate in the approved format from competent authority.

Physical Standards

Minimum physical standards shall be as prescribed in Clause 4 of the Apprenticeship Rule 1992 and subsequent amendments.

Previous Training / Experience

Candidates who have already undergone or are currently undergoing Apprenticeship under Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973, and/or having one year or more experience are NOT ELIGIBLE to apply.

HVF Avadi Apprentice Selection Process 2026-27

The selection process for HVF Avadi Apprenticeship 2026-27 is based on merit of qualifying examination and certificate verification.

  • Shortlisting: Board of Apprenticeship Training (Southern Region) will prepare the shortlist from online application data based on percentage of marks obtained in the basic prescribed qualification for the respective disciplines.
  • Intimation: Shortlisted candidates will be informed through their registered email ID.
  • Certificate Verification: Shortlisted candidates must appear for Certificate Verification at Heavy Vehicles Factory, Avadi, Chennai on the scheduled dates.

HVF Avadi Apprentice Stipend & Training Duration 2026-27

All Apprentices engaged under HVF Avadi Apprenticeship 2026-27 will undergo one-year training with monthly stipend as per Apprenticeship norms.

  • Graduate Apprentices (Engineering / Technology): ₹18,000/- per month.
  • Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentices (BA/BSc/BCom/BBA/BBM/BCA etc.): ₹18,000/- per month.
  • Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: ₹16,200/- per month.
  • Training Period: One year for all categories as per Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973.

Upon completion of Apprenticeship, Heavy Vehicles Factory, Avadi, Chennai has no obligation to offer employment, and apprentices cannot claim right of employment on the basis of completion of training.

How to Apply for HVF Avadi Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27

Eligible candidates must register and apply online through the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal for Heavy Vehicles Factory Avadi (User ID: STNTLC000004) by following the steps below.

  1. Visit the NATS portal at https://nats.education.gov.in and click on “Student”.
  2. For first-time users, click “Student Register”, complete the registration form and obtain a 12-digit Enrollment Number.
  3. For existing NATS users, log in using registered email ID and password (or use “Forgot Password” to reset if migrated from old portal). Complete the application form if not already done.
  4. After enrollment, log in with email ID and password and click on “Apply against advertised vacancies”.
  5. Search for “HEAVY VEHICLES FACTORY” and click “Apply”. The status will change to “applied”.
  6. Upload Provisional Certificate or Consolidated Mark Sheet of BE/B.Tech/Diploma/BA/B.Sc/B.Com/BBA/BCA etc. and ensure that percentage of marks is correctly entered in the “% of marks / CGPA x 10” column; applications without percentage will not be considered.

Important Instructions

  • Only eligible candidates should apply and carefully read all provisions and requirements in the notification before submitting online application via NATS portal for HVF Avadi.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending certificate verification, and no boarding/lodging expenses are admissible for candidates.
  • Incomplete, erroneous or late online applications received after due date will be rejected, and no further communication will be entertained in this regard.
  • Board of Apprenticeship Training (Southern Region) has not authorised any individual/organisation to coordinate or liaison on its behalf; candidates are advised to beware of touts and note that the Board is not responsible for such incidents.
  • Canvassing or pressuring through any source will disqualify the candidature and the candidate’s name will be removed from official records without prior intimation.
  • For any clarification, candidates may contact through email at [email protected] as given in the notification.
