The Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test (TNTET) is a state-level examination that assesses the eligibility of candidates to teach in primary and upper primary schools. The 2026 edition is special as it focuses exclusively on working teachers, providing them an opportunity to clear the test amid government directives making TET mandatory for promotions and continued service. This is particularly relevant following recent G.O.s and court rulings emphasizing TET qualification for in-service educators. Working teachers in government, aided, and recognized private schools should read this article to understand application details, preparation strategies, and benefits.

Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test for Working Teachers 2026 – Complete Guide

The Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test for Working Teachers 2026 is designed to certify the eligibility of in-service teachers for teaching positions in Classes 1 to 8. Conducted by the Teachers Recruitment Board (TRB) under the Government of Tamil Nadu, it targets working teachers appointed before a specified cutoff date. The exam is held in offline mode using OMR sheets, with two separate papers: Paper 1 for Classes 1–5 and Paper 2 for Classes 6–8.

What is Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test for Working Teachers 2026?

TET is a state-level eligibility test for teachers of Classes 1–8 in government and aided schools, ensuring they meet national standards for teaching aptitude and subject knowledge. The 2026 version includes a special focus on working teachers who have not yet cleared TET, aligning with government and Supreme Court directives to make it mandatory for all educators. Clearing TET is now essential for job security and career advancement in Tamil Nadu.

  • Conducting body: Teachers Recruitment Board (TRB), Government of Tamil Nadu
  • Level: State-level eligibility test
  • Applicable classes: Paper 1 – Classes 1–5, Paper 2 – Classes 6–8

Special TET 2026 for Working Teachers – Key Highlights

This special TET targets working teachers, offering a dedicated chance to qualify without competing with fresh candidates. It differs by restricting eligibility to in-service educators, emphasizing their need for TET clearance for promotions and regularization. The test follows the standard TNTET pattern and syllabus.

Eligibility Criteria for Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test 2026 (Working Teachers)

Eligibility is limited to working teachers appointed on or before 01.09.2025 as Secondary Grade Teachers (SGT), BT Assistants, or equivalent cadres on time scale, consolidated, or part-time pay in specified departments and schools.

Educational Qualification for Paper 1 (Classes 1–5)

Candidates must possess the qualifications as per G.O.(Ms).No.13, School Education [SE3(1)] Department, dated 30.01.2020, including 10+2/HSC plus Diploma in Teacher Education/Diploma in Elementary Education or equivalent. This applies to Secondary Grade Teachers, BRTEs, and Special Education Teachers (IEDSS). In-service teachers in aided or unaided schools are also eligible if they meet NCTE norms.

Educational Qualification for Paper 2 (Classes 6–8)

Graduation in the relevant subject plus B.Ed. or equivalent, as per special rules for Tamil Nadu School Educational Subordinate Services. For Special Education Teachers, qualifications from G.O.(Ms).No.144, dated 17.06.2025 apply. Subject-specific requirements include relevant graduation for Mathematics/Science or Social Science teachers.

Age Limit and In-Service Relaxations

There is no upper age limit specified for TET eligibility. Relaxations in qualifying marks apply: 50% for BC/BCM/MBC/DNC/PWD and 40% for SC/SCA/ST.

Who Can Apply as a Working Teacher?

In-service teachers in government, government-aided, and recognized unaided private schools teaching Classes 1 to 8, including those under various departments like School Education, MBC, ADW, Tribal Welfare, and corporations. Qualified serving teachers opting for promotion must also apply.

TN TET 2026 Exam Pattern for Working Teachers

The exam pattern is identical for working and non-working candidates: 150 MCQs, 3 hours duration, no negative marking.

Minimum Qualifying Marks for Working Teachers

General category: 60% (90/150). BC/BCM/MBC/DNC and PWD: 50% (75/150). SC/SCA/ST: 40% (60/150).

Tamil Nadu TET 2026 Syllabus for Working Teachers

The syllabus is based on the state-prescribed topics for Classes 1–8, with difficulty up to secondary/higher secondary stage.

TNTET 2026 Paper 1 Syllabus (Classes 1–5)

  • Child Development and Pedagogy: Stages of child development, learning theories, inclusive education, teaching–learning process, assessment and evaluation.
  • Language I (regional language): Reading comprehension, grammar, language skills, pedagogy of language development.
  • Language II – English: Comprehension, vocabulary, grammar, communication, English language pedagogy.
  • Mathematics: Number system, operations, fractions, decimals, geometry, measurement, data handling, pedagogy of mathematics.
  • Environmental Studies: Family and friends, food, water, travel, shelter, environment, resources, EVS pedagogy.

TNTET 2026 Paper 2 Syllabus (Classes 6–8)

  • Child Development and Pedagogy (11–14): Adolescent development, learning and motivation, classroom management, evaluation.
  • Language I and II: Similar components as Paper 1 but at higher difficulty level.
  • Subject-specific: Mathematics & Science – algebra, geometry, mensuration, statistics, basics of physics, chemistry, biology, pedagogy. Social Science – history, geography, civics, economics, social science pedagogy.

Note that the official TRB syllabus PDF must be followed strictly.

Application Process for Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test 2026 (Working Teachers)

Applications are online only via http://www.trb.tn.gov.in. Separate applications for Paper 1 and Paper 2 with fees.

  • Register with valid email and mobile number.
  • Fill details, upload photo (40-60 KB, JPG/JPEG/PNG), signature (20-40 KB), and certificates (250-300 KB PDF).
  • Pay fee: Rs.600/- (general) or Rs.300/- (SC/SCA/ST/PWD) via net banking/credit/debit card.
  • Use edit window if needed; submit by 10-04-2026.

Documents required:

  • 10th/SSLC, 12th/HSC, Diploma/B.Ed./UG certificates and mark sheets.
  • Community certificate, Differently Abled certificate.
  • Service Certificate (Annexure-I).

Exam Centres, Hall Ticket and Exam Day Guidelines

Exams in all districts; centre details in hall ticket. Download hall ticket from TRB website. Report early with ID proof; no electronic gadgets allowed. OMR-based; follow invigilator instructions.

TN TET 2026 Result, Certificate Validity and Use for Promotions

Results published on http://www.trb.tn.gov.in as qualified lists. Qualifying candidates receive TNTET certificates. Validity is lifetime as per norms. For working teachers, TET clearance is mandatory for promotions in Tamil Nadu government schools; it's an eligibility criterion for career progression.

Benefits of Clearing Tamil Nadu TET 2026 for Working Teachers

  • Eligibility for regularization and promotions in government and aided schools.
  • Compliance with Supreme Court directions making TET mandatory for Classes 1–8 teachers.
  • Better job security and mobility, eligibility for future recruitment drives.
  • Professional recognition and alignment with national teacher quality standards.

Preparation Strategy for Working Teachers – How to Crack TN TET 2026

Balance school duties with study by focusing on pedagogy sections. Use NCERT/Tamil Nadu textbooks for content revision.

  • Create a weekly timetable around school hours.
  • Revise core concepts from textbook levels you teach daily.
  • Use weekends for full-length mock tests.
  • Focus on weak sections identified from previous attempts.

  • Gorkhas.
  • Garhwalis.
  • Ladakher.
  • Tribals of recognized tribal areas.

Note: Domicile and Caste certificate will be considered to determine applicability of height relaxation.

Application Fee

  • Examination Fee: Rs 250/- per application for all categories.
  • Payment Mode: Online (through the website during application).

Important Dates

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 13-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 01-04-2026
  • Online Exam Dates: 01/06/2026 to 15/06/2026 (Tentative)
  • Firm dates for online exam will be announced later on the website.

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates. Admission to the examination will be purely on the basis of Admit Card. The CEE will be conducted at designated centres tentatively between 01 Jun 2026 to 15 Jun 2026.
  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. Shortlisted candidates will attend the Recruitment Rally at designated venue where the Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical Test and Document Verification will be conducted.

Physical Fitness Test (PFT) (At Rally Site)

  • 1.6 Km Run
    • Group I: Upto 7 Min 45 Secs - Excellent
    • Group II: 7 Min 46 Sec to 8 Min 30 Sec - Good
  • Long Jump: 10 Feet (Need to qualify)
  • High Jump: 3 Feet (Need to qualify)

Note: Provisions for extra time for 1.6 Km run in hilly terrain and lower timing for Long Jump and High Jump in such cases.

Medical Standards

  • Candidates must be in good physical and mental health, free from any disability likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties.
  • Detailed medical examination as per Army standards.

Final Merit List

  • Final merit list will be based on aggregate of marks scored in CEE and performance in PFT (if applicable).
  • Recruitment is purely based on merit depending on available vacancies.

How to Apply

  3. Login using the credentials and fill the online application form carefully.
  4. Upload required documents, photographs, and signatures as per specifications.
  5. Pay the examination fee of Rs 250/- online.
  6. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

Note: Applications invited from domiciles of all districts of Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, UT of Chandigarh & Delhi. Any change in policy or details published in notification will be intimated on registered email/mobile number and with a ticker on the www.joinindianarmy.nic.in web portal.

Documents Required

Candidates must carry the following documents in original along with self-attested photocopies at the rally site (Phase II):

  • Single Bank A/C, PAN Card & AADHAR Card.
  • Police Verification Form.
  • Certificate from serving personnel for wards of serving soldiers (if applicable).
  • Any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

Salary Structure

Agniveers will be paid a customized package with fixed yearly increment. In addition, Risk and Hardship, Ration, Dress and Travel allowances as applicable.

Note: The total number of advertised posts and category-wise reservation figures are subject to change as per latest UP Government reservation rules and orders.

Eligibility Criteria for UPSSSC Pharmacist 2026

1. Educational Qualification

As per Uttar Pradesh Bheshajik Seva Niyamavali, 1980 (Part-4, Rule-8), candidates must possess a Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognised institution and must also be registered with the State Pharmacy Council, Uttar Pradesh to apply for UPSSSC Pharmacist posts.

2. Preferred Qualification (Adhimani Arhata)

As per Rule-9 of Uttar Pradesh Bheshajik Seva Niyamavali, 1980, preference will be given to candidates who have either served in the Provincial Army for a minimum period of two years, or have obtained the 'B' certificate of the National Cadet Corps (NCC).

3. Age Limit

The age limit for UPSSSC Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 is:

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 40 years
  • Age Relaxation: As per UP Government rules — SC/ST/OBC and other reserved categories will get relaxation as notified from time to time.
  • For UP State Government Employees: 5 years relaxation in upper age limit as per relevant government order.
  • Age Calculation Date: 1st January of the year of recruitment (or 1st July if post is advertised between 1st July to 31st December).

4. Nationality

Candidates must be Indian citizens as specified in the official notification.

5. PET Eligibility Condition

Only those candidates who have appeared in the Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET-2025) and have been issued a score card by UPSSSC are eligible to apply for this Main Examination. Candidates who scored zero or negative marks in PET-2025 will not be shortlisted.

Selection Process for UPSSSC Pharmacist 2026

The selection for UPSSSC Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following process:

  • Shortlisting for Main Examination: Based on normalised scores of PET-2025. Candidates will be shortlisted at 15 times the number of vacancies (up to the final cut-off mark at 2 decimal places).
  • Main Written Examination (Likhit Pariksha): One objective-type question paper with 100 questions, total 100 marks, duration 2 hours (120 minutes). Negative marking of 25% (i.e., ¼ mark) for each wrong answer.
  • Document Verification: For selected candidates after the written exam.

Eligible candidates can apply online for UPSSSC Pharmacist 2026 by following these steps:

Important Instructions for UPSSSC Pharmacist 2026

  • Only candidates who appeared in PET-2025 and received a score card from UPSSSC are eligible to apply for this Main Examination.

  • All reserved category candidates from Uttar Pradesh must mention their category in the application form. Only one (most beneficial) reservation will be applicable if a candidate claims multiple categories.
  • Candidates who are not domicile of Uttar Pradesh will not be eligible for reservation benefits and will be treated as General/Unreserved.
  • EWS candidates must possess an EWS certificate issued between 01-04-2025 and 29-03-2026 (application closing date), based on income of financial year 2024-25 and valid for financial year 2025-26.

  • Candidates currently employed in Central or State Government must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer.

Download Ordnance Factory Kanpur Recruitment 2026 Application Form

Salary

  • For all tenure-based ITI posts (Machinist and other trades), the consolidated monthly salary is based on Basic Pay of Rs 18,000 at 7th CPC Level‑1 plus applicable Dearness Allowance (DA) as per Government rules.

  • The pay is treated as consolidated for contract employees, and an annual increase of 3% on the Basic Pay is admissible during the tenure, subject to satisfactory performance in half‑yearly evaluations.

  • Remuneration is calculated at the rate of 1/30th of Basic Pay plus DA for 8 hours of work per day, and proportionate deductions are made for unauthorised leave or absence; contract personnel are also eligible for company holidays at par with regular employees.

  • If company quarters are not provided, HRA is payable, and where quarters are allotted, licence fee is deducted at rates applicable to regular workmen.

Selection Process

  • Selection for all 151 tenure-based ITI posts is purely merit-based, combining NCTVT/NCVT marks and Trade/Practical Test performance.

  • First, candidates are shortlisted for Trade/Practical Test on the basis of total marks obtained in the NCTVT/NCVT exam; the cut‑off percentage for calling candidates is decided by Ordnance Factory Kanpur.

  • A Trade/Practical Test is then conducted for the relevant trade (Machinist, Examiner, Electrician, etc.) at Ordnance Factory Kanpur to assess hands‑on skills.

  • The final merit list is prepared using combined scores with 80% weightage to NCTVT/NCVT exam marks and 20% weightage to the Trade/Practical Test.

  • Candidates placed in merit are called for Document Verification, where all original certificates and eligibility conditions are checked; if some candidates are rejected at this stage, additional candidates in order of merit may be called until all notified posts are covered.

Application Fees

  • The application fee is Rs 100 per candidate, to be paid via Demand Draft in favour of “ORDNANCE FACTORY KANPUR” for both advertisements.

  • SC/ST, Ex‑Servicemen and Physically Handicapped (PwD) candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

  • The fee must be enclosed with the offline application form in the prescribed manner; applications without the required fee (where applicable) are liable to be rejected.

How to Apply Ordnance Factory Kanpur Recruitment 2026 (151 Posts)

  • Applications are accepted offline only for all 151 tenure-based ITI posts under Ordnance Factory Kanpur Recruitment 2026.

  • Candidates must download and print the prescribed application form format from the official notice section of the AWEIL website (aweil.in/notice) as given in the two recruitment advertisements for 116 Machinist posts and 35 trades posts.

  • Fill the application form in block letters, carefully entering personal details, educational qualifications (10th and NTC/NAC), trade applied for, category, and contact details as required in the format.

  • Attach self-attested copies of:

    • Class 10th certificate/marksheet (as proof of date of birth)

    • NTC/NAC certificate in the relevant trade

    • Caste/category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD), Ex‑serviceman documents, etc., if applicable

    • Any other documents specified in the notifications.

  • Paste the required photograph on the form and enclose two extra self‑attested passport-size photographs as instructed.

  • Prepare the application fee Demand Draft of Rs 100 (where applicable) in favour of “ORDNANCE FACTORY KANPUR”; SC/ST, Ex‑Servicemen and PwD candidates are exempt from the fee.

  • Place the filled form, DD and documents in an envelope clearly superscribed with the relevant post, for example:

    • “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF MACHINIST (SS) ON CONTRACT BASIS” (for 116 Machinist posts), or

    • “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ‘TRADE NAME’ ON CONTRACT BASIS” (for Examiner, Electrician, etc.).

  • Send the envelope by post to: The Chief General Manager,Ordnance Factory Kanpur,Kalpi Road, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh – 208009, ensuring it reaches on or before 08 April 2026; applications received after the last date or incomplete/unsigned are liable to be rejected.

Additional qualification/Certification in Exports/International Marketing/Foreign Trade will be an added advantage
  • Senior Manager - Marketing (Consumer Sales) - HR-14: MBA/PGDM (at least 02 years course) in Marketing/Sales/Operations/Public Procurement/Supply Chain Management from Recognized University/Institute (AIU or UGC or AICTE) OR Full-time Engineering Degree with minimum 55% from a Government-recognized University/Institute (AIU or UGC or AICTE). Additional qualification or certification in Rehabilitation, Medical Devices or Social Sector Management will be an added advantage
  • Manager (Market Research & Data Analysis) - HR-15: MBA/PGDM (at least 02 years course) with minimum 55% marks in any discipline from a Government-recognized University/Institute (AIU or UGC or AICTE) OR Full-time Engineering Degree with minimum 55% from a Government-recognized University/Institute (AIU or UGC or AICTE). Certification in Data Analytics/Data Science/Statistical Tools/Business Intelligence will be an added advantage
  • Deputy Manager - GeM Sales - HR-16: MBA/PGDM (at least 02 years course) with minimum 55% marks in any discipline from a Government-recognized University/Institute (AIU or UGC or AICTE) OR Full-time Engineering Degree with minimum 55% from a Government-recognized University/Institute (AIU or UGC or AICTE). SAP Certification will be added advantage

  • Specialist - SAP SD - HR-27: Full-Time Bachelor of Engineering with 55% Marks from a government recognized University/Institute. SAP Certification will be added advantage
  • Specialist - SAP BASIS - HR-28: Full-Time Bachelor of Engineering with Minimum 55% Marks from a government recognized University/Institute. SAP Certification will be added advantage

At least 3 years of post-qualification experience in AI/ML engineering, with a strong focus on applications related to manufacturing industry

  • Junior Manager - Design & Development (Electronics) - HR-32: Full Time Engineering Degree in Electronics with minimum 55% marks from recognized university/Institute (AIU or UGC or AICTE)
  • Officer - O & M (Electrical/Electronics & Instrumentation) - HR-33: Full Time Engineering Degree in Electrical/Electronic/Instrumentation with minimum 55% marks from a Government recognized University/Institute. GATE Score Card - 2025 is required

Essential Qualifications

  • All essential qualifications should be from recognized Universities/Institutions approved by UGC/AICTE/Government of India as applicable
  • For GATE-based posts (HR-04 and HR-33), candidates must possess valid GATE 2025 score card
  • For professional qualifications like CA/ICWA/CS, candidates must have passed the final examination from respective institutes
  • For posts requiring registration with RCI (HR-18 and HR-19), candidates must be registered in Central Rehabilitation Register (CRR)
  • The prescribed qualifications are mandatory and in absence of the same any higher qualification even if possessed by the candidate does not make any candidate eligible
  • No age and percentage of marks bar for Departmental/Internal candidates who are on regular rolls or under Fixed Term Contracts with the corporation

Experience

  • General Manager Posts (HR-01, HR-05, HR-12, HR-20): Minimum 18 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing Sector with eight years at senior management capacity. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediately lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Deputy General Manager Posts (HR-06, HR-13): Minimum 16 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing Sector in respective domain. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediately lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Senior Manager Posts (HR-14, HR-24): Minimum 14 years post qualification experience in Government/PSU/reputed organizations. PSU/Government applicants should have minimum 02 years experience in the immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Manager Posts (HR-07, HR-15, HR-30): Minimum 12 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing Sector in respective domain. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Deputy Manager Posts (HR-02, HR-08, HR-16): Minimum 10 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing Sector in respective domain. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Assistant Manager (HR-31): Minimum 8 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing sector or research organization in field of design, research and development. Should have worked in immediate lower scale for at least 02 years. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Specialist SAP FICO (HR-25): Minimum 06 years of experience in SAP FICO with experience supporting general functions including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Financial Accounting, Management Accounting, Fixed Asset Accounting, Inter-company Accounting, and Project System. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Junior Manager Posts (HR-03, HR-09, HR-17, HR-22, HR-32): Minimum 05 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing Sector in respective domain. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Specialist SAP General & PM, SAP SD, SAP BASIS (HR-26, HR-27, HR-28): Minimum 05 years of experience in respective SAP modules. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • AI Engineer/Data Scientist (HR-29): At least 3 years of post-qualification experience in AI/ML engineering, with strong focus on applications related to manufacturing industry. Hands-on experience in developing and deploying AI models and machine learning algorithms for marketing and production environments. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Accountant (HR-11): 04 Years in field of Accounting functions
  • Officer Level Posts (HR-04, HR-10, HR-18, HR-19, HR-21, HR-23, HR-33): For HR-04 and HR-33 - GATE 2025 score required with relevant knowledge. For HR-10 - Good knowledge in Accounts and Taxation. For HR-18 - Knowledge in fabrication and fitting of artificial limbs and conducting camps. For HR-19 - Knowledge to examine patients with hearing, balance, or related ear problems and conducting camps. For HR-21 - As per qualifications mentioned with practical experience requirements. For HR-23 - Knowledge in labour or Social Welfare Work in an organization or other social and administrative work
  • Teaching experience and training period will not be counted as experience
  • Candidates from private sector should be drawing minimum consolidated fixed monthly gross salary as specified for respective grades (E-7: Rs. 1,86,120/-, E-6: Rs. 1,65,440/-, E-5: Rs. 1,44,760/-, E-4: Rs. 1,24,080/-, E-3: Rs. 1,03,400/-, E-2: Rs. 82,720/-, E-1: Rs. 62,040/-, E-0: NIL). Monthly gross salary includes Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance, HRA and other Fixed Perks and Allowance. No variable pay and incentive or reimbursement of expenses shall be considered
  • Wherever applicable, candidates must produce experience certificate as per required format during document verification

Desirable

  • All applicants should preferably have good computer knowledge and communication skills
  • Acquaintance with SAP shall be an added advantage for the candidates as Corporation's working is in SAP
  • For Deputy Manager - Production (Textile): Experience with SAP/ERP systems and export related process is desirable
  • For General Manager (Marketing): Knowledge of Corporate social responsibility, asset management, acquisition mergers contracts and negotiation, MOU etc. is desirable. Experience on manufacturing, distribution and supply of Artificial Limbs and Rehabilitation Aids, maintaining MIS on large domain, in/out bound logistics/SCM and CRM with logistics will be preferred. Knowledge of ERP is desirable
  • For Deputy General Manager - Marketing: Exposure to social sector/rehabilitation/healthcare/medical devices/assistive devices will be preferred
  • For Senior Manager - Marketing (Consumer Sales): Exposure to rehabilitation and healthcare/medical devices will be preferred
  • For Manager (Market Research & Data Analysis): Experience in the field of healthcare/rehabilitation/assistive devices/medical devices/social sector or public policy programs will be preferred
  • For General Manager (Projects & Commercial): Candidates having exposure in handling turn key projects of sizeable value of engineering industry will be preferred
  • For AI Engineer/Data Scientist: Experience with advanced optimization algorithms for marketing, supply chain and production scheduling. Familiarity with robotics and automation in Industries. Understanding of Industry 4.0 principles and smart marketing and manufacturing technologies. Prior experience in integrating AI with ERP/MES systems
  • For Junior Manager - Design & Development (Electronics): Knowledge of embedded firmware development for real-time applications using various microcontroller platforms is desirable

Salary/Stipend

  • E-7 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 1,00,000/- to Rs. 2,60,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 34,31,280/- (including Basic, IDA at 51.8%, Perks at 35%, HRA at 20%, Superannuation at 30% of Basic+DA, PRP/PLAI variable component)
  • E-6 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 90,000/- to Rs. 2,40,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 30,36,312/-
  • E-5 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 80,000/- to Rs. 2,20,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 26,52,864/-
  • E-4 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 70,000/- to Rs. 2,00,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 23,21,256/-
  • E-3 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 1,80,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 19,55,088/-
  • E-2 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 1,60,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 15,14,040/-
  • E-1 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 40,000/- to Rs. 1,40,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 13,03,392/-
  • E-0 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 1,20,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 9,77,544/-. Officers at E-0 will be given basic salary of Rs. 30,000/- for initial 1 year. On confirmation after satisfactory performance after 1 year of joining, basic salary will be fixed at Rs. 36,000/- under same pay scale
  • Group-D: Pay Scale Rs. 18,790/- to Rs. 64,130/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 6,25,496/-
  • IDA (Industrial Dearness Allowance) changes every quarter based on AICPI. Current IDA for Oct-Dec 2025 quarter is 51.8%
  • The annual increment is 3% of the basic pay every year
  • HRA for metro cities is currently 30% and for other cities is 20%
  • In addition to basic pay, selected candidates would be entitled for DA, HRA, perks and other benefits like PF contribution of 12%, Pension Scheme, PRP, Incentive (PLAI), Indoor treatment, hospitalization facilities under Medical Rules, Post-Retirement Medical Scheme, Gratuity, Earned leave and casual leave as per the rules of the Corporation
  • The employee and dependents are covered under Hospitalization scheme as per Group Health Insurance Scheme of the Corporation
  • OPD facility also be provided up to one month basic plus DA in a financial year subject to submission of bill from Corporation empaneled hospitals/doctors
  • Even after superannuation, the employee and spouse can avail post-retirement medical benefit
  • The Corporation has its PF Trust and the share of both employee and employer is 12%. Rs. 1,250/- every month goes to FPF maintained by EPFO. Family Pension is admissible after attaining the age of 58 years
  • The corporation has taken up a superannuation policy with LIC of India where employees can contribute 10% and the corporation shall contribute 10% of the salary. At the time of superannuation, LIC calculates the Fund Corpus and fixes annuity for the life of the employee and thereafter his/her spouse

Age Limit (as on 01/01/2026)

  • E-7 Grade (General Manager Posts): Maximum age 55 years
  • E-6 Grade (Deputy General Manager Posts): Maximum age 52 years
  • E-5 Grade (Senior Manager Posts): Maximum age 50 years
  • E-4 Grade (Manager Posts): Maximum age 48 years
  • E-3 Grade (Deputy Manager and Specialist Posts): Maximum age 45 years
  • E-2 Grade (Assistant Manager Posts): Maximum age 42 years
  • E-1 Grade (Junior Manager and AI Engineer Posts): Maximum age 40 years
  • E-0 Grade (Officer Level Posts): Maximum age 30 years
  • Group-D (Accountant): Maximum age 34 years
  • The candidate should not have exceeded the age limit as of 01.01.2026. The date for reckoning the age, qualification, experience, etc. shall be 01.01.2026
  • No age and percentage of marks bar for Departmental/Internal candidates who are on the regular rolls of the Corporation or are under Fixed Term Contracts with the corporation
  • Relaxations for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/EWS/PwBD (Divyangjan) candidates (Percentage of disability 40% or above) will be provided as per guidelines of Government of India
  • The SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS candidates who apply against unreserved (UR) posts will not be eligible for age relaxation
  • PwBD (Divyangjan) candidates (Percentage of disability 40% or above) are eligible for age relaxations

Application Fee

  • For Executive Posts (E0-E7): Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only)
  • For Non-Executive Posts (Group-D): Rs. 250/- (Rupees Two Hundred Fifty only)

Vacancy Details

High Court of Allahabad has announced the recruitment of Special Judicial Magistrates for two districts in Uttar Pradesh. These positions are on a fixed honorarium basis with conveyance allowance. The recruitment is open for Government servants or former Government employees who possess legal qualifications or have extensive experience in legal affairs.

District Vacancy Position
Gonda 1 Special Judicial Magistrate
Jalaun (Orai) 1 Special Judicial Magistrate

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications

  • Status: Must be a Government servant (current or former) OR has held any post under the Government of India/State Government/Union Territory
  • Educational Qualification: Must possess:
    • Law degree (LL.B. from a recognized university), OR
    • Be well-experienced in relation to legal affairs to the satisfaction of the High Court
  • Professional Background: Experience in legal matters, judicial work, or administrative/legal roles under Government is an advantage

Term & Age

  • Term of Office: 4 years from the date of assumption of charge OR attaining the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier
  • Age Limit: No specific upper age limit mentioned, but term ends at age 70
  • Transferability: A candidate appointed for a specific district shall NOT be transferred to any other district under any circumstances

Previous SJM/SMM Experience

  • Ex-SJMs appointed by Government of Uttar Pradesh do NOT need to submit character roll entries
  • Ex-SJMs applying for re-appointment must enclose four best judgments delivered while holding the post of SJM/SMM

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Released 09.02.2026
Application Submission Last Date 13-04-2026
Selection Process Merit-based by High Court
Term of Office 4 Years or Age 70 years

Selection Process

  • Application Scrutiny: All applications are submitted to the respective District Judge who conducts preliminary scrutiny
  • District Judge Review: The District Judge reviews applications and forwards only those he finds fit for the SJM post to the High Court with his remarks
  • High Court Evaluation: The High Court evaluates forwarded applications based on qualifications, experience, and legal expertise
  • Merit-Based Selection: Selection is based on merit, qualifications, Government service record, and experience in legal matters
  • Final Appointment: Appointment is made by the High Court through formal order of the Court

Salary/Remuneration

  • Fixed Honorarium: ₹45,000/- per month (fixed, subject to correction and updation by High Court)
  • Conveyance Allowance: ₹5,000/- per month for official travel and conveyance
  • Total Monthly Remuneration: ₹50,000/- per month (base honorarium + conveyance)
  • Payment: Subject to correction and updation from time to time as per High Court guidelines

How to Apply

Application Preparation

  1. Download the Application Form from the official High Court notification PDF
  2. Fill all columns of the application form in block letters (all columns are compulsory)
  3. Affix a self-attested recent passport-size photograph
  4. Provide complete and accurate information including:

India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates applying for India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 must satisfy all eligibility conditions related to nationality, age, educational qualification and experience as on the closing date of the advertisement.

  • Nationality: Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
  • Age Limit: 18 to 35 years as on the closing date of the advertisement.
  • Age Relaxation: Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen and other categories as per Government of India directives and applicable reservation rules.
  • Educational Qualification – Chemical: First class (minimum 60%) full-time regular B.Sc degree in Chemistry from a recognized university with at least 5 years of post-qualification relevant experience.
  • Educational Qualification – Electrical: Full-time regular 3-year Diploma in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics / Plant Maintenance Engineering with minimum 60% marks and at least 5 years of post-qualification relevant experience.
  • Educational Qualification – Electronics: Full-time regular 3-year Diploma in Electronics & Communication / Electronics & Instrumentation / Industrial Electronics & Instrumentation with minimum 60% marks and at least 5 years of post-qualification relevant experience.
  • Educational Qualification – Mechanical: Full-time regular 3-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering / Production Engineering / Mechatronics with minimum 60% marks and at least 5 years of post-qualification relevant experience.
  • Educational Qualification – Optics & Coating: First class (minimum 60%) full-time regular B.Sc degree with Physics and Mathematics as major subjects from a recognized university with at least 5 years of post-qualification relevant experience.
  • Marks Relaxation: General/OBC (NCL)/EWS candidates must have at least 60% aggregate marks; SC/ST/PwBD candidates must have at least 50% aggregate marks in the essential qualification.
  • Course Type: Only full-time regular courses recognized by AICTE/UGC/State Boards or appropriate statutory authorities will be considered.

India Optel Limited Junior Project Engineer Salary 2026

  • Junior Project Engineers engaged under India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 will be placed in Pay Level ₹30,000 – ₹1,20,000, along with Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA).
  • They will be eligible for House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per applicable rates where company accommodation is not allotted.
  • Medical Allowance of ₹1,500 per month is payable, subject to conditions for retired Govt. employees/Ex-servicemen with respect to CGHS/ECHS/Defence Forces NOC.
  • An annual increment of 3% of basic pay (rounded to the next ten) is admissible during the tenure, based on satisfactory performance and recommendation of the competent authority.

Tenure of Engagement

  • The initial engagement on Fixed Term Contract basis will be for up to 2 years, depending on requirement.
  • Extension in engagement may be granted for periods up to 1 year at a time, subject to requirement and performance evaluation, with the total tenure not exceeding 5 years including initial term and extensions.
  • IOL reserves the right to terminate the contract before completion of the term in case of unsatisfactory performance or misconduct, with notice as per conditions in the advertisement.

Place of Posting

Selected candidates for India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 will normally be posted at Opto Electronics Factory (OLF) and Ordnance Factory Dehradun (OFD), units of India Optel Limited located in Dehradun, Uttarakhand. However, depending on organizational requirements, they may be posted, transferred, attached or deputed to other locations with the approval of the competent authority.

India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Screening: Applications will be screened by a Screening Committee, and only eligible candidates will be considered.
  • Shortlisting: Candidates will be shortlisted for interview, generally up to 1.5 times the number of vacancies, based on percentage of marks in Diploma/B.Sc (as applicable).
  • Interview: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for personal interview, for which call letters will be sent through email.
  • Final Merit: Final merit will be prepared using 75% weightage for Diploma/B.Sc percentage and 25% weightage for interview performance.
  • Document Verification: Original documents will be verified before interview; any shortcomings or discrepancies will result in rejection of candidature.
  • Tie-breaking: In case of equal scores, the elder candidate (by date of birth) will be placed higher; if DOB is also same, alphabetical order of names will be considered.

Application Fee

  • There is no application fee (NIL) for India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 Junior Project Engineer posts.

How to Apply India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 (Junior Project Engineer)

Applications for India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 are accepted offline only in the prescribed application format (Annexure “A”). Follow the steps given below.

  1. Download Application Form: Visit the DOO (C&S) website at https://ddpdoo.gov.in, go to the “Join Us” tab and download the application format (Annexure “A”) attached with the advertisement.
  2. Fill in Block Letters: Fill the application completely in BLOCK LETTERS, giving correct personal details, category, educational qualifications, post applied for, and experience information.
  3. Attach Photograph: Paste a recent passport-size photograph on the application form and self-attest it as specified.
  4. Attach Self-attested Documents: Enclose self-attested photocopies of:
    • Valid proof of date of birth (Matriculation/Secondary school certificate or Birth Certificate)
    • Educational mark sheets and degree/diploma certificates (10th onwards)
    • Experience certificates, joining/relieving letters, salary slips/statement, PPO (for retired candidates), etc., showing relevant post-qualification experience
    • Caste/category certificate for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS, PwBD certificate, Ex-Servicemen discharge certificate (if applicable)
  5. Check Email and Mobile: Clearly mention a valid and active email ID and mobile number which will remain in use throughout the engagement process, as all important communication will be sent via email.
  6. Separate Applications: If applying for more than one discipline/position, submit a separate application for each.
  7. Superscribe Envelope: Put the filled application and enclosures in an envelope clearly superscribed as “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ________ ON FIXED TERM CONTRACT BASIS”.
  8. Send by Speed Post Only: Send the application by Speed Post only to the following address so that it reaches within 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News:Postal Address: The Chairman & Managing Director, India Optel Limited, OFILDD Campus, Raipur, Dehradun (Uttarakhand) – 248008
  9. Applications received after the closing date, incomplete applications, applications without required enclosures, not in the prescribed format or with incorrect information are liable to be rejected without any correspondence.

Important Instructions & Rejection Conditions

  • Applications not meeting eligibility criteria, received after the last date, or not in the prescribed format will be summarily rejected and IOL will not be responsible for postal delays.
  • Incomplete, illegible applications or those without self-attested copies of required certificates will not be considered.
  • Any variation in name/surname between application and certificates, or any false/incorrect information or dubious documents, will lead to disqualification.
  • Candidates who do not fulfil the eligibility conditions at any stage will be disqualified ab-initio and no correspondence will be entertained regarding non-selection.

Nature of Engagement & Termination

  • The engagement is purely on Fixed Term Contract basis and does not confer any right for regular or permanent employment in India Optel Limited.
  • The engagement automatically ends on completion of the contract term unless extended, and may be terminated earlier for poor performance, misconduct, breach of company rules or prolonged unauthorized absence.
  • The contract can be terminated by giving notice (or payment in lieu) as specified in the advertisement: generally 3 months by the FTC employee and 1 month by the company.
